===== D:\CRM Main\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app\src\components\FollowUpReminders\FollowUpReminders.jsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { leadService } from '../../services/leadService';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

/**
 * Global follow-up reminder.
 * Mounted once in MainLayout, so it works on EVERY page (not only Follow-ups).
 *
 * - Loads this telecaller's leads that have a follow-up date (tcNextRefollowupDate)
 * - When that date/time arrives -> popup + sound + browser notification
 * - Also shows follow-ups that became due while the telecaller was away (last 24h)
 * - Actions: Call Now (opens Call Panel and starts the call), Snooze 5 min, Dismiss
 */

const CHECK_EVERY_MS = 1000;             // compare "now" with due times every second (in-memory, very cheap)
const REFRESH_EVERY_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000;  // how often we re-read follow-ups from the server
const SNOOZE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const OVERDUE_WINDOW_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_VISIBLE = 3;

// ─── helpers (same rules as Followups.jsx) ────────────────────────────────────
const unwrapRows = (value) => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
  if (Array.isArray(value?.data)) return value.data;
  if (Array.isArray(value?.content)) return value.content;
  if (Array.isArray(value?.items)) return value.items;
  if (Array.isArray(value?.leads)) return value.leads;
  if (Array.isArray(value?.data?.content)) return value.data.content;
  return [];
};

const parseLeadNotes = (lead) => {
  const raw = lead?.notes;
  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw)) return raw;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim()) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
};

const firstValue = (...values) =>
  values.find((v) => v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '');
// same, but returns '' instead of undefined (so we never print the word "undefined")
const textOf = (...values) => String(firstValue(...values) ?? '');

// "2026-11-24T14:30" -> that local time. Date only ("2026-11-24") -> 09:00 local.
const toDueDate = (raw) => {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const text = String(raw).trim();
  const hasTime = /[T ]\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(text);
  if (!hasTime) {
    const m = text.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
    if (!m) return null;
    return { due: new Date(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), 9, 0, 0), hasTime: false };
  }
  const d = new Date(text);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : { due: d, hasTime: true };
};

const mapLeadToReminder = (lead) => {
  const rawDate = firstValue(
    lead?.tcNextRefollowupDate, lead?.nextFollowupDate, lead?.followUpDate, lead?.followupDate
  );
  const parsed = toDueDate(rawDate);
  if (!parsed) return null;

  const notes = parseLeadNotes(lead);
  const fuStatus = String(notes.TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_STATUS || '');
  // Already handled -> never remind
  if (['Completed', 'Missed', 'Cancelled'].includes(fuStatus)) return null;

  const leadKey = String(firstValue(lead?.leadId, lead?.businessLeadId, lead?.id, lead?._id, ''));
  if (!leadKey) return null;

  return {
    key: `${leadKey}|${String(rawDate).trim()}`,   // changes when the follow-up is rescheduled
    leadId: leadKey,
    rawLead: lead,
    organization: textOf(lead?.organization, lead?.schoolName, lead?.school, lead?.name) || 'Unknown organization',
    contactPerson: textOf(lead?.contactPerson, lead?.contactName),
    mobile: textOf(lead?.mobile, lead?.phoneNumber, lead?.phone),
    note: textOf(notes.TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_NOTE, notes.tcNextRefollowupNote, lead?.tcNextRefollowupNote, lead?.followupNote),
    due: parsed.due,
    hasTime: parsed.hasTime,
  };
};

const fmtDue = (r) => {
  const date = r.due.toLocaleDateString([], { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
  return r.hasTime ? `${date}, ${r.due.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}` : date;
};

const dueLabel = (r, now) => {
  const mins = Math.floor((now - r.due.getTime()) / 60000);
  if (mins < 2) return 'Due now';
  if (mins < 60) return `Overdue by ${mins} min`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  return `Overdue by ${hrs} hr${hrs > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
};

// ─── sound + browser notification ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const beep = () => {
  try {
    const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!Ctx) return;
    const ctx = new Ctx();
    [0, 0.35].forEach((offset) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.value = 880;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + offset);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + offset + 0.02);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + offset + 0.3);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(ctx.currentTime + offset);
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + offset + 0.32);
    });
    setTimeout(() => ctx.close?.(), 1500);
  } catch { /* autoplay blocked - popup still shows */ }
};

const browserNotify = (r) => {
  try {
    if (!('Notification' in window) || Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;
    const n = new Notification('⏰ Follow-up due: ' + r.organization, {
      body: [r.contactPerson, r.mobile, r.note].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      tag: r.key,
      requireInteraction: true,
    });
    n.onclick = () => { window.focus(); n.close(); };
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
};

// ─── component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const FollowUpReminders = ({ onNavigate }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const storeKey = `fu-reminders-ack:${user?.username || 'me'}`;

  const [popups, setPopups] = useState([]);      // reminders currently shown
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now());

  const itemsRef = useRef([]);                    // all pending follow-ups
  const shownRef = useRef(new Set());             // keys already popped up this session
  const snoozedRef = useRef(new Map());           // key -> timestamp when to show again
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);

  const readAcked = useCallback(() => {
    try { return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeKey) || '[]')); }
    catch { return new Set(); }
  }, [storeKey]);

  const ack = useCallback((key) => {
    try {
      const set = readAcked();
      set.add(key);
      localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify([...set].slice(-500)));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, [readAcked, storeKey]);

  // ── load follow-ups from the server (same API the Follow-ups page uses) ─────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (loadingRef.current) return;
    loadingRef.current = true;
    try {
      const districts = unwrapRows(await leadService.getMyDistricts());
      const responses = await Promise.all(
        districts.map((item) => {
          const d = typeof item === 'string' ? item : (item?.district || item?.name || item?.districtName);
          return d ? leadService.getMyLeadsByDistrict(d).catch(() => []) : Promise.resolve([]);
        })
      );
      const list = responses.flatMap(unwrapRows).map(mapLeadToReminder).filter(Boolean);
      itemsRef.current = list;
      const upcoming = list.filter((r) => r.due.getTime() > Date.now()).sort((a, b) => a.due - b.due)[0];
      console.info(`[FollowUpReminders] loaded ${list.length} pending follow-ups` + (upcoming ? `, next: ${upcoming.organization} at ${upcoming.due.toLocaleString()}` : ''));

      // drop popups for follow-ups that were completed / rescheduled / removed meanwhile
      const alive = new Set(list.map((r) => r.key));
      setPopups((cur) => cur.filter((p) => alive.has(p.key)));
    } catch (error) {
      /* offline / not a telecaller -> try again next cycle */
      console.warn('[FollowUpReminders] could not load follow-ups:', error?.message || error);
    } finally {
      loadingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  // ── compare "now" with due times ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const check = useCallback(() => {
    const t = Date.now();
    setNow(t);
    const acked = readAcked();
    const fresh = [];

    itemsRef.current.forEach((r) => {
      const dueMs = r.due.getTime();
      if (dueMs > t) return;                                   // not yet
      if (t - dueMs > OVERDUE_WINDOW_MS) return;               // too old
      if (acked.has(r.key)) return;                            // already handled
      const snoozeUntil = snoozedRef.current.get(r.key);
      if (snoozeUntil && snoozeUntil > t) return;              // snoozed
      if (shownRef.current.has(r.key)) return;                 // already on screen
      shownRef.current.add(r.key);
      fresh.push(r);
    });

    if (fresh.length) {
      fresh.sort((a, b) => a.due - b.due);
      setPopups((cur) => [...cur, ...fresh]);
      beep();
      fresh.forEach(browserNotify);
    }
  }, [readAcked]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // ask once for desktop-notification permission (needed when the tab is in background)
    try {
      if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default') {
        Notification.requestPermission();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }

    load().then(check);

    // Ticker. Browsers slow down setInterval in background tabs (to ~1 per minute),
    // which made reminders late. A Web Worker is not throttled, so it drives the clock;
    // setInterval stays as a fallback.
    let worker = null;
    let checkTimer = null;
    try {
      const blob = new Blob(
        [`setInterval(function(){ postMessage(1); }, ${CHECK_EVERY_MS});`],
        { type: 'application/javascript' }
      );
      worker = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      worker.onmessage = () => check();
    } catch {
      checkTimer = setInterval(check, CHECK_EVERY_MS);
    }

    const loadTimer = setInterval(load, REFRESH_EVERY_MS);
    const onFocus = () => { load().then(check); };
    const onVisible = () => { if (!document.hidden) check(); };
    // Fired by leadService.updateLead -> a follow-up was just created / rescheduled
    const onChanged = () => { load().then(check); };

    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    window.addEventListener('followups-changed', onChanged);
    return () => {
      if (worker) worker.terminate();
      if (checkTimer) clearInterval(checkTimer);
      clearInterval(loadTimer);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
      window.removeEventListener('followups-changed', onChanged);
    };
  }, [load, check]);

  // Test helper: open the browser console on ANY page and run  testFollowUpReminder()
  useEffect(() => {
    window.testFollowUpReminder = () => {
      const due = new Date();
      const r = {
        key: `test|${Date.now()}`, leadId: 'TEST', rawLead: null,
        organization: 'Test School (reminder check)', contactPerson: 'Test Contact', mobile: '9876543210',
        note: 'This is a test follow-up reminder.', due, hasTime: true,
      };
      setPopups((cur) => [...cur, r]);
      beep();
    };
    return () => { delete window.testFollowUpReminder; };
  }, []);

  // ── actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const remove = (key) => setPopups((cur) => cur.filter((p) => p.key !== key));

  const dismiss = (r) => { ack(r.key); remove(r.key); };

  const snooze = (r) => {
    snoozedRef.current.set(r.key, Date.now() + SNOOZE_MS);
    shownRef.current.delete(r.key);   // allowed to pop up again after the snooze
    remove(r.key);
  };

  const callNow = (r) => {
    ack(r.key);
    remove(r.key);
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate('callpanel', {
        state: { lead: r.rawLead, leadId: r.leadId, phone: r.mobile, name: r.organization, action: 'startCall' },
      });
    }
  };

  if (!popups.length) return null;

  const visible = popups.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE);
  const hidden = popups.length - visible.length;

  return createPortal(
    <div
      role="alert"
      aria-live="assertive"
      style={{ position: 'fixed', top: 16, right: 16, zIndex: 10000, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12, width: 340, maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)' }}
    >
      {visible.map((r) => (
        <div
          key={r.key}
          style={{ background: '#fff', borderRadius: 12, borderLeft: '5px solid #7b1113', boxShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.22)', padding: 14, animation: 'fuPopIn .25s ease-out' }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <strong style={{ color: '#7b1113', fontSize: 13 }}>⏰ Follow-up reminder</strong>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#b91c1c', background: '#fee2e2', borderRadius: 999, padding: '2px 8px' }}>
              {dueLabel(r, now)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, color: '#111827' }}>{r.organization}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#4b5563', marginTop: 2 }}>
            {[r.contactPerson, r.mobile && `☎ ${r.mobile}`].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '--'}
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#6b7280', marginTop: 2 }}>Scheduled: {fmtDue(r)}</div>
          {r.note && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#374151', background: '#f9fafb', borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 8px', marginTop: 8, maxHeight: 64, overflow: 'auto' }}>
              {r.note}
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => callNow(r)}
              style={{ flex: 1.3, padding: '8px 0', border: 'none', borderRadius: 8, background: '#7b1113', color: '#fff', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >📞 Call Now</button>
            <button
              onClick={() => snooze(r)}
              style={{ flex: 1, padding: '8px 0', border: '1px solid #e5e7eb', borderRadius: 8, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12.5 }}
            >Snooze 5m</button>
            <button
              onClick={() => dismiss(r)}
              style={{ flex: 0.8, padding: '8px 0', border: '1px solid #e5e7eb', borderRadius: 8, background: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12.5 }}
            >Dismiss</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      {hidden > 0 && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#fff', background: '#7b1113', borderRadius: 999, padding: '4px 10px', alignSelf: 'center' }}>
          +{hidden} more follow-up{hidden > 1 ? 's' : ''} due
        </div>
      )}

      <style>{`@keyframes fuPopIn { from { transform: translateX(30px); opacity: 0 } to { transform: none; opacity: 1 } }`}</style>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
};

export default FollowUpReminders;

===== D:\CRM Main\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app\src\components\Invoice\InvoiceEditorModal.jsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FiDownload, FiPlus, FiSave, FiTrash2, FiX } from 'react-icons/fi';

import InvoiceTemplate from './InvoiceTemplate';
import { INVOICE_DEFAULTS, TEXT_KEYS } from './InvoiceDefaults';
import paymentAdminService from '../../services/paymentAdminService';
import invoiceAssetService from '../../services/invoiceAssetService';

import './InvoiceEditorModal.css';
import './InvoiceEditorExtras.css';

const NUMBER_FORMAT = /^INV-IC\/\d{5,}$/;
const GSTIN_FORMAT = /^\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][A-Z\d]Z[A-Z\d]$/;
const PHONE_FORMAT = /^[0-9+\-\s]{7,15}$/;
const STATUS_OPTIONS = ['Paid', 'Partial Paid', 'Pending', 'Fully Paid', 'Verified'];

const num = (v) => {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};

const toInputDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(value)) return String(value).slice(0, 10);
  const d = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) : d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
};

/** Backend invoice -> editor form (every field editable). */
const formFromInvoice = (inv) => {
  const form = {
    invoiceNumber: inv.invoiceNumber || '',
    invoiceDate: toInputDate(inv.invoiceDate || inv.paymentDate),
    paymentStatus: inv.paymentStatus || 'Paid',
    paymentType: inv.paymentType || '',
    organizationName: inv.organizationName || '',
    address: inv.address || '',
    phone: inv.phone || '',
    customerGstin: inv.customerGstin || '',
    email: inv.email || '',
    discountAmount: inv.discountAmount ?? 0,
    taxRate: inv.taxRate ?? 18,
    amountPaid: inv.amountPaid ?? 0,
  };

  // company / bank / declaration / signature: saved value, else the template default
  TEXT_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
    form[key] = inv[key] !== undefined && inv[key] !== null ? inv[key] : INVOICE_DEFAULTS[key];
  });

  form.items =
    Array.isArray(inv.items) && inv.items.length
      ? inv.items.map((i) => ({
          description: i.description || '',
          quantity: i.quantity ?? 1,
          rate: i.rate ?? 0,
        }))
      : [
          {
            description: inv.description || `${inv.paymentType || 'Service'} charges`,
            quantity: 1,
            rate: inv.totalAmount ?? 0,
          },
        ];

  return form;
};

/** Editor form -> object understood by InvoiceTemplate / printInvoicePdf (numbers cleaned). */
const toInvoiceView = (form) => ({
  ...form,
  discountAmount: num(form.discountAmount),
  taxRate: num(form.taxRate),
  amountPaid: num(form.amountPaid),
  items: form.items.map((i) => ({
    description: i.description,
    quantity: num(i.quantity),
    rate: num(i.rate),
  })),
});

const money = (v) => num(v).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

export default function InvoiceEditorModal({ payment, onClose, onPrint, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(null);
  const [assets, setAssets] = useState({ qrDataUrl: '', logoDataUrl: '', signatureDataUrl: '', thankYouDataUrl: '' });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  const previewRef = useRef(null);
  const [previewScale, setPreviewScale] = useState(0.45);

  const hydrate = (inv) => {
    const f = formFromInvoice(inv);
    setForm(f);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [invoice, qr, brand] = await Promise.all([
          paymentAdminService.getInvoice(payment.id),
          paymentAdminService.getSharedQr().catch(() => null),
          invoiceAssetService.getAssets().catch(() => ({})),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;
        hydrate(invoice);
        setAssets({
          qrDataUrl: qr?.dataUrl || '',
          logoDataUrl: brand?.logoDataUrl || '',
          signatureDataUrl: brand?.signatureDataUrl || '',
          thankYouDataUrl: brand?.thankYouDataUrl || '',
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (active) setLoadError(e.message || 'Unable to load the invoice. Generate the invoice first.');
      } finally {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [payment.id]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = previewRef.current;
    if (!el) return undefined;
    const fit = () => {
      const w = Math.max(1, el.clientWidth - 48);
      const h = Math.max(1, el.clientHeight - 48);
      const s = Math.min(w / 1024, h / 1518, 1);
      setPreviewScale(Number.isFinite(s) ? Math.max(0.08, s) : 0.45);
    };
    fit();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(fit);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [loading]);

  const set = (key) => (e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: e.target.value }));

  const setItem = (index, key, value) =>
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      items: f.items.map((item, i) => (i === index ? { ...item, [key]: value } : item)),
    }));

  // Copy the Bill To name + address into the Shipping fields (both stay editable afterwards).
  const copyBillToShipping = () =>
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, shippingName: f.organizationName, shippingAddress: f.address }));

  const addItem = () =>
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, items: [...f.items, { description: '', quantity: 1, rate: 0 }] }));

  const removeItem = (index) =>
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, items: f.items.length > 1 ? f.items.filter((_, i) => i !== index) : f.items }));

  // what the preview + PDF show
  const view = useMemo(() => {
    if (!form) return {};
    return toInvoiceView(form);
  }, [form]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => {
    if (!form) return { subtotal: 0, taxable: 0, tax: 0, grand: 0, balance: 0 };
    const subtotal = form.items.reduce((s, i) => s + num(i.quantity) * num(i.rate), 0);
    const taxable = Math.max(0, subtotal - num(form.discountAmount));
    const tax = (taxable * num(form.taxRate)) / 100;
    const grand = taxable + tax;
    return { subtotal, taxable, tax, grand, balance: Math.max(0, grand - num(form.amountPaid)) };
  }, [form]);

  const validate = () => {
    if (!NUMBER_FORMAT.test(form.invoiceNumber.trim())) return 'Invoice number format must be INV-IC/00760.';
    if (!form.organizationName.trim()) return 'Client / organization name is required.';
    if (form.phone.trim() && !PHONE_FORMAT.test(form.phone.trim())) return 'Contact number must be 7-15 digits (digits, +, - and spaces only).';
    if (form.customerGstin.trim() && !GSTIN_FORMAT.test(form.customerGstin.trim().toUpperCase())) return 'GSTIN must be a valid 15-character GST number (e.g. 33ABCDE1234F1Z5).';
    if (!form.items.length) return 'Add at least one item.';
    for (const [i, item] of form.items.entries()) {
      if (!String(item.description).trim()) return `Item ${i + 1}: description is required.`;
      if (num(item.quantity) <= 0) return `Item ${i + 1}: quantity must be greater than 0.`;
      if (num(item.rate) < 0) return `Item ${i + 1}: rate cannot be negative.`;
    }
    if (num(form.discountAmount) < 0 || num(form.discountAmount) > totals.subtotal) return 'Discount must be between 0 and the subtotal.';
    if (num(form.taxRate) < 0 || num(form.taxRate) > 100) return 'Tax rate must be between 0 and 100.';
    if (num(form.amountPaid) < 0) return 'Paid amount cannot be negative.';
    if (num(form.amountPaid) > totals.grand + 0.005) return 'Paid amount cannot be more than the invoice total.';
    return '';
  };

  const save = async () => {
    const problem = validate();
    if (problem) { setNotice({ type: 'err', text: problem }); return null; }
    setSaving(true);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const payload = { ...view, invoiceNumber: form.invoiceNumber.trim(), customerGstin: form.customerGstin.trim().toUpperCase() };
      const saved = await paymentAdminService.updateInvoice(payment.id, payload);
      hydrate(saved);
      setNotice({ type: 'ok', text: 'Invoice saved.' });
      onSaved?.(saved);
      return saved;
    } catch (e) {
      setNotice({ type: 'err', text: e.message || 'Unable to save the invoice.' });
      return null;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const download = async () => {
    if (printing) return;
    const saved = await save(); // download exactly what is stored
    if (!saved) return;
    setPrinting(true);
    try {
      await onPrint(toInvoiceView(formFromInvoice(saved)));
    } finally {
      setPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  const text = (key, label, props = {}) => (
    <label>
      <span>{label}</span>
      <input value={form[key] ?? ''} onChange={set(key)} {...props} />
    </label>
  );

  const area = (key, label, rows = 3) => (
    <label>
      <span>{label}</span>
      <textarea rows={rows} value={form[key] ?? ''} onChange={set(key)} />
    </label>
  );

  return (
    <div className="invoice-editor-overlay" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="invoice-editor-modal">
        <div className="invoice-editor-header">
          <div>
            <h2>Edit Invoice</h2>
            <p>Everything on the invoice can be edited. Changes are saved and used for every PDF / Excel download.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="invoice-editor-actions">
            <button className="iee-save-btn" type="button" onClick={save} disabled={loading || saving || !form}>
              <FiSave size={16} /> {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}
            </button>
            <button className="invoice-editor-print-btn" type="button" onClick={download} disabled={loading || printing || saving || !form}>
              <FiDownload size={17} /> {printing ? 'Generating PDF…' : 'Save & Download PDF'}
            </button>
            <button className="invoice-editor-close-btn" type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">
              <FiX size={22} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {loading && <div className="iee-state">Loading invoice…</div>}
        {!loading && loadError && <div className="iee-state iee-err">{loadError}</div>}

        {!loading && form && (
          <div className="invoice-editor-body">
            <aside className="invoice-editor-form">
              <h3>Invoice</h3>
              {text('invoiceNumber', 'Invoice Number', { placeholder: 'INV-IC/00760' })}
              <small className="invoice-number-hint">Format: INV-IC/00000 (auto sequence, must be unique)</small>
              <div className="iee-row">
                <label>
                  <span>Invoice Date</span>
                  <input type="date" value={form.invoiceDate} onChange={set('invoiceDate')} />
                </label>
                <label>
                  <span>Status</span>
                  <select value={form.paymentStatus} onChange={set('paymentStatus')}>
                    {[...new Set([form.paymentStatus, ...STATUS_OPTIONS])].map((s) => <option key={s}>{s}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </label>
              </div>
              {text('paymentType', 'Received row label (shows as "<label> Received", e.g. Advance / Full)')}

              <h3>Company (invoice header)</h3>
              {text('companyName', 'Company Name')}
              {area('companyAddress', 'Company Address', 3)}
              {text('companyEmail', 'Company Email')}
              <div className="iee-row">
                {text('companyMobile', 'Mobile')}
                {text('companyWebsite', 'Website')}
              </div>

              <h3>Bill To</h3>
              {text('organizationName', 'Customer Name')}
              {area('address', 'Billing Address', 3)}
              <div className="iee-row">
                {text('customerGstin', 'GSTIN (optional)', {
                  placeholder: '33ABCDE1234F1Z5',
                  maxLength: 15,
                  style: { textTransform: 'uppercase' },
                })}
                {text('phone', 'Contact Number', { placeholder: 'Optional', inputMode: 'tel' })}
              </div>

              <h3>Shipping Address</h3>
              <button type="button" className="iee-add-btn" onClick={copyBillToShipping}>
                Copy billing address to shipping
              </button>
              {text('shippingName', 'Ship To Name')}
              {area('shippingAddress', 'Shipping Address', 3)}
              <small className="invoice-number-hint">Leave both blank to print the Bill To details as the shipping address.</small>

              <h3>Items</h3>
              {form.items.map((item, index) => (
                <div className="iee-item" key={index}>
                  <div className="iee-item-head">
                    <b>Item {index + 1}</b>
                    <button type="button" className="iee-icon-btn" onClick={() => removeItem(index)} disabled={form.items.length === 1} title="Remove item">
                      <FiTrash2 size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <textarea rows={2} placeholder="Description" value={item.description} onChange={(e) => setItem(index, 'description', e.target.value)} />
                  <div className="iee-row3">
                    <label><span>Qty</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={item.quantity} onChange={(e) => setItem(index, 'quantity', e.target.value)} /></label>
                    <label><span>Rate (₹)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={item.rate} onChange={(e) => setItem(index, 'rate', e.target.value)} /></label>
                    <label><span>Amount</span><input readOnly value={money(num(item.quantity) * num(item.rate))} /></label>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button type="button" className="iee-add-btn" onClick={addItem}><FiPlus size={14} /> Add item</button>

              <h3>Amounts</h3>
              <div className="iee-row3">
                <label><span>Discount (₹)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={form.discountAmount} onChange={set('discountAmount')} /></label>
                <label><span>Tax rate (%)</span><input type="number" min="0" max="100" step="any" value={form.taxRate} onChange={set('taxRate')} /></label>
                <label><span>Paid (₹)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" value={form.amountPaid} onChange={set('amountPaid')} /></label>
              </div>
              <div className="iee-readonly">
                <div><span>Subtotal</span><b>₹{money(totals.subtotal)}</b></div>
                <div><span>Tax</span><b>₹{money(totals.tax)}</b></div>
                <div><span>Total</span><b>₹{money(totals.grand)}</b></div>
                <div><span>Balance due</span><b>₹{money(totals.balance)}</b></div>
                <small>These amounts are for this invoice only. Payment records are not changed.</small>
              </div>

              <h3>Payment Instructions</h3>
              <div className="iee-row">
                {text('bankName', 'Bank Name')}
                {text('bankBranch', 'Branch Name')}
              </div>
              <div className="iee-row">
                {text('bankIfsc', 'IFSC Code')}
                {text('bankAccountNo', 'Account No')}
              </div>

              <h3>Declaration &amp; Signature</h3>
              {area('declaration', 'Declaration text', 3)}
              {text('signatoryFor', '"For ..." line')}
              <div className="iee-row">
                {text('signatoryName', 'Signatory Name')}
                {text('signatoryTitle', 'Designation')}
              </div>

              {notice && <div className={`iee-notice ${notice.type}`}>{notice.text}</div>}
            </aside>

            <main className="invoice-editor-preview" ref={previewRef}>
              <div
                className="invoice-editor-preview-scale"
                style={{
                  '--preview-scale': previewScale,
                  '--preview-width': `${1024 * previewScale}px`,
                  '--preview-height': `${1518 * previewScale}px`,
                }}
              >
                <InvoiceTemplate

                  thankYouDataUrl={assets.thankYouDataUrl}
                />
              </div>

        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React from 'react';
import './InvoiceTemplate.css';
import { INVOICE_DEFAULTS } from './InvoiceDefaults';

const money = (value) =>
  Number(value || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });

const split = (value) =>
  String(value || '')
    .split(/\n|,/)
    .map((item) => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return '—';

  const parsedDate = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(parsedDate.getTime())) {
    return String(value);
  }

  return parsedDate
    .toLocaleDateString('en-GB')
    .replace(/\//g, '-');
};

const amountInWords = (value) => {
  const number = Math.round(Number(value || 0));

  if (!number) {
    return 'Zero only';
  }

  const ones = [
    '',
    'One',
    'Two',
    'Three',
    'Four',
    'Five',
    'Six',
    'Seven',
    'Eight',
    'Nine',
    'Ten',
    'Eleven',
    'Twelve',
    'Thirteen',
    'Fourteen',
    'Fifteen',
    'Sixteen',
    'Seventeen',
    'Eighteen',
    'Nineteen',
  ];

  const tens = [
    '',
    '',
    'Twenty',
    'Thirty',
    'Forty',
    'Fifty',
    'Sixty',
    'Seventy',
    'Eighty',
    'Ninety',
  ];

  const convert = (amount) => {
    if (amount < 20) {
      return ones[amount];
    }

    if (amount < 100) {
      return (
        tens[Math.floor(amount / 10)] +
        (amount % 10 ? ` ${ones[amount % 10]}` : '')
      );
    }

    return (
      `${ones[Math.floor(amount / 100)]} Hundred` +
      (amount % 100 ? ` and ${convert(amount % 100)}` : '')
    );
  };

  let remaining = number;
  const parts = [];

  if (remaining >= 10000000) {
    parts.push(
      `${convert(Math.floor(remaining / 10000000))} Crore`
    );
    remaining %= 10000000;
  }

  if (remaining >= 100000) {
    parts.push(
      `${convert(Math.floor(remaining / 100000))} Lakh`
    );
    remaining %= 100000;
  }

  if (remaining >= 1000) {
    parts.push(
      `${convert(Math.floor(remaining / 1000))} Thousand`
    );
    remaining %= 1000;
  }

  if (remaining > 0) {
    parts.push(convert(remaining));
  }

  return `${parts.join(' ')} only`;
};

export default function InvoiceTemplate({
  invoice = {},
  qrDataUrl,
  logoDataUrl,
  signatureDataUrl,
  thankYouDataUrl,
}) {
  const payment = invoice || {};

  // Every text on the invoice is editable; missing values fall back to the defaults.
  const txt = (key) =>
    payment[key] !== undefined && payment[key] !== null
      ? String(payment[key])
      : INVOICE_DEFAULTS[key] || '';

  const lines = (value) =>
    String(value || '')
      .split(/\n/)
      .map((item) => item.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

  // ----- items -----
  const rawItems =
    Array.isArray(payment.items) && payment.items.length
      ? payment.items
      : [
          {
            description:
              payment.description ||
              `${payment.paymentType || 'Service'} charges`,
            quantity: 1,
            rate: Number(payment.totalAmount || 0),
          },
        ];

  const items = rawItems.map((item) => {
    const quantity = Number(item.quantity ?? 1);
    const rate = Number(item.rate ?? 0);
    return {
      description: item.description || '',
      quantity,
      rate,
      amount: quantity * rate,
    };
  });

  // ----- totals -----
  const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
  const discount = Number(payment.discountAmount || 0);
  const rate = Number(payment.taxRate ?? 18); // default GST 18% (editable per invoice)
  const taxable = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);
  const tax = (taxable * rate) / 100;
  const grandTotal = taxable + tax;
  const paid = Number(payment.amountPaid || 0);
  const balance = Math.max(0, grandTotal - paid);

  const billName = payment.organizationName || '';
  const billAddress = split(payment.address);
  const shipName = txt('shippingName').trim() || billName;
  const shipAddress = txt('shippingAddress').trim()
    ? split(txt('shippingAddress'))
    : billAddress;

  const invoiceNumber = payment.invoiceNumber || '—';
  const invoiceDate = payment.invoiceDate || payment.paymentDate;
  const paymentStatus =
    payment.paymentStatus || (balance <= 0 ? 'Paid' : 'Partial Paid');

  const companyAddress = split(txt('companyAddress'));

  return (
    <div className="invoice-print-root">
      <article className="invoice-sheet">
        <header className="invoice-title-bar">INVOICE</header>

        {/* COMPANY HEADER */}
        <section className="invoice-company">
          <div className="invoice-company-copy">
            <h1>{txt('companyName')}</h1>

            {companyAddress.length > 0 && (
              <div className="company-row">
                <span>●</span>
                <div>
                  {companyAddress.map((line, index) => (
                    <React.Fragment key={index}>
                      {line}
                      {index < companyAddress.length - 1 && <br />}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {txt('companyEmail') && (
              <div className="company-row">
                <span>✉</span>
                <div>Email Address: {txt('companyEmail')}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            {txt('companyMobile') && (
              <div className="company-row">
                <span>⌕</span>
                <div>Mobile: {txt('companyMobile')}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            {txt('companyWebsite') && (
              <div className="company-row">
                <span>◎</span>
                <div>Website: {txt('companyWebsite')}</div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="invoice-brand">
            {logoDataUrl ? (
              <img src={logoDataUrl} alt="Company logo" />
            ) : (
              <div className="logo-fallback">
                <b>▥</b>
                <span>IC</span>
                <b>♧</b>
                <strong>INDO</strong>
                <em>CAMPAS</em>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        <div className="invoice-rule" />

        {/* BILLING DETAILS */}
        <section className="invoice-address-grid">
          <div>
            <h3>BILL TO</h3>
            <b>{billName || '—'}</b>
            {billAddress.map((item, index) => (
              <p key={index}>{item}</p>
            ))}
            {payment.phone && <p>Contact: {payment.phone}</p>}
            {payment.customerGstin && <p>GSTIN: {payment.customerGstin}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <h3>SHIPPING ADDRESS</h3>
            <b>{shipName || '—'}</b>
            {shipAddress.map((item, index) => (

import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import html2canvas from 'html2canvas';
import { jsPDF } from 'jspdf';
import InvoiceTemplate from './InvoiceTemplate';

// local fallbacks, used only when the Super Admin has not uploaded these images yet
import fallbackLogo from '../../assets/invoice/indo-logo.jpg';
import fallbackSignature from '../../assets/invoice/authorized-signature.png';
import fallbackThankYou from '../../assets/invoice/thank-you-paid.png';

const nextPaint = () =>
  new Promise((resolve) =>
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve))
  );

const waitForImages = async (container) => {
  const images = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('img'));
  await Promise.all(images.map((img) => {
    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const done = () => resolve();
      img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true });
      img.addEventListener('error', done, { once: true });
    });
  }));
};

/**
 * Renders the exact React invoice DOM and downloads it as a single A4 PDF.
 * The browser print dialog is not used, so clicking Save / Print PDF produces
 * a real .pdf file immediately.
 */
export async function printInvoicePdf(
  invoice,
  { qrDataUrl, logoDataUrl, signatureDataUrl, thankYouDataUrl } = {}
) {
  logoDataUrl = logoDataUrl || fallbackLogo;
  signatureDataUrl = signatureDataUrl || fallbackSignature;
  thankYouDataUrl = thankYouDataUrl || fallbackThankYou;

  const mount = document.createElement('div');
  mount.className = 'invoice-pdf-mode';
  mount.style.position = 'fixed';
  mount.style.left = '-20000px';
  mount.style.top = '0';
  mount.style.width = '794px';
  mount.style.background = '#ffffff';
  mount.style.zIndex = '-1';
  document.body.appendChild(mount);

  const root = createRoot(mount);

  try {
    root.render(
      React.createElement(InvoiceTemplate, {
        invoice,
        qrDataUrl,
        logoDataUrl,
        signatureDataUrl,
        thankYouDataUrl,
      })
    );

    await nextPaint();
    await waitForImages(mount);
    await nextPaint();

    const sheet = mount.querySelector('.invoice-sheet');
    if (!sheet) throw new Error('Invoice template could not be rendered.');

    const canvas = await html2canvas(sheet, {
      scale: 2,
      useCORS: true,
      allowTaint: true,
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      logging: false,
      windowWidth: 794,
    });

    const pdf = new jsPDF({
      orientation: 'portrait',
      unit: 'mm',
      format: 'a4',
      compress: true,
    });

    const pageWidth = 210;
    const pageHeight = 297;
    const imageData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    const imageRatio = canvas.width / canvas.height;

    let renderWidth = pageWidth;
    let renderHeight = renderWidth / imageRatio;
    if (renderHeight > pageHeight) {
      renderHeight = pageHeight;
      renderWidth = renderHeight * imageRatio;
    }

    const x = (pageWidth - renderWidth) / 2;
    const y = (pageHeight - renderHeight) / 2;
    pdf.addImage(imageData, 'PNG', x, y, renderWidth, renderHeight, undefined, 'FAST');

    const rawNumber =
      invoice?.editedInvoiceNumber ||
      invoice?.invoiceNumber ||
      invoice?.invoiceNo ||
      invoice?.invoiceRecord?.invoiceNumber ||
      'invoice';

    const safeNumber = String(rawNumber).replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/gi, '-');
    pdf.save(`${safeNumber}.pdf`);
  } finally {
    root.unmount();
    mount.remove();
  }
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  FiBell,
  FiCheck,
  FiCheckCircle,
  FiMenu,
  FiShield,
  FiX
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import './Navbar.css';
import notificationService from '../../services/notificationService';

const Navbar = ({ toggleSidebar }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({
    fullName: '',
    username: '',
    role: ''
  });

  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [showNotifications, setShowNotifications] = useState(false);

  const loadUser = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const raw =
        localStorage.getItem('user') ||
        localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||
        localStorage.getItem('authUser');

      if (raw) {
        const u = JSON.parse(raw);

        setUser({
          fullName: u.fullName || u.name || u.username || '',
          username: u.username || '',
          role: u.role || ''
        });
      } else {
        setUser({
          fullName:
            localStorage.getItem('fullName') ||
            localStorage.getItem('name') ||
            localStorage.getItem('username') ||
            '',
          username: localStorage.getItem('username') || '',
          role: localStorage.getItem('role') || ''
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Unable to load logged-in user', e);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await notificationService.getNotifications();
      setNotifications(data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load notifications', e);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUser();
    loadNotifications();

    const interval = setInterval(loadNotifications, 30000);

    const refresh = () => {
      loadUser();
      loadNotifications();
    };

    window.addEventListener('auth-changed', refresh);
    window.addEventListener('storage', refresh);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener('auth-changed', refresh);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', refresh);
    };
  }, [loadUser, loadNotifications]);

  const initials = (user.fullName || user.username || 'User')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map(x => x[0])
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();

  const roleLabel = (user.role || '')
    .replace('ROLE_', '')
    .replaceAll('_', ' ')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\b\w/g, x => x.toUpperCase());

  const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;

  const markRead = async (n) => {
    if (n.read) return;

    try {
      await notificationService.markAsRead(n.id);

      setNotifications(prev =>
        prev.map(x =>
          x.id === n.id
            ? { ...x, read: true }
            : x
        )
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const markAll = async () => {
    try {
      await notificationService.markAllAsRead();

      setNotifications(prev =>
        prev.map(x => ({
          ...x,
          read: true
        }))
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="navbar">

      <button
        className="menu-btn"
        onClick={toggleSidebar}
      >
        <FiMenu />
      </button>

      <div className="navbar-right">

        {/* Notification */}
        <div className="notification-wrapper">

          <button
            className="nav-btn notification-btn"
            onClick={() =>
              setShowNotifications(prev => !prev)
            }
            aria-label="Notifications"
          >
            <FiBell />

            {unread > 0 && (
              <span className="notification-badge">
                {unread > 99 ? '99+' : unread}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          {showNotifications && (
            <div className="notification-dropdown">

              {/* Header */}
              <div className="notification-header">

                <div className="notification-title">
                  <h3>Notifications</h3>
                  <span>{unread} unread</span>
                </div>

                <div className="notification-actions">

                  {unread > 0 && (
                    <button
                      className="mark-all-btn"
                      onClick={markAll}
                    >
                      <FiCheck />
                      Mark all read
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {/* X / Close */}
                  <button
                    className="notification-close-btn"
                    onClick={() => setShowNotifications(false)}
                    aria-label="Close notifications"
                    title="Close"
                  >
                    <FiX />
                  </button>

                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Notification List */}
              <div className="notification-list">

                {notifications.length === 0 ? (

                  <div className="notification-empty">
                    <FiCheckCircle />
                    <span>No notifications</span>
                  </div>

                ) : (

                  notifications.map(n => (

                    <button
                      key={n.id}
                      className={`notification-item ${
                        n.read ? 'read' : 'unread'
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => markRead(n)}
                    >

                      <div className="notification-icon">
                        <FiBell />
                      </div>

                      <div className="notification-content">

                        <strong>{n.title}</strong>

                        <p>{n.message}</p>

                        <small>
                          {n.createdAt
                            ? new Date(
                                n.createdAt
                              ).toLocaleString()
                            : ''}
                        </small>

                      </div>

                      {!n.read && (
                        <span className="unread-dot" />
                      )}

                    </button>

                  ))

                )}

              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

       

        {/* User */}
        <div className="user-avatar">

          <div className="avatar-circle">
            {initials}
          </div>

          <div className="user-info">

            <span className="user-name">
              {user.fullName || user.username || 'User'}
            </span>

            <span className="user-role">
              {roleLabel}
            </span>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </header>
  );
};

export default Navbar;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './Sidebar.css';

  //{ icon: <FiClock />, label: "Attendance", id: "attendance" },
  { icon: <FiClipboard />, label: "Leave & Permissions", id: "leavepermissions" },
  { icon: <FiMessageSquare />, label: "Communications", id: "communications" },
 // { 
   // icon: <FiSettings />, 
  //  label: "Settings", 
  //  id: "settings",
   // isParent: true,
   // subItems: settingsSubItems
 // },
  //{ icon: <FiHelpCircle />, label: "Help & Support", id: "help" },
];

const Sidebar = ({ activePage, onNavigate, collapsed }) => {
  const [expandedMenus, setExpandedMenus] = useState({});

  // Find the settings menu item
  const settingsItem = navItems.find(item => item.isParent);

  // Auto-expand settings if a sub-item is active or if we're on the settings page
  useEffect(() => {
    if (settingsItem) {
      const isSubActive = settingsItem.subItems?.some(sub => activePage === sub.id);
      const isSettingsPage = activePage === 'settings';
      
      // If a sub-item is active or we're on the settings page, expand the settings menu
      if (isSubActive || isSettingsPage) {
        setExpandedMenus(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [settingsItem.id]: true
        }));
      }
    }
  }, [activePage, settingsItem]);

  // Toggle sub-menu expansion
  const toggleSubMenu = (menuId) => {
    if (collapsed) return;
    setExpandedMenus(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [menuId]: !prev[menuId]
    }));
  };

  // Check if a sub-item is active
  const isSubItemActive = (subItemId) => {
    return activePage === subItemId;
  };

  // Check if any sub-item of a menu is active
  const isMenuActive = (menu) => {
    if (activePage === menu.id) return true;
    if (menu.subItems) {
      return menu.subItems.some(sub => activePage === sub.id);
    }
    return false;
  };

  // Check if menu has sub-items
  const hasSubItems = (item) => {
    return item.subItems && item.subItems.length > 0;
  };

  // Handle navigation
  const handleNavigate = (id, e) => {
    if (id === "logout") {
      onNavigate(id);
      return;
    }
    onNavigate(id);
  };

  // Handle parent menu click - just toggle, don't navigate
  const handleParentClick = (item) => {
    if (hasSubItems(item)) {
      toggleSubMenu(item.id);
    } else {
      handleNavigate(item.id);
    }
  };

  return (
    <aside className={`sidebar ${collapsed ? "collapsed" : ""}`}>
      <div className="sidebar-logo">
        <img
          src={logo}
          alt="INDOCRM Logo"
          className="logo-image"
        />
        {!collapsed && (
          <span className="logo-text">INDOCRM</span>
        )}
      </div>
      
      <nav className="sidebar-nav">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const isActive = isMenuActive(item);
          const isExpanded = expandedMenus[item.id];
          const hasChildren = hasSubItems(item);

          // When collapsed, only show icons
          if (collapsed) {
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                className={`nav-item ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => handleNavigate(item.id)}
                title={item.label}
              >
                <span className="nav-icon">{item.icon}</span>
              </button>
            );
          }

          return (
            <div key={item.id} className="nav-item-wrapper">
              {/* Parent Menu Item */}
              <button
                className={`nav-item ${isActive ? "active" : ""} ${hasChildren ? "has-submenu" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => handleParentClick(item)}
              >
                <span className="nav-icon">{item.icon}</span>
                <span className="nav-label">{item.label}</span>
                {hasChildren && (
                  <span className="nav-chevron">
                    {isExpanded ? <FiChevronDown /> : <FiChevronRight />}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>

              {/* Sub Menu Items */}
              {hasChildren && isExpanded && (
                <div className="sub-menu-container">
                  {item.subItems.map((subItem) => {
                    const isSubActive = isSubItemActive(subItem.id);
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={subItem.id}
                        className={`nav-item sub-nav-item ${isSubActive ? "active" : ""}`}
                        onClick={() => handleNavigate(subItem.id)}
                      >
                        <span className="nav-icon sub-icon">{subItem.icon}</span>
                        <span className="nav-label">{subItem.label}</span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* Logout button placed at the bottom */}
      <div className="sidebar-footer">
        <button
          className={`nav-item ${activePage === "logout" ? "active" : ""}`}
          onClick={() => onNavigate("logout")}
        >
          <span className="nav-icon"><FiLogOut /></span>
          {!collapsed && (
            <span className="nav-label">Logout</span>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

          // Update the call data
          const updatedCalls = callData.map(item => {
            if (item.name === call.name && item.mobile === call.mobile) {
              return {
                ...item,
                name: newName,
                mobile: newMobile,
                status: newStatus
              };
            }
            return item;
          });
          setCallData(updatedCalls);
          alert('Call details updated successfully!');
        }
      }
    }
  };

  // Handle View All button click
  const handleViewAll = () => {
    // Navigate to calls page or show all calls
    alert('Navigating to all calls page...');
    // You can use react-router-dom: navigate('/calls')
    console.log('View all calls clicked');
  };

  return (
    <div className="recent-calls">
      <table className="calls-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Name</th>
            <th>Mobile</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Duration</th>
            <th>Time</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {callData.map((call, index) => (
            <tr key={index}>
              <td className="call-name">{call.name}</td>
              <td className="call-mobile">{call.mobile}</td>
              <td><span className={`status-badge ${statusClass[call.status] || ''}`}>{call.status}</span></td>
              <td>{call.duration}</td>
              <td>{call.time}</td>
              <td>
                
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div className="view-all">
        <button className="view-all-btn" onClick={handleViewAll}>
          View All
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RecentCalls;

// CRM-APP (TELECALLERS)/src/context/AuthContext.jsx

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
// ✅ Change this import
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import attendanceService from '../services/attendanceService';  // ← Changed from leadService

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('user');
    
    if (token && savedUser) {
      try {
        const userData = JSON.parse(savedUser);
        authService.validateToken()
          .then(() => {
            setUser(userData);
          })
          .catch(() => {
            localStorage.removeItem('token');
            localStorage.removeItem('user');
            setUser(null);
          })
          .finally(() => {
            setLoading(false);
          });
      } catch (e) {
        localStorage.removeItem('token');
        localStorage.removeItem('user');
        setUser(null);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    let alive = true;
    const sendHeartbeat = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await attendanceService.heartbeat();
        if (alive) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendance:update', { detail: result }));
      } catch (_) {}
    };
    sendHeartbeat();
    const timer = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, 20000);
    const handleOnline = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await attendanceService.reconnect(`${navigator.userAgent}`);
        if (alive) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendance:update', { detail: result }));
      } catch (_) {}
    };
    const handleOffline = () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendance:offline'));
    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(timer); window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline); window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline); };
  }, [user]);

  const login = async (username, password) => {
    try {
      const response = await authService.login(username, password);
      localStorage.setItem('token', response.token);
      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({
        username: response.username,
        fullName: response.fullName,
        role: response.role,
        districts: response.districts || []
      }));
      setUser({
        username: response.username,
        fullName: response.fullName,
        role: response.role,
        districts: response.districts || []
      });
      try { const attendance = await attendanceService.today(); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendance:update', { detail: attendance })); } catch (_) {}
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    try { await attendanceService.logout(); } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await authService.logout();
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore errors during logout
    }
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    setUser(null);
  };

  const register = async (userData) => {
    try {
      await authService.register(userData);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  const value = {
    user,
    loading,
    login,
    logout,
    register,
    isAuthenticated: !!user,
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

// src/context/WebSocketContext.jsx

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useRef,
  useCallback
} from 'react';

import { Client } from '@stomp/stompjs';
import SockJS from 'sockjs-client';
import { useAuth } from './AuthContext';

const WebSocketContext = createContext(null);

export const useWebSocket = () => {
  const context = useContext(WebSocketContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useWebSocket must be used within a WebSocketProvider'
    );
  }

  return context;
};

export const WebSocketProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);

  const [bridgeDeviceId, setBridgeDeviceId] = useState(() => {
    return (
      localStorage.getItem('bridgeDeviceId') ||
      'bridge_1784353031921'
    );
  });

  const [bridgeConnected, setBridgeConnected] = useState(false);
  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState(null);

  const stompClientRef = useRef(null);
  const subscriptionsRef = useRef(new Map());
  const reconnectAttempts = useRef(0);

  const maxReconnectAttempts = 10;

  /*
   * IMPORTANT:
   *
   * Do NOT use:
   *
   * https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/ws
   *
   * here.
   *
   * Using /ws makes the browser connect to:
   *
   * http://localhost:5174/ws
   *
   * and Vite proxies it to:
   *
   * https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/ws
   *
   */

  const getWsUrl = useCallback(() => {
    return '/ws';
  }, []);

  /*
   * Setup subscriptions
   */
  const setupSubscriptions = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      !stompClientRef.current ||
      !stompClientRef.current.connected
    ) {
      console.warn(
        'Cannot setup subscriptions: WebSocket not connected'
      );

      return;
    }

    /*
     * Remove previous automatic subscriptions
     * before creating new ones.
     */
    subscriptionsRef.current.forEach((subscription, id) => {
      try {
        subscription.unsubscribe();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Error removing subscription ${id}:`,
          error
        );
      }
    });

    subscriptionsRef.current.clear();

    const destinations = [
      '/topic/call-status',
      '/topic/call-requests',
      '/topic/call',
      `/topic/call/${bridgeDeviceId}`,
      '/user/queue/call',
      user?.username ? `/topic/attendance/${user.username}` : null
    ];

    destinations.filter(Boolean).forEach((destination) => {
      const subId = `sub-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()
        .toString(36)
        .substring(2, 7)}`;

      try {
        const subscription =
          stompClientRef.current.subscribe(
            destination,
            (message) => {
              try {
                const data = JSON.parse(message.body);

                console.log(
                  `📨 Received on ${destination}:`,
                  data
                );

                if (destination.startsWith('/topic/attendance/')) {
                  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendance:update', { detail: data }));
                  return;
                }

                /*
                 * Handle call status updates
                 */
                if (
                  destination === '/topic/call-status' ||
                  destination ===
                    `/topic/call/${bridgeDeviceId}`
                ) {
                  if (
                    data.status ||
                    data.callStatus ||
                    data.state
                  ) {
                    window.dispatchEvent(
                      new CustomEvent(
                        'bridgeCallStatus',
                        {
                          detail: data
                        }
                      )
                    );
                  }
                }
              } catch (error) {
                /*
                 * Message is not JSON.
                 */
                console.log(
                  `📨 Raw message on ${destination}:`,
                  message.body
                );
              }
            }
          );

        subscriptionsRef.current.set(
          subId,
          subscription
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Failed to subscribe to ${destination}:`,
          error
        );
      }
    });

    console.log('✅ Subscriptions setup complete');
  }, [bridgeDeviceId, user?.username]);

  /*
   * Register Android bridge device
   */
  const registerDevice = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      !stompClientRef.current ||
      !stompClientRef.current.connected
    ) {
      console.warn(
        'Cannot register device: WebSocket not connected'
      );

      return;
    }

    if (!user) {
      console.warn(
        'Cannot register device: No user'
      );

      return;
    }

    const deviceId = bridgeDeviceId;

    const registerMsg = {
      deviceId: deviceId,
      username: user.username || 'admin',
      deviceType: 'android_bridge'
    };

    console.log(
      '📱 Registering device:',
      registerMsg
    );

    try {
      stompClientRef.current.publish({
        destination: '/app/bridge/register',
        body: JSON.stringify(registerMsg)
      });

      /*
       * Registration response subscription
       */
      const subId = `register-${Date.now()}`;

      /*
       * Remove previous registration subscription
       * if it exists.
       */
      const existingRegistration =
        subscriptionsRef.current.get(
          'bridge-registration'
        );

      if (existingRegistration) {
        try {
          existingRegistration.unsubscribe();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            'Error removing old registration subscription:',
            error
          );
        }

        subscriptionsRef.current.delete(
          'bridge-registration'
        );
      }

      const subscription =
        stompClientRef.current.subscribe(
          `/user/${deviceId}/queue/register`,
          (message) => {
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(
                message.body
              );

              console.log(
                '✅ Device registration response:',
                data
              );

              if (data.status === 'success') {
                setBridgeConnected(true);

                localStorage.setItem(
                  'bridgeDeviceId',
                  deviceId
                );
              }
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(
                'Error parsing registration response:',
                error
              );
            }
          }
        );

      subscriptionsRef.current.set(
        'bridge-registration',
        subscription
      );

      console.log(
        '📱 Registration message sent successfully'
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Error registering device:',
        error
      );
    }
  }, [user, bridgeDeviceId]);

  /*
   * Connect to STOMP WebSocket
   */
  const connect = useCallback(() => {
    /*
     * Don't create another connection if one already exists.
     */
    if (
      stompClientRef.current &&
      (
        stompClientRef.current.active ||
        stompClientRef.current.connected
      )
    ) {
      console.log(
        'WebSocket connection already active'
      );

      return;
    }

    const wsUrl = getWsUrl();

    console.log(
      '🔌 Connecting to WebSocket:',
      wsUrl
    );

    /*
     * Reset connection state
     */
    setConnectionError(null);

    const stompClient = new Client({
      /*
       * IMPORTANT:
       *
       * This is now /ws.
       *
       * Vite proxy will forward:
       *
       * /ws
       *
       * to:
       *
       * https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/ws
       */
      webSocketFactory: () => {
        console.log(
          '🔌 Creating SockJS connection:',
          wsUrl
        );

        return new SockJS(wsUrl);
      },

      /*
       * STOMP debug logs
       */
      debug: (message) => {
        if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
          console.debug(
            'STOMP:',
            message
          );
        }
      },

      /*
       * Automatic reconnect
       */
      reconnectDelay: 5000,

      /*
       * Heartbeat
       */
      heartbeatIncoming: 4000,
      heartbeatOutgoing: 4000,

      /*
       * Successful connection
       */
      onConnect: () => {
        console.log(
          '✅ WebSocket connected'
        );

        setIsConnected(true);
        setConnectionError(null);

        reconnectAttempts.current = 0;

        /*
         * Register device
         */
        if (user) {
          registerDevice();
        }

        /*
         * Setup application subscriptions
         */
        setupSubscriptions();
      },

      /*
       * Disconnect
       */
      onDisconnect: () => {
        console.log(
          '❌ WebSocket disconnected'
        );

        setIsConnected(false);
        setBridgeConnected(false);
      },

      /*
       * STOMP error
       */
      onStompError: (frame) => {
        console.error(
          'STOMP error:',
          frame
        );

        const errorMessage =
          frame?.headers?.message ||
          'STOMP error';

        setConnectionError(
          errorMessage
        );

        setIsConnected(false);
      },

      /*
       * WebSocket error
       */
      onWebSocketError: (error) => {
        console.error(
          'WebSocket error:',
          error
        );

        setConnectionError(
          'WebSocket connection error'
        );

        setIsConnected(false);
      },

      /*
       * WebSocket close
       */
      onWebSocketClose: (event) => {
        console.log(
          '🔌 WebSocket closed:',
          event
        );

        setIsConnected(false);
        setBridgeConnected(false);
      }
    });

    /*
     * Save STOMP client
     */
    stompClientRef.current =
      stompClient;

    /*
     * Activate connection
     */
    stompClient.activate();

    /*
     * Cleanup function
     */
    return () => {
      console.log(
        '🧹 Cleaning up WebSocket connection'
      );

      /*
       * Unsubscribe everything
       */
      subscriptionsRef.current.forEach(
        (subscription, id) => {
          try {
            subscription.unsubscribe();
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(
              `Error unsubscribing ${id}:`,
              error
            );
          }
        }
      );

      subscriptionsRef.current.clear();

      /*
       * Deactivate STOMP client
       */
      if (stompClient) {
        try {
          stompClient.deactivate();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            'Error deactivating STOMP:',
            error
          );
        }
      }

      if (
        stompClientRef.current ===
        stompClient
      ) {
        stompClientRef.current = null;
      }

      setIsConnected(false);
      setBridgeConnected(false);
    };
  }, [
    getWsUrl,
    user,
    registerDevice,
    setupSubscriptions
  ]);

  /*
   * Subscribe to a topic
   */
  const subscribe = useCallback(
    (destination, callback, id) => {
      if (
        !stompClientRef.current ||
        !stompClientRef.current.connected
      ) {
        console.warn(
          'Cannot subscribe: WebSocket not connected'
        );

        return null;
      }

      const subId =
        id ||
        `sub-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .substring(2, 7)}`;

      /*
       * Remove existing subscription with
       * same ID.
       */
      const existing =
        subscriptionsRef.current.get(
          subId
        );

      if (existing) {
        try {
          existing.unsubscribe();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            'Error removing existing subscription:',
            error
          );
        }

        subscriptionsRef.current.delete(
          subId
        );
      }

      try {
        const subscription =
          stompClientRef.current.subscribe(
            destination,
            (message) => {
              try {
                const data =
                  JSON.parse(
                    message.body
                  );

                callback(data);
              } catch (error) {
                /*
                 * If message isn't JSON,
                 * return raw body.
                 */
                callback(
                  message.body
                );
              }
            }
          );

        subscriptionsRef.current.set(
          subId,
          subscription
        );

        console.log(
          '📡 Subscribed:',
          destination
        );

        return subId;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Error subscribing to ${destination}:`,
          error
        );

        return null;
      }
    },
    []
  );

  /*
   * Unsubscribe
   */
  const unsubscribe = useCallback(
    (id) => {
      if (!id) {
        return;
      }

      const subscription =
        subscriptionsRef.current.get(
          id
        );

      if (subscription) {
        try {
          subscription.unsubscribe();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            'Error unsubscribing:',
            error
          );
        }

        subscriptionsRef.current.delete(
          id
        );

        console.log(
          '📡 Unsubscribed:',
          id
        );
      }
    },
    []
  );

  /*
   * Send STOMP message
   */
  const sendMessage = useCallback(
    (destination, body) => {
      if (
        !stompClientRef.current ||
        !stompClientRef.current.connected
      ) {
        console.error(
          'Cannot send message: WebSocket not connected'
        );

        return false;
      }

      try {
        const messageBody =
          typeof body === 'string'
            ? body
            : JSON.stringify(body);

        stompClientRef.current.publish({
          destination: destination,
          body: messageBody
        });

        console.log(
          '📤 Message sent:',
          destination
        );

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'Error sending message:',
          error
        );

        return false;
      }
    },
    []
  );

  /*
   * Send bridge call request
   */
  const sendBridgeCallRequest =
    useCallback((request) => {
      if (
        !stompClientRef.current ||
        !stompClientRef.current.connected
      ) {
        console.error(
          'Cannot send call request: WebSocket not connected'
        );

        return false;
      }

      try {
        const message = {
          type: 'bridge_call',
          data: request
        };

        stompClientRef.current.publish({
          destination:
            '/app/bridge/call',
          body: JSON.stringify(
            message
          )
        });

        console.log(
          '📤 Sent bridge call request:',
          request
        );

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'Error sending call request:',
          error
        );

        return false;
      }
    }, []);

  /*
   * Send bridge status
   */
  const sendBridgeStatus =
    useCallback((status) => {
      if (
        !stompClientRef.current ||
        !stompClientRef.current.connected
      ) {
        console.error(
          'Cannot send status: WebSocket not connected'
        );

        return false;
      }

      try {
        const message = {
          type: 'call_status',
          data: status
        };

        stompClientRef.current.publish({
          destination:
            '/app/bridge/status',
          body: JSON.stringify(
            message
          )
        });

        console.log(
          '📤 Sent bridge status:',
          status
        );

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'Error sending status:',
          error
        );

        return false;
      }
    }, []);

  /*
   * Connect on mount
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanup = connect();

    return () => {
      if (cleanup) {
        cleanup();
      }
    };
  }, [connect]);

  /*
   * Re-register device when user changes
   * and WebSocket is connected.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && isConnected) {
      registerDevice();
    }
  }, [
    user,
    isConnected,
    registerDevice
  ]);

  /*
   * Reconnect manually
   */
  const reconnect = useCallback(() => {
    console.log(
      '🔄 Manual WebSocket reconnect requested'
    );

    if (stompClientRef.current) {
      try {
        stompClientRef.current.deactivate();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'Error deactivating previous client:',
          error
        );
      }

      stompClientRef.current =
        null;
    }

    setIsConnected(false);
    setBridgeConnected(false);
    setConnectionError(null);

    reconnectAttempts.current = 0;

    setTimeout(() => {
      connect();
    }, 500);
  }, [connect]);

  /*
   * Context value
   */
  const value = {
    isConnected,
    connectionError,

    bridgeDeviceId,
    setBridgeDeviceId,

    bridgeConnected,
    setBridgeConnected,

    connect,
    reconnect,

    registerDevice,

    subscribe,
    unsubscribe,

    sendMessage,
    sendBridgeCallRequest,
    sendBridgeStatus
  };

  return (
    <WebSocketContext.Provider
      value={value}
    >
      {children}
    </WebSocketContext.Provider>
  );
};

// Default (original-PDF) content for the 5 agreement categories + the
// doc -> XHTML generator used for the PDF / Super Admin view.
// A "doc" is plain JSON: every text in it is editable in AgreementDocumentEditor.

export const CATEGORIES = [
  { key: 'dm',      label: 'Digital Marketing',  sub: 'Admission platform + Digital Marketing', agreementType: 'DIGITAL_MARKETING' },
  { key: 'admin',   label: 'Admin Dashboard',    sub: 'Admission Dashboard – Rs.8,000 + GST',   agreementType: 'DIGITAL_MARKETING' },
  { key: 'pro',     label: 'Pro',                sub: 'ERP Pro plan & Admin Dashboard',         agreementType: 'ERP' },
