const confidentiality = (n = 7) => [
  H(`${n}. CONFIDENTIALITY`),
  S(`${n}.1 Definition of Confidential Information`),
  P('For the purposes of this Agreement, "Confidential Information" includes all written, electronic, or oral information disclosed by either party to the other, directly or indirectly, that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential. This includes, but is not limited to:'),
  L('Student, staff, and administrative data', 'Financial information and pricing', 'Technical details, web dashboard code, or specifications', 'Business strategies, reports, and internal communications', 'Usernames, passwords, and system access details'),
  S(`${n}.2 Confidentiality Obligations`), P('Each party agrees that:'),
  P('a) It shall maintain the confidentiality of the other party’s Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information (and in no case less than reasonable care).\nb) It shall not disclose any Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the disclosing party.\nc) It shall use Confidential Information solely for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Agreement.'),
  S(`${n}.3 Exceptions`), P('The obligations under this clause shall not apply to information that:'),
  P('a) Is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement;\nb) Is lawfully received from a third party without breach of any obligation of confidentiality;\nc) Is independently developed without reference to the other party\'s Confidential Information;\nd) Is required to be disclosed by law, regulation, or court order, provided that the receiving party gives prompt notice to the disclosing party (if legally permitted) and cooperates in seeking protective measures.'),
  S(`${n}.4 Duration`), P('The confidentiality obligations shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement and remain in effect for a period of three (3) years from the date of termination.'),
  S(`${n}.5 Return or Destruction of Information`), P('Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information of the other party, including all copies in any form, except for archival copies retained for legal or compliance purposes.'),
];

export const defaultDoc = (kind, client = {}) => {
  const d = (DEFAULTS[kind] || DEFAULTS.pro)();
  return {
    __kind: kind, date: today(), ...d,
    clientName: client.clientName || '', clientAddress: client.clientAddress || '',
    providerSign: { name: 'R. Aravinda Raj', designation: 'Chief Executive Officer', date: '' },
    clientSign: { name: client.signName || '', designation: client.signDesignation || '', date: '' },
  };
};

export const parseDoc = (mergeValues, kind) => {
  try {
    const raw = mergeValues && mergeValues.doc;
    if (!raw) return null;
    const d = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    return d && Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? { ...defaultDoc(kind), ...d, __kind: kind } : null;
  } catch { return null; }
};

// ── doc -> XHTML (inline styles only, strict XML safe for openhtmltopdf) ────
const esc = (v = '') => String(v).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
const rich = (v = '') => esc(v).replace(/₹/g, '<span style="font-family:\'DejaVu Sans\'">₹</span>').replace(/\n/g, '<br/>');
const fillAddress = (tpl, doc) => String(tpl || '').replace(/\{\{address\}\}/g, doc.clientAddress || '__________');

export const docToHtml = (doc) => {
  const out = [];
  const T = 'font-family:\'Liberation Serif\',\'Times New Roman\',serif;';
  out.push(`<div id="agr-doc" style="${T}font-size:11pt;color:#111;line-height:1.35;">`);
  if (doc.intro) out.push(`<p style="text-align:center;margin:0 0 8px 0;">${rich(doc.intro)}</p>`);
  out.push(`<p style="margin:6px 0;"><b>${rich(doc.providerText).replace(/^(INDOCAMPAS TECH PRIVATE LIMITED)/, '$1')}</b></p>`);
  out.push('<p style="text-align:center;margin:8px 0;"><b><u>AND</u></b></p>');
  out.push(`<p style="margin:6px 0;"><b>${rich(String(doc.clientName || '').toUpperCase())}</b>${rich(fillAddress(doc.clientTail, doc))}</p>`);
  doc.blocks.forEach((b) => {
    if (b.t === 'h1') out.push(`<h3 style="font-size:12.5pt;margin:14px 0 6px 0;text-transform:none;">${rich(b.text)}</h3>`);
    else if (b.t === 'h2') out.push(`<h4 style="font-size:11pt;margin:9px 0 3px 0;">${rich(b.text)}</h4>`);
    else if (b.t === 'p') out.push(`<p style="margin:3px 0;text-align:justify;">${rich(b.text)}</p>`);
    else if (b.t === 'ul') out.push(`<ul style="margin:3px 0 6px 22px;padding:0;">${(b.items || []).map((i) => `<li style="margin:1px 0;text-align:justify;">${rich(i)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`);
    else if (b.t === 'table') {
      out.push('<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:70%;margin:8px 0;">' + (b.rows || []).map((r, ri) =>
        '<tr>' + r.map((c) => `<td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:4px 8px;${b.head && ri === 0 || ri === b.rows.length - 1 ? 'font-weight:bold;' : ''}">${rich(c)}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>').join('') + '</table>');
    }
  });
  const sign = (title, s) => `<td style="width:48%;vertical-align:top;"><p style="margin:2px 0;"><b>${rich(title)}</b></p><p style="margin:14px 0 2px 0;">Signature: ____________________</p><p style="margin:2px 0;">Name: ${rich(s.name) || '____________________'}</p><p style="margin:2px 0;">Designation: ${rich(s.designation) || '____________________'}</p><p style="margin:2px 0;">Date: ${rich(s.date) || '____________________'}</p></td>`;
  out.push('<h3 style="font-size:12.5pt;margin:16px 0 6px 0;">SIGNATURES</h3>');
  out.push('<p style="margin:3px 0;">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement on the date first written above.</p>');
  out.push(`<table style="width:100%;margin-top:14px;"><tr>${sign('For INDOCAMPAS TECH PRIVATE LIMITED', doc.providerSign || {})}<td style="width:4%;"></td>${sign('For ' + String(doc.clientName || 'THE INSTITUTION').toUpperCase(), doc.clientSign || {})}</tr></table>`);
  out.push('</div>');
  return out.join('');
};

// src/pages/Agreements/AgreementDocumentEditor.jsx
// WYSIWYG editor that looks like the approved IndoCampas agreement PDFs
// (same idea as QuotationDocumentEditor). Every text is editable; clauses,
// bullet points and table rows can be added / removed / moved.
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FiPlus, FiTrash2, FiArrowUp, FiArrowDown, FiPhone, FiGlobe, FiMapPin } from 'react-icons/fi';
import { LOGO_MARK_B64, RIBBON_TOP_B64, RIBBON_BOTTOM_B64 } from './Brandassets';
import agreementBrandingService from '../../services/agreementBrandingService';
import { PAGE_W, PAGE_H, PAD_TOP, PAD_SIDE, pageBackground, usePageFlow, PageOverlays } from './pageFlow';
import './AgreementDocumentEditor.css';

// auto-growing textarea
const TA = ({ value, onChange, className = '', placeholder }) => {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    ref.current.style.height = 'auto';
    ref.current.style.height = `${ref.current.scrollHeight}px`;
  }, [value]);
  return <textarea ref={ref} rows={1} className={`ade-t ${className}`} value={value ?? ''} placeholder={placeholder} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />;
};
const IN = ({ value, onChange, className = '', ...r }) => (
  <input className={`ade-t ade-in ${className}`} value={value ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} {...r} />
);

export default function AgreementDocumentEditor({ doc, setDoc }) {
  // Letterpad / logo / footer uploaded by the Super Admin (Quotations page) - shared with Agreements.
  const [brand, setBrand] = useState(null);
  const bodyRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    agreementBrandingService.get().then((b) => { if (alive) setBrand(b); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, []);
  const pad = brand?.letterpadDataUrl || '';
  const logo = brand?.hasLogo ? brand.logoDataUrl : '';
  const footerPhone = brand?.phone || '8925811993 / 8925811994';
  const footerWeb = brand?.website || 'www.indocampas.com';
  const footerAddress = (brand?.address || 'TIDEL NEO - Thiruchitrambalam\nKoot Road, Tamil Nadu 605111').split('\n');

  const paged = !!(pad || logo);
  const pages = usePageFlow(bodyRef, paged);

  const up = (patch) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, ...patch }));
  const setBlock = (i, patch) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, blocks: d.blocks.map((b, k) => (k === i ? { ...b, ...patch } : b)) }));
  const delBlock = (i) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, blocks: d.blocks.filter((_, k) => k !== i) }));
  const addAfter = (i, block) => setDoc((d) => { const b = [...d.blocks]; b.splice(i + 1, 0, block); return { ...d, blocks: b }; });
  const move = (i, dir) => setDoc((d) => {
    const j = i + dir; if (j < 0 || j >= d.blocks.length) return d;
    const b = [...d.blocks]; [b[i], b[j]] = [b[j], b[i]]; return { ...d, blocks: b };
  });

  const Tools = ({ i }) => (
    <span className="ade-tools">
      <button type="button" title="Move up" onClick={() => move(i, -1)}><FiArrowUp size={12} /></button>
      <button type="button" title="Move down" onClick={() => move(i, 1)}><FiArrowDown size={12} /></button>
      <button type="button" title="Add paragraph below" onClick={() => addAfter(i, { t: 'p', text: '' })}><FiPlus size={12} /></button>
      <button type="button" title="Add heading below" onClick={() => addAfter(i, { t: 'h2', text: '' })}>H</button>
      <button type="button" title="Add bullet list below" onClick={() => addAfter(i, { t: 'ul', items: [''] })}>•</button>
      <button type="button" className="ade-del" title="Remove this block" onClick={() => delBlock(i)}><FiTrash2 size={12} /></button>
    </span>
  );

  const renderBlock = (b, i) => {
    if (b.t === 'h1') return <div className="ade-row" key={i}><TA className="ade-h1" value={b.text} onChange={(v) => setBlock(i, { text: v })} /><Tools i={i} /></div>;
    if (b.t === 'h2') return <div className="ade-row" key={i}><TA className="ade-h2" value={b.text} onChange={(v) => setBlock(i, { text: v })} /><Tools i={i} /></div>;
    if (b.t === 'p') return <div className="ade-row" key={i}><TA className="ade-p" value={b.text} onChange={(v) => setBlock(i, { text: v })} /><Tools i={i} /></div>;
    if (b.t === 'ul') {
      return (
        <div className="ade-row" key={i}>
          <div className="ade-ul">
            {(b.items || []).map((it, k) => (
              <div className="ade-li" key={k}>
                <span className="ade-dot">•</span>
                <TA value={it} onChange={(v) => setBlock(i, { items: b.items.map((x, n) => (n === k ? v : x)) })} />
                <button type="button" className="ade-x" title="Remove point" onClick={() => setBlock(i, { items: b.items.filter((_, n) => n !== k) })}><FiTrash2 size={11} /></button>
              </div>
            ))}
            <button type="button" className="ade-add" onClick={() => setBlock(i, { items: [...(b.items || []), ''] })}><FiPlus size={11} /> Add point</button>
          </div>
          <Tools i={i} />
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (b.t === 'table') {
      return (
        <div className="ade-row" key={i}>
          <div className="ade-table">
            {b.rows.map((r, ri) => (
              <div className="ade-tr" key={ri}>
                {r.map((c, ci) => (
                  <IN key={ci} className={ri === 0 || ri === b.rows.length - 1 ? 'ade-b' : ''} value={c}
                    onChange={(v) => setBlock(i, { rows: b.rows.map((rr, a) => (a === ri ? rr.map((cc, z) => (z === ci ? v : cc)) : rr)) })} />
                ))}
                <button type="button" className="ade-x" onClick={() => setBlock(i, { rows: b.rows.filter((_, a) => a !== ri) })}><FiTrash2 size={11} /></button>
              </div>
            ))}
            <button type="button" className="ade-add" onClick={() => setBlock(i, { rows: [...b.rows.slice(0, -1), ['', ''], b.rows[b.rows.length - 1]] })}><FiPlus size={11} /> Add row</button>
          </div>
          <Tools i={i} />
        </div>
      );
    }
    return null;
  };

  const SignBox = ({ title, k }) => (
    <div className="ade-sign-box">
      <div className="ade-b">{title}</div>
      <div>Signature: ______________</div>
      <div className="ade-inline">Name: <IN value={doc[k]?.name} onChange={(v) => up({ [k]: { ...doc[k], name: v } })} /></div>
      <div className="ade-inline">Designation: <IN value={doc[k]?.designation} onChange={(v) => up({ [k]: { ...doc[k], designation: v } })} /></div>
      <div className="ade-inline">Date: <IN value={doc[k]?.date} onChange={(v) => up({ [k]: { ...doc[k], date: v } })} /></div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="ade-wrap">
  <div className="ade-page"
          style={paged ? { width: PAGE_W, maxWidth: 'none', height: pages * PAGE_H, minHeight: 0, padding: 0, boxSizing: 'border-box', position: 'relative', margin: '0 auto', ...pageBackground(pad) } : undefined}>
        {paged && <PageOverlays pages={pages} logo={logo} footerPhone={footerPhone} footerWeb={footerWeb} footerAddress={footerAddress} />}
        {!pad && !paged && <img className="ade-ribbon-tr" src={RIBBON_TOP_B64} alt="" />}
        {paged ? null : logo ? (
          <div className="ade-head">
            <img src={logo} alt="Company logo" style={{ height: 64, maxWidth: '46%', objectFit: 'contain' }} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="ade-head">

          <IN className="ade-b ade-org" value={doc.clientName} onChange={(v) => up({ clientName: v })} placeholder="SCHOOL / INSTITUTION NAME" />
          <TA value={doc.clientTail} onChange={(v) => up({ clientTail: v })} />
          <div className="ade-inline"><b>Address ({'{{address}}'}):</b> <IN value={doc.clientAddress} onChange={(v) => up({ clientAddress: v })} placeholder="School address" /></div>

// src/pages/Agreements/AgreementFormModal.jsx
// New / Edit Agreement. Works like the Quotation form:
//   1. pick the lead  2. click a category (Digital Marketing / Admin Dashboard /
//   Pro / Pro Plus / Pro Max)  3. the exact agreement opens in the WYSIWYG editor
//   4. edit anything  5. Save as Draft  ->  Submit for Super Admin verification.
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FiX, FiSave, FiDownload } from 'react-icons/fi';
import agreementService from '../../services/agreementService';
import AgreementDocumentEditor from './AgreementDocumentEditor';
import { CATEGORIES, categoryOf, defaultDoc, parseDoc, docToHtml } from './agreementDocs';

const firstNonBlank = (...v) => v.find((x) => x != null && String(x).trim() !== '') ?? '';
const leadKey = (l) => String(l?.leadId ?? l?.id ?? l?._id ?? '');
const leadName = (l) => firstNonBlank(l?.school, l?.schoolName, l?.name, l?.clientName);
const leadAddress = (l) => firstNonBlank(l?.schoolAddress, l?.address, l?.schoolCurrentLocation, l?.area);
const leadPincode = (l) => firstNonBlank(l?.pincode, l?.pinCode, l?.postalCode, l?.zipCode);

export default function AgreementFormModal({ initial, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const isEdit = !!initial && initial !== 'new';
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState([]);
  const [leadId, setLeadId] = useState('');
  const [pincode, setPincode] = useState('');
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('');
  const [doc, setDoc] = useState(null);
  const drafts = useRef({});            // keeps edits when the user switches category and comes back
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');

  const lead = useMemo(() => leads.find((l) => leadKey(l) === String(leadId)), [leads, leadId]);

  const loadLeads = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true); setError('');
      const list = await agreementService.leads();
      setLeads(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Unable to load leads'); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLeads();
    if (isEdit && typeof initial === 'object') {
      const k = initial.mergeValues?.category || 'pro';
      const d = parseDoc(initial.mergeValues, k);
      setLeadId(initial.leadId || ''); setPincode(initial.pincode || '');
      setKind(k);
      if (d) { setDoc(d); drafts.current[k] = d; }
      else setDoc(defaultDoc(k, { clientName: initial.clientName, clientAddress: initial.address }));
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line
  }, []);

  const pickLead = (id) => {
    setLeadId(id);
    const l = leads.find((x) => leadKey(x) === String(id));
    if (!l) return;
    setPincode(leadPincode(l));
    // refresh client details in every open draft
    const patch = { clientName: leadName(l), clientAddress: leadAddress(l) };
    Object.keys(drafts.current).forEach((k) => { drafts.current[k] = { ...drafts.current[k], ...patch }; });
    setDoc((d) => (d ? { ...d, ...patch } : d));
  };

  const pickCategory = (k) => {
    if (doc && kind) drafts.current[kind] = doc;          // stash current edits
    setKind(k); setError(''); setSuccess('');
    setDoc(drafts.current[k] || defaultDoc(k, { clientName: leadName(lead), clientAddress: leadAddress(lead) }));
  };

  const resetToOriginal = () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Ella changes-um pooyidum. Original agreement-ku reset pannalaama?')) return;
    const d = defaultDoc(kind, { clientName: doc.clientName, clientAddress: doc.clientAddress });
    drafts.current[kind] = d; setDoc(d);
  };

  const validate = () => {
    if (!leadId) return 'Please select a lead / client';
    if (!kind || !doc) return 'Please click an agreement category';
    if (!String(doc.clientName || '').trim()) return 'Client / School name is required';
    if (!String(doc.clientAddress || '').trim()) return 'Client / School address is required';
    return '';
  };

  const save = async () => {
    const msg = validate(); if (msg) { setError(msg); return; }
    const cat = categoryOf(kind);
    setLoading(true); setError(''); setSuccess('');
    try {
      const payload = {
        leadId, templateId: `builtin-${kind}`, agreementType: cat.agreementType, serviceType: cat.label,
        title: `${cat.label} Agreement`, pincode, agreementDate: doc.date,
        authorizedPersonName: doc.clientSign?.name || '', authorizedPersonDesignation: doc.clientSign?.designation || '',
        contentHtml: docToHtml(doc),
        mergeValues: { category: kind, client_name: doc.clientName.trim(), client_address: doc.clientAddress.trim(), pincode, doc: JSON.stringify(doc) },
      };
      const res = isEdit ? await agreementService.update(initial.id, payload) : await agreementService.create(payload);
      if (!res?.id) throw new Error('Server returned an invalid response.');
      setSaved(res); setSuccess('Agreement saved as Draft.');
      onSaved?.(res, false);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Unable to save agreement'); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const openPdf = async () => {
    try { window.open(await agreementService.pdfBlobUrl(saved.id), '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'); }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Unable to load PDF'); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="agr-modal-overlay" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !loading) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="agr-modal-box agr-modal-box-wide" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
        <div className="agr-modal-header">
          <span className="agr-modal-title">{isEdit ? 'Edit Agreement' : 'New Agreement'}</span>
          <button type="button" className="agr-close" onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}><FiX /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="agr-modal-body">
          {error && <div className="agr-error" role="alert">{error}{leads.length === 0 && <button type="button" className="agr-btn secondary" style={{ marginLeft: 12 }} onClick={loadLeads}>Retry</button>}</div>}
          {success && <div className="agr-success" role="status">{success}</div>}

          <div className="agr-form-row">
            <div className="agr-form-group"><label>Lead / Client</label>
              <select value={leadId} onChange={(e) => pickLead(e.target.value)} disabled={loading || isEdit}>
                <option value="">Select lead</option>
                {leads.map((l) => <option key={leadKey(l)} value={leadKey(l)}>{leadName(l) || leadKey(l)}</option>)}
              </select></div>
            <div className="agr-form-group"><label>Pincode</label><input value={pincode} onChange={(e) => setPincode(e.target.value)} /></div>
          </div>

          <div className="ade-section-title">Agreement Category (click one)</div>
          <div className="ade-cats">
            {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
              <button type="button" key={c.key} className={`ade-cat ${kind === c.key ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => pickCategory(c.key)} disabled={loading}>
                <strong>{c.label}</strong><small>{c.sub}</small>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {doc && <AgreementDocumentEditor doc={doc} setDoc={setDoc} />}
        </div>
        <div className="agr-modal-footer">
          <button type="button" className="agr-btn secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}><FiX /> Close</button>
          {doc && <button type="button" className="agr-btn secondary" onClick={resetToOriginal} disabled={loading}>Reset to original</button>}
          <button type="button" className="agr-btn primary" onClick={save} disabled={loading || !doc}><FiSave /> {loading ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Agreement'}</button>
          {saved && <button type="button" className="agr-btn secondary" onClick={openPdf}><FiDownload /> PDF</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import './Agreements.css';

import {
  FiPlus,
  FiSearch,
  FiEdit2,
  FiEye,
  FiSend,
  FiX,
  FiMail,
  FiMessageCircle,
  FiAlertCircle,
  FiRefreshCw
} from 'react-icons/fi';

import { agreementService } from '../../services/agreementService';
import AgreementFormModal from './AgreementFormModal';

const fmt = (s) => ({
  PENDING_APPROVAL: 'Pending Verification',
  RESUBMITTED: 'Pending Verification',
  DRAFT: 'Draft',
  APPROVED: 'Approved',
  REJECTED: 'Rejected',
  SENT: 'Sent to Lead'
}[s] || String(s || 'DRAFT').replaceAll('_', ' '));

export default function Agreements() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(null);

  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // LOAD AGREEMENTS AND TEMPLATES
  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    const [aRes, tRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      agreementService.list(),
      agreementService.templates()
    ]);

    if (aRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
      setItems(Array.isArray(aRes.value) ? aRes.value : []);
    }

    if (tRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
      setTemplates(Array.isArray(tRes.value) ? tRes.value : []);
    }

    const failures = [aRes, tRes]
      .filter(r => r.status === 'rejected')
      .map(r => r.reason?.message)
      .filter(Boolean);

    if (failures.length) {
      setError(
        [...new Set(failures)].join(' ') +
        ' — check that the backend server / tunnel is running and reachable, then retry.'
      );
    }

    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  // SUBMIT FOR VERIFICATION
  const submit = async (id) => {
    try {
      const saved = await agreementService.submit(id);

      setItems(prev =>
        prev.map(x => x.id === id ? saved : x)
      );
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || 'Unable to submit agreement');
    }
  };

  // PDF PREVIEW
  const openPdf = async (id) => {
    try {
      const url = await agreementService.pdfBlobUrl(id);

      window.open(
        url,
        '_blank',
        'noopener,noreferrer'
      );
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || 'Unable to load PDF');
    }
  };

  // SEND APPROVED AGREEMENT
  const share = async (a, channel) => {
    try {
      setError('');

      // Validate contact details before marking as sent.
      if (channel === 'Email' && !a.email) {
        setError('This lead has no email address.');
        return;
      }

      if (channel === 'WhatsApp' && !String(a.phone || '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) {
        setError('This lead has no WhatsApp number.');
        return;
      }

      const saved = await agreementService.send(a.id, channel);

      setItems(prev =>
        prev.map(x => x.id === a.id ? saved : x)
      );

      const title = encodeURIComponent(
        a.title || 'Approved Agreement'
      );

      const message = encodeURIComponent(
        `Dear ${a.clientName || 'Client'}, your agreement has been approved. Please find the approved agreement attached or use the CRM agreement PDF shared by your Telecaller.`
      );

      if (channel === 'Email') {
        window.location.href =
          `mailto:${encodeURIComponent(a.email)}?subject=${title}&body=${message}`;
      } else {
        const phone = String(a.phone || '').replace(/[^\d]/g, '');

        window.open(
          `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${message}`,
          '_blank',
          'noopener,noreferrer'
        );
      }

      setSending(null);

    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || 'Unable to mark agreement as sent');
    }
  };

  // SEARCH FILTER
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter(a =>
      [
        a.clientName,
        a.organization,
        a.title,
        a.agreementType,
        fmt(a.status)
      ]
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(query.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [items, query]);

  return (
    <div className="agreements-page">

      {/* PAGE HEADER */}
      <div className="agr-header">

        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">
            Agreements
          </h1>

          <p className="page-subtitle">
            Draft → Submit for Verification → Approved/Rejected → Send to Lead
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="agr-btn-primary"
          onClick={() => setEditing('new')}
        >
          <FiPlus />
          New Agreement
        </button>

      </div>

      {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}
      {error && (
        <div className="agr-error-banner">

          <span>{error}</span>

          <button
            onClick={load}
            title="Retry"
            style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
          >
            <FiRefreshCw />
            Retry
          </button>

          <button onClick={() => setError('')}>
            <FiX />
          </button>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* SEARCH TOOLBAR */}
      <div className="agr-toolbar">

        <div className="agr-search">
          <FiSearch />

          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search agreements"
          />
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* AGREEMENTS TABLE */}
      {loading ? (

        <div className="agr-empty">
          Loading...
        </div>

      ) : (

        <div className="agr-table-wrap">

          <table className="agr-table">

            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Client</th>
                <th>Category</th>
                <th>Title</th>
                <th>Status</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>

              {filtered.map(a => (

                <tr key={a.id}>

                  <td>
                    <b>{a.clientName}</b>

                    <div>{a.organization}</div>

                    {a.status === 'REJECTED' &&
                      a.rejectionReason && (

                          }}
                        >
                          <FiAlertCircle />
                          {' '}Rejected: {a.rejectionReason}
                        </small>
                      )}
                  </td>

                  <td>
                    {a.serviceType ||
                      templates.find(t => t.id === a.templateId)?.name ||
                      a.agreementType ||
                      a.templateId}
                  </td>

                  <td>{a.title}</td>

                  <td>
                    <span className="agr-status-pill">
                      {fmt(a.status)}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td>

                    {['DRAFT', 'REJECTED'].includes(a.status) && (
                      <button
                        className="agr-icon-btn"
                        onClick={() => setEditing(a)}
                        title="Edit"
                      >
                        <FiEdit2 />
                      </button>
                    )}

                    <button
                      className="agr-icon-btn"
                      onClick={() => openPdf(a.id)}

                        title="Send to Lead"

                    )}

                  <td colSpan="5" className="agr-empty">
                    No agreements found

                </tr>
              )}

            </tbody>

          </table>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* =====================================
          SEND APPROVED AGREEMENT MODAL
      ====================================== */}

      {sending && (

        <div
          className="agr-modal-overlay agr-send-overlay"
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
              setSending(null);

              <button
                className="agr-modal-close"

//

//

// /assets/indocampas-logo.png
//

  "/assets/indocampas-logo.png";


// ============================================================================
// UTILITY
// ============================================================================

function escapeHtml(value = "") {
  return String(value)
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return new Date()
      .toLocaleDateString("en-GB")
      .replaceAll("/", "-");
  }

  if (value instanceof Date) {
    return value
      .toLocaleDateString("en-GB")
      .replaceAll("/", "-");
  }

  return String(value);
}

function replacePlaceholders(html, values) {
  let result = html;

  Object.entries(values).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    result = result.replaceAll(
      `{{${key}}}`,
      value ?? ""
    );
  });

  return result;
}

    commissionWithErp: "₹1,000",
  },


  digitalMarketing: {
    key: "digitalMarketing",

    label: "Digital Marketing Package",

    yearlyFee: "₹23,000",

    discount: "₹7,000",

    defaultAmount: "₹16,000",

    gst: "18%",
  },


  erp: {
    key: "erp",

    label: "ERP Software",

    plans: {

      erpPro: {
        label: "Pro Plan",
        defaultAmount: "₹10,000",
      },

      erpProPlus: {
        label: "Pro Plus Plan",
        defaultAmount: "₹18,000",
      },

      erpProMax: {
        label: "Pro Max Plan",
        defaultAmount: "₹28,000",
      },

    },
  },

};


// ============================================================================
// BUILD DIGITAL MARKETING AGREEMENT
// ============================================================================

export function buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(
  selectedServices = {},
  amounts = {},
  lead = {},
  agreementData = {},
) {

  const digitalModule =
    SERVICE_MODULES.digitalMarketing;

  const admissionModule =
    SERVICE_MODULES.admissionDashboard;

  const digitalAmount =
    amounts.digitalMarketing ||
    digitalModule.defaultAmount;

  const admissionAmount =
    selectedServices.admissionDashboard
      ? (
          amounts.admissionDashboard ||
          admissionModule.defaultAmount
        )
      : admissionModule.defaultAmount;

  return replacePlaceholders(
    DIGITAL_MARKETING_TEMPLATE_HTML,
    {

      agreement_date:
        escapeHtml(
          formatDate(
            agreementData.date ||
            agreementData.agreementDate ||
            new Date()
          )
        ),

      client_name:
        escapeHtml(
          lead?.name ||
          lead?.school ||
          lead?.schoolName ||
          agreementData?.clientName ||
          ""
        ),

      client_address:
        escapeHtml(
          lead?.schoolAddress ||
          lead?.address ||
          agreementData?.clientAddress ||
          ""
        ),

      admission_dashboard_amount:
        escapeHtml(admissionAmount),

      digital_yearly_fee:
        escapeHtml(
          amounts.digitalYearlyFee ||
          digitalModule.yearlyFee
        ),

      digital_discount:
        escapeHtml(
          amounts.digitalDiscount ||
          digitalModule.discount
        ),

      digital_amount:
        escapeHtml(digitalAmount),

      digital_gst:
        escapeHtml(
          amounts.digitalGst ||
          digitalModule.gst
        ),

      commission_without_erp:
        escapeHtml(
          amounts.commissionWithoutErp ||
          admissionModule.commissionWithoutErp
        ),

      commission_with_erp:
        escapeHtml(
          amounts.commissionWithErp ||
          admissionModule.commissionWithErp
        ),

    }
  );
}


// ============================================================================
// BUILD ERP AGREEMENT
// ============================================================================

export function buildErpAgreementHtml(
  selectedServices = {},
  amounts = {},
  lead = {},
  agreementData = {},
) {

  const erpModule =
    SERVICE_MODULES.erp;

  const planKey =
    amounts.erpPlan ||
    "erpPro";

  const plan =
    erpModule.plans[planKey] ||
    erpModule.plans.erpPro;

  const erpAmount =
    agreementData?.erpPrice ||
    agreementData?.manualPrice ||
    amounts.erpAmount ||
    plan.defaultAmount;

  const erpTotalStrength =
    agreementData?.studentStrength ||
    agreementData?.totalStrength ||
    amounts.erpTotalStrength ||
    "";

  const gst =
    amounts.erpGst ||
    "Exclusive of GST";

  const total =
    amounts.erpTotalAmount ||
    erpAmount;

  return replacePlaceholders(
    ERP_TEMPLATE_HTML,
    {

      agreement_date:
        escapeHtml(
          formatDate(
            agreementData.date ||
            agreementData.agreementDate ||
            new Date()
          )
        ),

      client_name:
        escapeHtml(
          lead?.name ||
          lead?.school ||
          lead?.schoolName ||
          agreementData?.clientName ||
          ""
        ),

      client_address:
        escapeHtml(
          lead?.schoolAddress ||
          lead?.address ||
          agreementData?.clientAddress ||
          ""
        ),

      erp_plan_label:
        escapeHtml(plan.label),

      erp_amount:
        escapeHtml(erpAmount),

      erp_total_strength:
        escapeHtml(String(erpTotalStrength)),

      erp_gst:
        escapeHtml(gst),

      erp_total_amount:
        escapeHtml(total),

      company_signatory_name:
        escapeHtml(
          agreementData?.companySignatoryName ||
          "R. Aravind"
        ),

      company_signatory_title:
        escapeHtml(
          agreementData?.companySignatoryTitle ||
          "Chief Executive Officer"
        ),

      client_signatory_name:
        escapeHtml(
          agreementData?.clientSignatoryName ||
          ""
        ),

      client_signatory_title:
        escapeHtml(
          agreementData?.clientSignatoryTitle ||
          "Principal / Authorized Signatory"
        ),

    }
  );
}


// ============================================================================
// ADMISSION DASHBOARD ONLY
// ============================================================================
//
// The original Admission Dashboard agreement is represented using the
// original Digital Marketing branded agreement structure.
//
// We keep the original PDF branding, header, footer and clauses.
//

export function buildAdmissionDashboardAgreementHtml(
  selectedServices = {},
  amounts = {},
  lead = {},
  agreementData = {},
) {

  return buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(
    {
      ...selectedServices,
      admissionDashboard: true,
    },

    {
      ...amounts,
      digitalMarketing:
        "NO DIGITAL MARKETING FEE",
    },

    lead,

    agreementData
  );
}


// ============================================================================
// MAIN BUILDER
// ============================================================================
//
// selectedServices:
//
// {
//   admissionDashboard: true,
//   digitalMarketing: false,
//   erp: true
// }
//
// IMPORTANT:
//
// ERP and Digital Marketing documents are NOT merged into one generic
// agreement.
//
// If both are selected:
//
// ERP ORIGINAL DOCUMENT
//        +
// PAGE BREAK
//        +
// DIGITAL MARKETING ORIGINAL DOCUMENT
//
// ============================================================================

export function buildAgreementHtml(
  selectedServices = {},
  amounts = {},
  lead = {},
  agreementData = {},
) {

  const selected = {

    admissionDashboard:
      Boolean(
        selectedServices?.admissionDashboard
      ),

    digitalMarketing:
      Boolean(
        selectedServices?.digitalMarketing
      ),

    erp:
      Boolean(
        selectedServices?.erp
      ),

  };


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // VALIDATION
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !selected.admissionDashboard &&
    !selected.digitalMarketing &&
    !selected.erp
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Please select at least one agreement service."
    );
  }


  const documents = [];


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // ERP ORIGINAL AGREEMENT
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (selected.erp) {

    documents.push(
      buildErpAgreementHtml(
        selectedServices,
        amounts,
        lead,
        agreementData
      )
    );

  }


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // DIGITAL MARKETING ORIGINAL AGREEMENT
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (selected.digitalMarketing) {

    documents.push(
      buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(
        selectedServices,
        amounts,
        lead,
        agreementData
      )
    );

  }


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // ADMISSION DASHBOARD ONLY
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    selected.admissionDashboard &&
    !selected.digitalMarketing
  ) {

    documents.push(
      buildAdmissionDashboardAgreementHtml(
        selectedServices,
        amounts,
        lead,
        agreementData
      )
    );

  }


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // RETURN ALL SELECTED ORIGINAL DOCUMENTS
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  return documents.join(`
    <div
      style="
        page-break-before: always;
        break-before: page;
        height: 0;
      "
    ></div>
  `);

}


// ============================================================================
// TEMPLATE REGISTRY
// ============================================================================

export const AGREEMENT_TEMPLATES = {

  erp: {
    key: "erp",

    label: "ERP Software Agreement",

    build: buildErpAgreementHtml,
  },


  digitalMarketing: {
    key: "digitalMarketing",

    label:
      "Digital Marketing & Admin Dashboard Agreement",

    build:
      buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml,
  },


  admissionDashboard: {
    key: "admissionDashboard",

    label:
      "Admission Dashboard Agreement",

    build:
      buildAdmissionDashboardAgreementHtml,
  },

};

function escapeHtml(value = "") {
  return String(value)
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-GB").replaceAll("/", "-");
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toLocaleDateString("en-GB").replaceAll("/", "-");
  return String(value);
}

function replaceKnown(text, values) {
  let out = text;

  // Digital Marketing merge fields
  out = out.replace(/21-02-2026/g, values.agreement_date ?? "{{agreement_date}}");
  out = out.replace(/INDIRAGANDHI NURSERY AND PRIMARY SCHOOL/g, values.client_name ?? "{{client_name}}");
  out = out.replace(/School No:396, E 4th St, Pudukkottai, Tamil Nadu 622001/g, values.client_address ?? "{{client_address}}");
  out = out.replace(/₹23,000/g, values.digital_yearly_fee ?? "{{digital_yearly_fee}}");
  out = out.replace(/₹7,000/g, values.digital_discount ?? "{{digital_discount}}");
  out = out.replace(/₹16,000/g, values.digital_amount ?? "{{digital_amount}}");
  out = out.replace(/GST: 18%/g, "GST: " + (values.digital_gst ?? "{{digital_gst}}"));
  out = out.replace(/₹2,000/g, values.commission_without_erp ?? "{{commission_without_erp}}");
  out = out.replace(/₹1,000/g, values.commission_with_erp ?? "{{commission_with_erp}}");

  // ERP merge fields
  out = out.replace(/VENUS VIDYALAYA MATRICULATION SCHOOL/g, values.client_name ?? "{{client_name}}");
  out = out.replace(/Veppilaipatty \(po\), Valapady \(tk\), Salem \(Dt\) Pin code : 636202/g, values.client_address ?? "{{client_address}}");

  return out;
}

function renderLine(line, values) {
  const classes = ["exact-text-line"];
  if (line.bold) classes.push("exact-bold");
  if (line.italic) classes.push("exact-italic");
  const text = escapeHtml(replaceKnown(line.t, values));
  return `<span
    class="${classes.join(" ")}"
    contenteditable="true"
    suppresscontenteditablewarning="true"
    style="left:${line.x}px;top:${line.y}px;width:${Math.max(line.w + 8, 10)}px;min-height:${Math.max(line.h + 2, 10)}px;font-family:${escapeHtml(line.font)};font-size:${line.size}px;line-height:${line.h}px;"
  >${text}</span>`;
}

function renderPage(lines, values, key) {
  const text = lines.map(line => renderLine(line, values)).join("");
  return `
    <section class="exact-agreement-page" data-page="${key}">
      <img class="exact-brand-logo" src="${ASSETS.logo}" alt="" />
      <img class="exact-top-ribbon" src="${ASSETS.topRibbon}" alt="" />
      <img class="exact-bottom-ribbon" src="${ASSETS.bottomRibbon}" alt="" />
      ${text}
    </section>`;
}

function valuesFor(lead = {}, agreementData = {}, amounts = {}) {
  return {
    agreement_date: escapeHtml(formatDate(agreementData.date || agreementData.agreementDate || new Date())),
    client_name: escapeHtml(lead.name || lead.school || lead.schoolName || agreementData.clientName || ""),
    client_address: escapeHtml(lead.schoolAddress || lead.address || agreementData.clientAddress || ""),
    digital_yearly_fee: escapeHtml(amounts.digitalYearlyFee || "₹23,000"),
    digital_discount: escapeHtml(amounts.digitalDiscount || "₹7,000"),
    digital_amount: escapeHtml(amounts.digitalMarketing || amounts.digitalAmount || "₹16,000"),
    digital_gst: escapeHtml(amounts.digitalGst || "18%"),
    commission_without_erp: escapeHtml(amounts.commissionWithoutErp || "₹2,000"),
    commission_with_erp: escapeHtml(amounts.commissionWithErp || "₹1,000"),
    erp_plan_label: escapeHtml(amounts.erpPlanLabel || ""),
    erp_amount: escapeHtml(amounts.erpAmount || ""),
    erp_gst: escapeHtml(amounts.erpGst || "18%"),
    erp_total_amount: escapeHtml(amounts.erpTotalAmount || amounts.erpAmount || ""),
  };
}

export function buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(selectedServices = {}, amounts = {}, lead = {}, agreementData = {}) {
  const values = valuesFor(lead, agreementData, amounts);
  return EXACT_AGREEMENT_STYLES + `<div class="exact-agreement-document exact-digital-agreement">${DM_PAGES.map((p, i) => renderPage(p, values, `digital-${i+1}`)).join("")}</div>`;
}

export function buildErpAgreementHtml(selectedServices = {}, amounts = {}, lead = {}, agreementData = {}) {
  const values = valuesFor(lead, agreementData, amounts);
  return EXACT_AGREEMENT_STYLES + `<div class="exact-agreement-document exact-erp-agreement">${ERP_PAGES.map((p, i) => renderPage(p, values, `erp-${i+1}`)).join("")}</div>`;
}

export function buildAdmissionDashboardAgreementHtml(selectedServices = {}, amounts = {}, lead = {}, agreementData = {}) {
  return buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(selectedServices, { ...amounts, digitalMarketing: amounts.digitalMarketing || "NO COST" }, lead, agreementData);
}

export function buildAgreementHtml(selectedServices = {}, amounts = {}, lead = {}, agreementData = {}) {
  const docs = [];
  if (selectedServices.erp) docs.push(buildErpAgreementHtml(selectedServices, amounts, lead, agreementData));
  if (selectedServices.digitalMarketing || selectedServices.admissionDashboard) {
    docs.push(buildDigitalMarketingAgreementHtml(selectedServices, amounts, lead, agreementData));
  }
  if (!docs.length) throw new Error("Please select at least one agreement service.");
  return docs.join('<div style="page-break-before:always;break-before:page;height:0"></div>');
}

};

// src/pages/Agreements/pageFlow.jsx
// Shared by the Telecaller editor and the Super Admin viewer.
// Lays the agreement out on real A4 pages so it matches the generated PDF
// (AgreementPdfService: @page margin 42mm 20mm 52mm 20mm, letterpad stamped on every page):
//   * the letterpad is drawn once per page (never stretched / repeated through the text)
//   * a block that would run into the bottom ribbon/footer area is pushed to the next page
//   * logo + footer are drawn on every page at the same positions the PDF uses
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { FiPhone, FiGlobe, FiMapPin } from 'react-icons/fi';

export const PAGE_W = 794;                 // A4 @96dpi
export const PAGE_H = 1123;
export const PAD_TOP = Math.round(42 * 3.7795);      // 42mm  (logo ends ~39.5mm)
export const PAD_BOTTOM = Math.round(52 * 3.7795);   // 52mm  (footer starts ~249mm)
export const PAD_SIDE = Math.round(20 * 3.7795);     // 20mm

export const pageBackground = (pad) =>
  pad
    ? { backgroundImage: `url(${pad})`, backgroundSize: `100% ${PAGE_H}px`, backgroundRepeat: 'repeat-y' }
    : {};

// Moves whole blocks (direct children of the body element) to the next page when they
// would cross into the bottom margin. Returns the number of pages.
export function usePageFlow(bodyRef, enabled) {
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);

  const run = useCallback(() => {
    const body = bodyRef.current;
    if (!body || !enabled) return;
    const kids = Array.from(body.children);
    kids.forEach((k) => { k.style.paddingTop = ''; });
    const bases = kids.map((k) => parseFloat(getComputedStyle(k).paddingTop) || 0);
    const contentH = PAGE_H - PAD_TOP - PAD_BOTTOM;

    kids.forEach((k, i) => {
      const top = k.offsetTop;
      const h = k.offsetHeight;
      const page = Math.floor(top / PAGE_H);
      const limit = (page + 1) * PAGE_H - PAD_BOTTOM;
      const pageStart = page * PAGE_H + PAD_TOP;
      if (top + h > limit && h <= contentH && top > pageStart + 2) {
        k.style.paddingTop = `${(page + 1) * PAGE_H + PAD_TOP - top + bases[i]}px`;
      }
    });

    const last = kids[kids.length - 1];
    const end = last ? last.offsetTop + last.offsetHeight : PAD_TOP;
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((end + PAD_BOTTOM) / PAGE_H));
    setPages((p) => (p === n ? p : n));
  }, [bodyRef, enabled]);

  // after every render (children's effects, e.g. auto-growing textareas, have already run)
  useEffect(() => { run(); });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !bodyRef.current || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return undefined;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => run());
    ro.observe(bodyRef.current);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [enabled, bodyRef, run]);

  return pages;
}

// Logo + footer for every page, same coordinates as the PDF (fractions of the A4 page).
export function PageOverlays({ pages, logo, brand, footerPhone, footerWeb, footerAddress }) {
  const iconStyle = (top) => ({
    position: 'absolute', left: 0.14 * PAGE_W, top: top * PAGE_H, width: 19, height: 19, borderRadius: '50%',
    background: '#7b1113', color: '#fff', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
  });
  const textStyle = (top, color) => ({
    position: 'absolute', left: 0.185 * PAGE_W, top: top * PAGE_H, height: 0.028 * PAGE_H, lineHeight: `${0.028 * PAGE_H}px`,
    fontFamily: 'Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif', fontSize: 13, color, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
  });
  return Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => (
    <div key={i} aria-hidden="true"
      style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: i * PAGE_H, width: PAGE_W, height: PAGE_H, pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: 1 }}>
      {logo && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0.094 * PAGE_W, top: 0.028 * PAGE_H, width: 0.46 * PAGE_W, height: 0.105 * PAGE_H, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <img src={logo} alt="" style={{ maxWidth: '100%', maxHeight: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }} />
        </div>
      )}
      <span style={iconStyle(0.842)}><FiPhone size={11} /></span>
      <span style={textStyle(0.838, '#111827')}>{footerPhone}</span>
      <span style={{ ...iconStyle(0.880), background: '#111827' }}><FiGlobe size={11} /></span>
      <span style={textStyle(0.876, '#1d4ed8')}>{footerWeb}</span>
      <span style={iconStyle(0.914)}><FiMapPin size={11} /></span>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0.185 * PAGE_W, top: 0.910 * PAGE_H, fontFamily: 'Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif', fontSize: 13, lineHeight: '16px', color: '#c8102e', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {footerAddress.slice(0, 3).map((line, k) => (<div key={k}>{line}</div>))}
      </div>
    </div>
  ));
}

import {FiClock, FiLogIn, FiLogOut, FiWifi, FiWifiOff, FiCalendar, FiShield, FiRefreshCw} from 'react-icons/fi';
import attendanceService from '../../services/attendanceService';
import './Attendance.css';

const fmt=(seconds=0)=>{seconds=Math.max(0,Math.floor(seconds)); const h=Math.floor(seconds/3600),m=Math.floor((seconds%3600)/60),s=seconds%60; return [h,m,s].map((v,i)=>i===0?String(v).padStart(2,'0'):String(v).padStart(2,'0')).join(':');};
const time=(v)=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:true}):'—';

export default function Attendance(){
  const [data,setData]=useState(null); const [loading,setLoading]=useState(true); const [error,setError]=useState(''); const [tick,setTick]=useState(Date.now()); const [offset,setOffset]=useState(0);
  const load=useCallback(async()=>{try{const d=await attendanceService.today();setData(d);if(d.serverNow)setOffset(new Date(d.serverNow).getTime()-Date.now());setError('');}catch(e){setError(e.message);}finally{setLoading(false);}},[]);
  useEffect(()=>{load(); const i=setInterval(load,15000); return()=>clearInterval(i);},[load]);
  useEffect(()=>{const on=()=>load();window.addEventListener('attendance:update',on);return()=>window.removeEventListener('attendance:update',on);},[load]);
  useEffect(()=>{const i=setInterval(()=>setTick(Date.now()),1000);return()=>clearInterval(i);},[]);
  const serverNow=tick+offset;
  const permissionEnd=data?.permission?.end?new Date(data.permission.end).getTime():0;
  const remaining=data?.permission?.status==='Active'?Math.max(0,Math.floor((permissionEnd-serverNow)/1000)):0;
  const working=data?.workingSeconds||0;
  const liveWorking=useMemo(()=>{if(!data)return 0;if(data.online && ['Present','Late'].includes(data.status) && data.serverNow){return working+Math.max(0,Math.floor((serverNow-new Date(data.serverNow).getTime())/1000));}return working;},[data,working,serverNow]);
  if(loading)return <div className="att-page"><div className="att-loading">Loading attendance…</div></div>;
  return <div className="att-page">
    <div className="att-head"><div><h1>Attendance</h1><p>Daily attendance is tied to your employee and server date. Re-login and network reconnects continue the same day.</p></div><button className="att-refresh" onClick={load}><FiRefreshCw/> Refresh</button></div>
    {error&&<div className="att-error">{error}</div>}
    <div className="att-grid">
      <div className={`att-status-card ${String(data?.status||'').toLowerCase()}`}><div className="att-card-label">Current Status</div><div className="att-status">{data?.status||'Not Marked'}</div><div className="att-online">{data?.online?<><FiWifi/> Connected</>:data?.disconnected?<><FiWifiOff/> Disconnected — attendance preserved</>:<><FiWifiOff/> Logged out</>}</div></div>
      <div className="att-card"><div className="att-card-label">First Login</div><div className="att-big"><FiLogIn/>{time(data?.firstLoginAt)}</div><small>Server time</small></div>
      <div className="att-card"><div className="att-card-label">Working Time</div><div className="att-big"><FiClock/>{fmt(liveWorking)}</div><small>Permission/leave time excluded</small></div>
      <div className="att-card"><div className="att-card-label">Sessions</div><div className="att-big"><FiRefreshCw/>{data?.sessionCount||0}</div><small>Login/logout sessions today</small></div>
    </div>
    <div className="att-detail-grid">
      <section className="att-panel"><h2><FiShield/> Permission</h2>{data?.permission?<><div className="permission-row"><strong>{time(data.permission.start)}</strong><span>→</span><strong>{time(data.permission.end)}</strong></div><div className="permission-state">{data.permission.status==='Active'?<>Remaining: <b>{fmt(remaining)}</b></>:<>Completed</>}</div><p>{data.permission.reason||'Approved permission'}</p></>:<div className="att-empty">No approved permission for today.</div>}</section>
      <section className="att-panel"><h2><FiCalendar/> Leave</h2>{data?.leave?<div className="leave-active"><b>{data.leave.leaveType}</b><span>Active</span></div>:<div className="att-empty">No active approved leave.</div>}</section>
      <section className="att-panel"><h2><FiRefreshCw/> Session History</h2><div className="session-list">{(data?.sessions||[]).map(s=><div className="session-row" key={s.id}><div><b>{time(s.loginAt)}</b>{s.logoutAt?` → ${time(s.logoutAt)}`:' → Active'}</div><span>{s.manuallyLoggedOut?'Logout':s.connected?'Connected':'Disconnected'}</span></div>)}</div></section>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',

  'Mon',
  'Tue',
  'Wed',
  'Thu',
  'Fri',

  'Sun',

const pad = (number) =>
  String(number).padStart(2, '0');

const Calendar = () => {

  const today = new Date();

  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState(
    new Date(
      today.getFullYear(),
      today.getMonth(),
      1
    )
  );

  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [showModal, setShowModal] =
    useState(false);

  const [saving, setSaving] =
    useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    date: '',
    title: '',
    link: '',
    type: 'MEETING',
    assignedTo: [],
  });

  const [telecallers, setTelecallers] =
    useState([]);

  const year =
    currentDate.getFullYear();

  const month =
    currentDate.getMonth();

  // =====================================================
  // USER ROLE
  // =====================================================

  const user = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}'
      );
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }, []);

  const role = String(
    user?.role || ''
  ).toUpperCase();

  const canManageEvents =
    role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ||
    role === 'ADMIN';

  // =====================================================
  // MONTH RANGE
  // =====================================================

  const getDateRange = () => {

    const from =
      `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-01`;

    const lastDay = new Date(
      year,
      month + 1,
      0
    ).getDate();

    const to =
      `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(lastDay)}`;

    return {
      from,
      to,
    };
  };

  // =====================================================
  // LOAD CALENDAR
  // =====================================================

  const loadEvents = async () => {

    try {

      setLoading(true);
      setError('');

      const {
        from,
        to,
      } = getDateRange();

      console.log(
        'Loading calendar events:',
        { from, to }
      );

      const response =
        await calendarService.getEvents(
          from,
          to
        );

      console.log(
        'Calendar response:',
        response
      );

      setEvents(
        Array.isArray(response)
          ? response
          : []
      );

    } catch (err) {

      console.error(
        'Calendar load error:',
        err
      );

      setError(
        err?.message ||
        'Failed to load calendar'
      );

      setEvents([]);

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadEvents();
  }, [year, month]);

  // =====================================================
  // LOAD TELECALLERS
  // =====================================================

  useEffect(() => {

    if (!canManageEvents) {
      return;
    }

    const loadTelecallers =
      async () => {

        try {

          const response =
            await calendarService.getTelecallers();

          setTelecallers(
            Array.isArray(response)
              ? response
              : []
          );

        } catch (err) {

          console.error(
            'Failed to load telecallers:',
            err
          );

          setTelecallers([]);
        }
      };

    loadTelecallers();

  }, [canManageEvents]);

  // =====================================================
  // EVENTS BY DATE
  // =====================================================

  const eventsByDate = useMemo(() => {

    const eventMap = {};

    events.forEach((event) => {

      if (!event?.date) {
        return;
      }

      if (!eventMap[event.date]) {
        eventMap[event.date] = [];
      }

      eventMap[event.date].push(event);
    });

    return eventMap;

  }, [events]);

  // =====================================================
  // CALENDAR GRID
  // =====================================================

  const calendarGrid = useMemo(() => {

    const firstDayOfMonth =
      new Date(year, month, 1);

    const startOffset =
      (firstDayOfMonth.getDay() + 6) % 7;

    const daysInMonth =
      new Date(
        year,
        month + 1,
        0
      ).getDate();

    const cells = [];

    for (
      let i = 0;
      i < startOffset;
      i++
    ) {
      cells.push(null);
    }

    for (
      let day = 1;
      day <= daysInMonth;
      day++
    ) {
      cells.push(day);
    }

    while (
      cells.length % 7 !== 0
    ) {
      cells.push(null);
    }

    return cells;

  }, [year, month]);

  // =====================================================
  // DATE FORMAT
  // =====================================================

  const formatDate = (day) =>
    `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

  const todayString =
    new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // =====================================================
  // NAVIGATION

        year,

        1

    );

        month + 1,
        1
      )
    );
  };

  // =====================================================

    });

      type: 'MEETING',
      assignedTo: [],
    });
  };

          }}

          {error}

              className="ap-modal-title"
            >

              <span>
                Add Calendar Event
              </span>

              <button
                className="ap-btn-icon"
                onClick={closeModal}
              >

                <FiX />

              </button>

            </div>

            {/* DATE */}

            <div className="ap-form-group">

              <label>
                Date *
              </label>

              <input
                type="date"
                value={form.date}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setForm(
                    (previous) => ({
                      ...previous,
                      date:
                        event.target.value,
                    })
                  )
                }
              />

            </div>

            {/* TITLE */}

            <div className="ap-form-group">

              <label>
                Title *
              </label>

              <input
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setForm(
                    (previous) => ({
                      ...previous,
                      title:
                        event.target.value,
                    })
                  )
                }
                placeholder="Event title"
              />

            </div>

            {/* TYPE */}

            <div className="ap-form-group">

              <label>
                Event Type
              </label>

              <select
                value={form.type}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setForm(
                    (previous) => ({
                      ...previous,
                      type:
                        event.target.value,
                    })
                  )
                }
              >

                <option value="MEETING">
                  Meeting
                </option>

                <option value="HOLIDAY">
                  Holiday
                </option>

                <option value="EVENT">
                  Event
                </option>

              </select>

            </div>

            {/* LINK */}

            <div className="ap-form-group">

              <label>
                Meeting Link
              </label>

              <input
                value={form.link}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setForm(
                    (previous) => ({
                      ...previous,
                      link:
                        event.target.value,
                    })
                  )
                }
                placeholder="https://meet.google.com/..."
              />

            </div>

            {/* TELECALLERS */}

            {telecallers.length > 0 && (

              <div className="ap-form-group">

                <label>
                  Assign Telecallers
                </label>

                <div
                  style={{
                    maxHeight: 150,
                    overflowY: 'auto',
                    border:
                      '1px solid #e5e7eb',
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    padding: 8,
                  }}
                >

                  {telecallers.map(
                    (telecaller) => {

                      const username =
                        telecaller.username;

                      const checked =
                        form.assignedTo.includes(
                          username
                        );

                      return (

                        <label
                          key={username}
                          style={{
                            display:
                              'flex',
                            alignItems:
                              'center',
                            gap: 8,
                            padding:
                              '6px 4px',
                            cursor:
                              'pointer',
                          }}
                        >

                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={
                              checked
                            }
                            onChange={() =>
                              toggleTelecaller(
                                username
                              )
                            }
                          />

                          <span>

                            {telecaller.fullName ||
                              username}

                            {telecaller.employeeId &&
                              ` (${telecaller.employeeId})`}

                          </span>

                        </label>

                      );
                    }
                  )}

                </div>

                <small
                  style={{
                    color: '#64748b',
                  }}
                >

                  Leave empty to make
                  the event visible to all
                  telecallers.

                </small>

              </div>

            )}

            {/* ACTIONS */}

            <div
              className="ap-form-actions"
            >

              <button
                className="ap-btn-outline"
                onClick={closeModal}
                disabled={saving}
              >

                Cancel

              </button>

              <button
                className="ap-btn-primary"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={saving}
              >

                {saving
                  ? 'Saving...'
                  : 'Add Event'}

              </button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      )}

    </div>
  );
};

export default Calendar;

const AVATAR_COLORS = ['#7b1113','#2563eb','#7c3aed','#d97706','#16a34a','#0891b2','#db2777','#ea580c'];

const avatarColor = n => {
  if (!n || typeof n !== 'string') return AVATAR_COLORS[0];
  return AVATAR_COLORS[n.charCodeAt(0) % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
};

// Excel imports are stored as a JSON object in lead.notes. Keep that object
// intact and append telecaller updates as the next UPn property.
const parseLeadUpdateRecord = (lead) => {
  const record = {};
  if (lead?.notes) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(lead.notes);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) Object.assign(record, parsed);
      else record['Legacy Note'] = String(lead.notes);
    } catch {
      record['Legacy Note'] = String(lead.notes);
    }
  }
  Object.keys(lead || {}).forEach((key) => {
    if (/^UP\s*\d+$/i.test(key) && lead[key] != null && String(lead[key]).trim()) record[key] = lead[key];
  });
  return record;
};

const getLeadUpdates = (lead) => Object.entries(parseLeadUpdateRecord(lead))
  .map(([label, value]) => {
    const match = label.match(/^UP\s*(\d+)$/i);
    return match ? { label: `UP${Number(match[1])}`, number: Number(match[1]), value: String(value ?? '') } : null;
  })
  .filter((item) => item && item.value.trim())
  .sort((a, b) => b.number - a.number);

// Resolve the business Lead ID used by LeadService (not MongoDB's _id).
// Keep raw backend identifiers intact; never overwrite the original lead object.
const getBusinessLeadId = (lead) => {
  if (!lead) return '';
  // API contract: PUT /api/leads/{leadId} looks up Lead.leadId, not Mongo _id.
  const businessId = lead.businessLeadId || lead.leadId;
  if (businessId != null && String(businessId).trim()) return String(businessId).trim();
  // Safe fallback only when the API response has no business leadId.
  const fallback = lead.id || lead._id;
  const value = fallback == null ? '' : String(fallback).trim();
  return value && !/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/i.test(value) ? value : '';
};


// ─── Queue grouping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A lead is a FOLLOW-UP only when the telecaller really scheduled one:
//   • status is Call Back / Follow-up, or
//   • the telecaller saved a follow-up note (TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_NOTE) with a valid date, or
//   • a valid follow-up date exists AND the lead is already past the "New" stage.
// A pre-filled Excel date on a still-New lead does NOT hide it from the New Leads tab any more.
const NEW_STAGE_STATUSES = ['', 'New', 'In Progress', 'Contacted'];
const NO_RESPONSE_STATUSES = ['No Response', 'Not Answered', 'Not answering', 'No Answer'];
const DONE_STATUSES = ['Converted', 'Not Interested', 'Completed', 'Not Existing', 'Demo Scheduled'];

const hasValidFollowupDate = (value) => {
  if (value == null) return false;
  const s = String(value).trim();
  if (!s || s === 'Pending' || s === '-' || s.toLowerCase() === 'null') return false;
  return !Number.isNaN(new Date(s).getTime());
};

const computeIsFollowUp = (lead) => {
  const status = (lead.status || '').trim();
  if (status === 'Call Back' || status === 'Follow-up') return true;
  if (!hasValidFollowupDate(lead.tcNextRefollowupDate)) return false;
  const record = parseLeadUpdateRecord(lead);
  if (record.TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_NOTE && String(record.TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_NOTE).trim()) return true;
  return !NEW_STAGE_STATUSES.includes(status);
};

const getQueueGroup = (lead) => {
  if (lead.isFollowUp) return 'Follow-ups';
  if (NO_RESPONSE_STATUSES.includes(lead.status)) return 'No Response';
  if (DONE_STATUSES.includes(lead.status)) return 'Done';
  return 'New Leads';
};

const normalizeLead = (lead) => {
  const base = {
    ...lead,
    businessLeadId: lead.leadId || lead.businessLeadId || '',
    id: lead.leadId || lead.id,
    _id: lead.id || lead._id || '',
    name: lead.name || lead.school || 'Unknown',
    mobile: lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber || 'N/A',
    category: lead.category || 'School',
    status: lead.status || 'New',
    contactPerson: lead.contactPerson || lead.name || '',
    source: lead.source || 'Excel Import',
    location: lead.district || 'Unknown',
    district: lead.district || '',
    notes: lead.notes || '',
    prevNotes: lead.notes || '',
    assignedTo: lead.assignedTo || 'Unassigned',
    time: lead.lastContact || '',
    initials: lead.name?.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('') || '??',
    organization: lead.organization || lead.school || lead.name || '',
    address: lead.schoolAddress || lead.address || '',
    area: lead.area || '',
    campaign: lead.campaign || '',
    nextFollowUp: lead.tcNextRefollowupDate || '',
    nextVisit: lead.meNextVisitDate || '',
  };
  base.isFollowUp = computeIsFollowUp(base);
  return base;
};

const getReadableFollowupNote = (lead) => {
  const record = parseLeadUpdateRecord(lead);
  const dedicated = record.TC_NEXT_FOLLOWUP_NOTE || record.tcNextRefollowupNote || lead?.tcNextRefollowupNote;
  if (dedicated && String(dedicated).trim()) return String(dedicated).trim();
  return 'Follow-up scheduled';
};

const formatFollowupDate = (value) => {
  if (!value || value === 'Pending') return 'Pending';
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(value);
  return date.toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

const fmtTime = s => {
  if (!s && s !== 0) return '00:00';
  const h=Math.floor(s/3600), m=Math.floor((s%3600)/60), sec=s%60;
  return h>0
    ? `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`
    : `${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`;
};

  return (

      {safeInitials.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
    </div>
  );
};

const AgentStatusSelector = ({ status, onChange, isCallActive }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const currentStatus = AGENT_STATUSES[status] || AGENT_STATUSES['Available'];

  const handleStatusChange = (newStatus) => {
    const newStatusObj = AGENT_STATUSES[newStatus];
    if (!newStatusObj.canCall && isCallActive) {
      if (!window.confirm('You have an active call. Changing to this status will not end the current call, but you won\'t be able to make new calls. Continue?')) {
        return;
      }
    }
    onChange(newStatus);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="agent-status-selector" ref={dropdownRef}>
      <button
        className="agent-status-trigger"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        style={{ background: currentStatus.bg }}
      >
        <span className="status-label">{currentStatus.label}</span>
        <span className="status-arrow">▼</span>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="agent-status-dropdown">
          {Object.entries(AGENT_STATUSES).map(([key, value]) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              className={`status-option ${status === key ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => handleStatusChange(key)}
              style={{
                background: status === key ? value.bg : 'transparent',
                borderLeft: status === key ? '3px solid #7b1113' : '3px solid transparent'
              }}
              disabled={isCallActive && !value.canCall}
            >
              <span className="status-option-label">{value.label}</span>
              {status === key && <span className="status-check">✓</span>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

const CallInitiationModal = ({ lead, onClose, onCall, canCall }) => {

  const availableNumbers = [

    { number: lead?.mobile3, label: 'Tertiary', person: lead?.contactPerson3 },
    ...(lead?.additionalMobiles || []).map((item, index) => ({
      number: typeof item === 'string' ? item : item.number,

      person: typeof item === 'string' ? '' : (item.contactPerson || ''),

  ].filter(c => c.number && c.number.trim() !== '');

  return (

              {lead?.contactPerson && <div className="call-contact-person" style={{color:'#6b7280', fontSize:'0.9rem'}}>Contact: {lead.contactPerson}</div>}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">

            >
              {availableNumbers.map((contact, idx) => (
                <option key={idx} value={contact.number}>
                  {contact.label}: {contact.number} {contact.person ? `(${contact.person})` : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="call-methods" style={{display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:'10px', margin:'16px 0'}}>
            <div style={{display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'12px', padding:'12px 16px', borderRadius:'10px', border:'2px solid #7b1113', background:'#fff5f5'}}>
              <PhoneCall size={20} color="#7b1113" />
              <span>Local SIM Call — sends a call request to the paired phone bridge</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!canCall && (
            <div className="call-blocked-warning" style={{display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'10px', padding:'10px 14px', background:'#fee2e2', borderRadius:'8px', color:'#b91c1c', fontSize:'12.5px', margin:'8px 0'}}>
              <AlertTriangle size={16} />
              <span>You are currently not available to make calls. Please change your status to Available.</span>
            </div>

            <button
              className={`call-initiate-btn ${!canCall ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
              onClick={async () => {
                if (!canCall) {
                  alert('Please change your status to Available to make calls.');
                  return;
                }
                setIsLoading(true);
                await onCall(selectedNumber);
                setIsLoading(false);
                onClose();
              }}
              disabled={isLoading || !canCall}
              style={{display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'8px', padding:'10px 24px', background: !canCall ? '#ccc' : '#7b1113', color:'white', border:'none', borderRadius:'8px', fontWeight:'600', cursor: !canCall ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', opacity: !canCall ? '0.6' : '1'}}
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader size={18} className="spinning" />
                  Connecting...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <PhoneCall size={18} />
                  Call Now
                </>
              )}
            </button>
            <button className="btn-outline" onClick={onClose} style={{padding:'10px 24px', borderRadius:'8px', border:'1px solid #e5e7eb', background:'transparent', color:'#1a1a1a', cursor:'pointer'}}>Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  );
};
