import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import '../../styles/AdminPages.css';
import {
  FiSend,
  FiPaperclip,
  FiUsers,
  FiCheckCircle,
  FiMic,
  FiSquare,
  FiMessageCircle,
  FiVolume2,
  FiPlay,
  FiPause,
  FiDownload,
  FiFileText,
  FiImage,
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import communicationService from '../../services/communicationService';

const GROUP_ID = 'GROUP-ALL';

const initials = (name) =>
  name?.split(' ').map((part) => part[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase() || '??';

const formatDuration = (seconds = 0) => {
  const value = Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0);
  const m = Math.floor(value / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const s = Math.floor(value % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${m}:${s}`;
};


const encodeWav = (samples, sampleRate) => {
  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(buffer);
  const writeString = (offset, value) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i += 1) {
      view.setUint8(offset + i, value.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  };
  const write16 = (offset, value) => view.setUint16(offset, value, true);
  const write32 = (offset, value) => view.setUint32(offset, value, true);

  writeString(0, 'RIFF');
  write32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2);
  writeString(8, 'WAVE');
  writeString(12, 'fmt ');
  write32(16, 16);
  write16(20, 1);
  write16(22, 1);
  write32(24, sampleRate);
  write32(28, sampleRate * 2);
  write16(32, 2);
  write16(34, 16);
  writeString(36, 'data');
  write32(40, samples.length * 2);

  let offset = 44;
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i += 1) {
    const sample = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    view.setInt16(
      offset,
      sample < 0 ? sample * 0x8000 : sample * 0x7fff,
      true
    );
    offset += 2;
  }

  return new Blob([buffer], { type: 'audio/wav' });
};
const formatFileSize = (bytes = 0) => {
  const value = Number(bytes) || 0;
  if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
  if (value < 1024 * 1024) return `${(value / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  if (value < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(value / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(value / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} GB`;
};

const VoicePlayer = ({ src, duration, compact = false }) => {
  const audioRef = useRef(null);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(Number(duration) || 0);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [buffered, setBuffered] = useState(0);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return undefined;
    setReady(false);
    setFailed(false);
    setPlaying(false);
    setCurrent(0);
    setBuffered(0);
    if (Number(duration) > 0) setTotal(Number(duration));
    audio.load();
    return undefined;
  }, [src]);

  const toggle = async () => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio || failed) return;
    try {
      if (audio.paused) {
        await audio.play();
      } else {
        audio.pause();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Audio playback error:', err);
      setFailed(true);
      setPlaying(false);
    }
  };

  const seek = (e) => {
    const value = Number(e.target.value);
    if (audioRef.current && Number.isFinite(value)) {
      audioRef.current.currentTime = value;
    }
    setCurrent(value);
  };

  const updateBuffered = (audio) => {
    try {
      if (audio.buffered.length) {
        setBuffered(audio.buffered.end(audio.buffered.length - 1));
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  return (
    <div className={`comm-voice-card ${compact ? 'compact' : ''} ${failed ? 'failed' : ''}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="comm-voice-play"
        onClick={toggle}
        disabled={!ready || failed}
        aria-label={playing ? 'Pause voice message' : 'Play voice message'}
      >
        {playing ? <FiPause size={17} /> : <FiPlay size={17} />}
      </button>

      <div className="comm-voice-body">
        <div className="comm-voice-track">
          <div className="comm-voice-wave" aria-hidden="true">
            {Array.from({ length: 30 }).map((_, i) => (
              <span key={i} style={{ height: `${7 + ((i * 17) % 17)}px` }} />
            ))}
          </div>
          <div
            className="comm-voice-buffer"
            style={{ width: `${total > 0 ? Math.min(100, (buffered / total) * 100) : 0}%` }}
          />
          <div
            className="comm-voice-progress"
            style={{ width: `${total > 0 ? Math.min(100, (current / total) * 100) : 0}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <input
          className="comm-voice-range"
          aria-label="Voice message progress"
          type="range"
          min="0"
          max={Math.max(total, 0.01)}
          step="0.01"
          value={Math.min(current, total || 0)}
          onChange={seek}
          disabled={!ready || failed}
        />
        <div className="comm-voice-times">
          <span>{formatDuration(current)}</span>
          <span>{formatDuration(total)}</span>
        </div>
        {failed && <div className="comm-voice-error">Audio could not be loaded completely.</div>}
      </div>

      <audio
        ref={audioRef}
        src={src}
        preload="auto"
        playsInline
        onLoadedMetadata={(e) => {
          const d = Number(e.currentTarget.duration);
          if (Number.isFinite(d) && d > 0) setTotal(d);
          setReady(Number.isFinite(d) && d > 0);
        }}
        onCanPlayThrough={(e) => {
          const d = Number(e.currentTarget.duration);
          if (Number.isFinite(d) && d > 0) setTotal(d);
          setReady(true);
          updateBuffered(e.currentTarget);
        }}
        onProgress={(e) => updateBuffered(e.currentTarget)}
        onTimeUpdate={(e) => {
          setCurrent(e.currentTarget.currentTime || 0);
          updateBuffered(e.currentTarget);
        }}
        onPlay={() => setPlaying(true)}
        onPause={() => setPlaying(false)}
        onEnded={() => {
          setPlaying(false);
          setCurrent(0);
        }}
        onError={(e) => {
          console.error('Audio load error:', e.currentTarget.error);
          setFailed(true);
          setReady(false);
          setPlaying(false);
        }}
        style={{ display: 'none' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const attachmentIcon = (type='') => type.startsWith('image/') ? <FiImage/> : <FiFileText/>;

const FileCard = ({ message, onOpen }) => {
  const type = message.attachmentContentType || '';
  const image = type.startsWith('image/');
  return <div style={{minWidth:250,maxWidth:330}}>
    {image && message.attachmentId && <div style={{borderRadius:10,overflow:'hidden',marginBottom:8,background:'#f3f4f6'}}><img src={message.__attachmentUrl || ''} alt={message.attachmentName || 'image'} style={{display:'block',width:'100%',maxHeight:240,objectFit:'cover',cursor:'pointer'}} onClick={onOpen}/></div>}
    <div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:10,padding:'10px 12px',borderRadius:10,background:'rgba(0,0,0,.04)'}}>
      <div style={{width:38,height:38,borderRadius:8,display:'grid',placeItems:'center',background:'rgba(37,99,235,.12)',color:'#2563eb'}}>{attachmentIcon(type)}</div>
      <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,whiteSpace:'nowrap',overflow:'hidden',textOverflow:'ellipsis'}}>{message.attachmentName || 'Attachment'}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:.65,marginTop:2}}>{type || 'File'}{message.attachmentSizeBytes ? ` • ${formatFileSize(message.attachmentSizeBytes)}` : ''}</div></div>
      <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} title="Open / download" style={{border:0,background:'transparent',cursor:'pointer',fontSize:18}}><FiDownload/></button>
    </div>
  </div>;
};

const Communications = () => {
  const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
  const [activeChat, setActiveChat] = useState(GROUP_ID);
  const [participants, setParticipants] = useState([]);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordingSeconds, setRecordingSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [voicePreview, setVoicePreview] = useState(null);
  const recordingSecondsRef = useRef(0);
  const [voiceUrls, setVoiceUrls] = useState({});
  const [attachmentUrls, setAttachmentUrls] = useState({});

  const bottomRef = useRef(null);
  const recorderRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef([]);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const recordingStartedAtRef = useRef(0);
  const audioContextRef = useRef(null);
  const audioSourceRef = useRef(null);
  const audioProcessorRef = useRef(null);
  const audioSinkRef = useRef(null);
  const audioSamplesRef = useRef([]);

  const loadParticipants = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await communicationService.getParticipants();
      setParticipants(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Communication participants error:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to load participants');
    }
  };

  const loadMessages = async (chatId = activeChat) => {
    try {
      const data = await communicationService.getMessages(chatId);
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      setMessages(list);

      const unread = list.filter(
        (message) =>
          message.senderUsername !== currentUser.username &&
          !(message.readBy || []).includes(currentUser.username)
      );
      for (const message of unread) {
        try {
          await communicationService.markRead(message.id);
        } catch (readError) {
          console.warn('Read update failed:', readError);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Communication messages error:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to load messages');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadParticipants();
    loadMessages(GROUP_ID);
    const timer = setInterval(loadParticipants, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMessages(activeChat);
    const timer = setInterval(() => loadMessages(activeChat), 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [activeChat]);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages.length]);

  const attachmentUrlCacheRef = useRef(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    const loadAttachments = async () => {
      const nextVoice = {};
      const nextFiles = {};
      const neededIds = new Set();

      for (const message of messages) {
        if (!message.attachmentId) continue;
        const type = message.attachmentContentType || '';
        if (message.type !== 'VOICE' && !type.startsWith('image/')) continue;

        neededIds.add(message.attachmentId);

        try {
          let url = attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.get(message.attachmentId);
          if (!url) {
            url = await communicationService.getAttachmentBlobUrl(message.attachmentId, message.attachmentSizeBytes);
            attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.set(message.attachmentId, url);
          }

          if (message.type === 'VOICE') nextVoice[message.id] = url;
          else nextFiles[message.id] = url;
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('Attachment preview failed:', err);
        }
      }

      // IMPORTANT: messages are polled every 2 seconds. Do NOT revoke
      // existing Blob URLs whenever `messages` changes, otherwise an
      // audio message gets cut off while it is playing. URLs are kept in
      // a cache and revoked only when the component unmounts or when an
      // attachment is no longer needed.
      for (const [id, url] of attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.entries()) {
        if (!neededIds.has(id)) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.delete(id);
        }
      }

      if (!cancelled) {
        setVoiceUrls(nextVoice);
        setAttachmentUrls(nextFiles);
      }
    };

    loadAttachments();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    for (const url of attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.values()) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
    attachmentUrlCacheRef.current.clear();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    audioProcessorRef.current?.disconnect();
    audioSourceRef.current?.disconnect();
    audioSinkRef.current?.disconnect();
    audioContextRef.current?.close().catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const send = async () => {
    if (!draft.trim() || sending || isRecording) return;
    try {
      setSending(true);
      setError('');
      const isGroup = activeChat === GROUP_ID;
      await communicationService.sendMessage({
        recipientType: isGroup ? 'GROUP' : 'DIRECT',
        recipientUsername: isGroup ? null : activeChat,
        text: draft.trim(),
        type: 'CHAT',
      });
      setDraft('');
      await loadMessages(activeChat);
      await loadParticipants();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Send communication error:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to send message');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const sendFile = async (event) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = '';
    if (!file || sending || isRecording) return;
    try {
      setSending(true);
      setError('');
      if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Maximum file size is 50 MB.');
      const uploaded = await communicationService.uploadAttachment(file);

      // Verify that the exact number of bytes captured in the browser
      // reached the backend/GridFS. Never send a message pointing to a
      // partial voice upload.
      const storedSize = Number(uploaded?.sizeBytes || 0);
      if (storedSize !== file.size) {
        throw new Error(
          `Voice upload is incomplete (${storedSize} of ${file.size} bytes). Please record again.`
        );
      }

      const isGroup = activeChat === GROUP_ID;
      await communicationService.sendMessage({
        recipientType: isGroup ? 'GROUP' : 'DIRECT',
        recipientUsername: isGroup ? null : activeChat,
        text: file.name,
        type: 'FILE',
        attachmentId: uploaded.attachmentId,
        attachmentName: uploaded.fileName,
        attachmentContentType: uploaded.contentType,
        attachmentSizeBytes: uploaded.sizeBytes,
      });
      await loadMessages(activeChat);
      await loadParticipants();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('File send error:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to send file');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const finishVoiceSend = async (blob, duration) => {
    try {
      setSending(true);
      setError('');
      const mimeType = blob.type || 'audio/wav';
      const extension = mimeType.includes('ogg') ? 'ogg' : mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'm4a' : 'webm';
      const file = new File([blob], `voice-${Date.now()}.${extension}`, { type: mimeType });
      if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Maximum file size is 50 MB.');
      const uploaded = await communicationService.uploadAttachment(file);
      const isGroup = activeChat === GROUP_ID;
      await communicationService.sendMessage({
        recipientType: isGroup ? 'GROUP' : 'DIRECT',
        recipientUsername: isGroup ? null : activeChat,
        text: 'Voice message',
        type: 'VOICE',
        attachmentId: uploaded.attachmentId,
        attachmentName: uploaded.fileName,
        attachmentContentType: uploaded.contentType,
        durationSeconds: duration,
        attachmentSizeBytes: uploaded.sizeBytes,
      });
      await loadMessages(activeChat);
      await loadParticipants();
      setVoicePreview((prev) => {
        if (prev?.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev.url);
        return null;
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Voice send error:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to send voice message');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const startRecording = async () => {
    if (isRecording || sending) return;
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || typeof AudioContext === 'undefined') {
      setError('Voice recording is not supported in this browser.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setError('');
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: {
          channelCount: 1,
          echoCancellation: true,
          noiseSuppression: true,
          autoGainControl: true,
        },
      });

      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      const context = new AudioCtx();
      await context.resume();

      const source = context.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
      const processor = context.createScriptProcessor(4096, 1, 1);
      const sink = context.createGain();
      sink.gain.value = 0;

      audioSamplesRef.current = [];
      processor.onaudioprocess = (event) => {
        const input = event.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
        audioSamplesRef.current.push(new Float32Array(input));
      };

      source.connect(processor);
      processor.connect(sink);
      sink.connect(context.destination);

      streamRef.current = stream;
      audioContextRef.current = context;
      audioSourceRef.current = source;
      audioProcessorRef.current = processor;
      audioSinkRef.current = sink;
      setRecordingSeconds(0);
      recordingSecondsRef.current = 0;
      setIsRecording(true);

      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        recordingSecondsRef.current += 1;
        setRecordingSeconds(recordingSecondsRef.current);
      }, 1000);

      recordingStartedAtRef.current = performance.now();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Recording start error:', err);
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      setError(err.message || 'Microphone permission is required.');
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = async () => {
    if (!isRecording) return;

    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = null;

    const samples = audioSamplesRef.current;
    const context = audioContextRef.current;
    const sampleRate = context?.sampleRate || 48000;

    try {
      audioProcessorRef.current?.disconnect();
      audioSourceRef.current?.disconnect();
      audioSinkRef.current?.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {}

    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;

    try {
      await context?.close();
    } catch (_) {}

    audioContextRef.current = null;
    audioSourceRef.current = null;
    audioProcessorRef.current = null;
    audioSinkRef.current = null;
    audioSamplesRef.current = [];
    setIsRecording(false);

    const totalSamples = samples.reduce((sum, chunk) => sum + chunk.length, 0);
    if (!totalSamples) {
      setError('No audio was captured. Please record again.');
      return;
    }

    const merged = new Float32Array(totalSamples);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of samples) {
      merged.set(chunk, offset);
      offset += chunk.length;
    }

    const blob = encodeWav(merged, sampleRate);
    const duration = Math.max(1, merged.length / sampleRate);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    setVoicePreview((prev) => {
      if (prev?.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev.url);
      return { blob, url, duration };
    });
    setRecordingSeconds(Math.round(duration));
    setError('');
  };

  const discardVoicePreview = () => {
    setVoicePreview((prev) => {
      if (prev?.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev.url);
      return null;
    });
    setError('');
  };

  const sendVoicePreview = async () => {
    if (!voicePreview || sending) return;
    await finishVoiceSend(voicePreview.blob, voicePreview.duration);
  };

  const recordAgain = () => {
    discardVoicePreview();
    setRecordingSeconds(0);
    setTimeout(() => startRecording(), 0);
  };

  const activeChatInfo = participants.find((participant) => participant.id === activeChat);
  const telecallers = participants.filter((p) => p.chatCategory === 'TELECALLER');
  const admins = participants.filter((p) => p.chatCategory === 'SUPER_ADMIN');

  const renderMessage = (message) => {
    const mine = message.senderUsername === currentUser.username;
    const read = (message.readBy || []).length > 1;
    return (
      <div key={message.id} className={`comm-msg ${mine ? 'out' : 'in'}`}>
        {!mine && <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 11, marginBottom: 3 }}>{message.senderName}</div>}
        {message.type === 'ANNOUNCEMENT' && <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>📢 Announcement</div>}
        {message.type === 'VOICE' ? (
          <div style={{padding:'4px 0'}}>
            <div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:7,fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:5}}><FiVolume2 size={15}/> Voice message</div>
            {voiceUrls[message.id] ? <VoicePlayer src={voiceUrls[message.id]} duration={message.durationSeconds}/> : <span style={{fontSize:12,opacity:.7}}>Loading audio...</span>}
          </div>
        ) : message.type === 'FILE' && message.attachmentId ? (
          <FileCard message={{...message, __attachmentUrl: attachmentUrls[message.id]}} onOpen={() => communicationService.openAttachment(message.attachmentId).catch((err) => setError(err.message))}/>
        ) : (
          message.text && <div style={{whiteSpace:'pre-wrap',wordBreak:'break-word'}}>{message.text}</div>
        )}
        <div className="comm-msg-meta">
          {message.createdAt ? new Date(message.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : ''}
          {mine && <span style={{ marginLeft: 5 }}>{read ? <FiCheckCircle size={11} /> : '· sent'}</span>}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="ap-page">
      <style>{`
        .comm-voice-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:260px;max-width:360px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.06)}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
        .comm-voice-play{width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;border:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(37,99,235,.25)}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-play{background:#fff;color:#2563eb}
        .comm-voice-play:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}
        .comm-voice-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
        .comm-voice-wave{height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;margin-bottom:3px;overflow:hidden}
        .comm-voice-wave span{display:block;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:#94a3b8;opacity:.75}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-wave span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
        .comm-voice-range{width:100%;height:4px;accent-color:#2563eb;cursor:pointer}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-range{accent-color:#fff}
        .comm-voice-times{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;color:#64748b;margin-top:2px}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-times{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
        .comm-input-row{box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.08);border:1px solid #e5e7eb!important}
        .comm-input-row input{background:#fff;border:0!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:10px 14px!important;outline:none!important}
        .comm-input-row button,.comm-input-row .ap-btn-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
        .comm-input-row button:last-child{background:#2563eb;color:#fff}
        .comm-input-row button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
        .comm-voice-preview{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex:1;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:16px;padding:4px 6px 4px 4px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.06)}
        .comm-voice-preview .comm-voice-card{min-width:0;max-width:none;flex:1;padding:5px 7px;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none}
        .comm-preview-action,.comm-preview-send{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;flex:0 0 36px;border-radius:50%!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center;border:1px solid #e2e8f0!important;background:#fff!important;color:#475569!important;cursor:pointer}
        .comm-preview-action.danger{color:#dc2626!important}
        .comm-preview-send{background:#2563eb!important;border-color:#2563eb!important;color:#fff!important}
        .comm-preview-action:disabled,.comm-preview-send:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
        .comm-recording-live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex:1;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:16px;padding:8px 10px;color:#334155}
        .comm-recording-live>span:not(.comm-recording-dot){font-size:12px;color:#64748b;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
        .comm-recording-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(239,68,68,.12);animation:comm-recording-pulse 1.2s infinite}
        .comm-stop-recording{margin-left:auto!important;width:auto!important;height:34px!important;padding:0 12px!important;border-radius:17px!important;background:#fee2e2!important;color:#b91c1c!important;border:1px solid #fecaca!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}
        @keyframes comm-recording-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.85)}}
        .comm-msg{border-radius:16px!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.06)!important;max-width:min(76%,620px)!important;padding:9px 11px!important}
        .comm-msg.in{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #e8edf3!important}
        .comm-msg.out{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#1d4ed8)!important;color:#fff!important;border:none!important}
        .comm-voice-card{min-width:280px!important;max-width:410px!important;padding:10px 11px!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:#f8fafc!important;border:1px solid #e5e7eb!important;box-shadow:none!important}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)!important}
        .comm-voice-track{position:relative;height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px}
        .comm-voice-wave{position:absolute;inset:0;height:26px;margin:0;gap:3px;z-index:1;align-items:center}
        .comm-voice-wave span{width:3px;opacity:.55;background:#64748b!important;transition:opacity .15s}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-wave span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.8)!important}
        .comm-voice-buffer{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(37,99,235,.10);z-index:0;border-radius:8px}
        .comm-voice-progress{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:#2563eb;z-index:2;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-progress{background:#fff}
        .comm-voice-range{position:relative;z-index:3;margin-top:-9px!important;background:transparent!important}
        .comm-voice-times{font-size:10px!important;color:#64748b!important;font-weight:600}
        .comm-msg.out .comm-voice-times{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important}
        .comm-voice-error{font-size:10px;color:#dc2626;margin-top:4px}
        .comm-input-row{background:#f8fafc!important;border:1px solid #e2e8f0!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:8px!important;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.08)!important}
        .comm-input-row input{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #edf1f5!important;border-radius:18px!important;min-height:40px!important}
        .comm-input-row button,.comm-input-row .ap-btn-icon{width:40px!important;height:40px!important;background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #e5e7eb!important;color:#475569!important;transition:.18s ease}
        .comm-input-row button:hover,.comm-input-row .ap-btn-icon:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#cbd5e1!important;background:#f8fafc!important}
        .comm-input-row button:last-child,.comm-preview-send{background:#2563eb!important;border-color:#2563eb!important;color:#fff!important}
        .comm-voice-preview{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #dbe3ec!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:5px!important;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.07)!important}
        .comm-recording-live{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #fecaca!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(220,38,38,.08)!important}
        .comm-list{background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #e8edf3!important}
        .comm-window{background:#f7f9fc!important;border:1px solid #e8edf3!important;border-radius:18px!important;overflow:hidden}
        .comm-window-head{background:#fff!important;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf3!important;padding:14px 18px!important;min-height:62px!important;display:flex;align-items:center!important;font-weight:700!important}
        .comm-messages{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fafc 0%,#f3f6fa 100%)!important;padding:18px!important}

                  <FiSend size={15} />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : isRecording ? (

            ) : (
              <>
                <button type="button" onClick={startRecording} disabled={sending} title="Record voice message">
                  <FiMic size={16} />
                </button>

                  placeholder="Type a message..."
                  value={draft}
                  disabled={sending}
                  onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(); } }}
                />
                <button onClick={send} disabled={sending || !draft.trim()} title="Send">
                  <FiSend size={15} />
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const ChatListItem = ({ participant, activeChat, setActiveChat }) => {
  const unread = Number(participant.unreadCount || 0);
  return (
    <div
      className={`comm-list-item ${activeChat === participant.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
      onClick={() => setActiveChat(participant.id)}
    >
      <div className="comm-avatar">{participant.group ? <FiUsers size={15} /> : initials(participant.name)}</div>
      <div className="comm-list-info">
        <div className="comm-name">
          {participant.name}
          {unread > 0 && <span style={{ marginLeft: 8, background: '#dc2626', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 10, padding: '2px 7px', fontSize: 10 }}>{unread}</span>}
        </div>
        <div className="comm-sub">{participant.group ? 'Group Chat' : participant.chatCategory === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? 'Super Admin' : 'Telecaller'}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Communications;

    if (!q) return leads;
    return leads.filter(lead => {
      const name = String(lead.name || '').toLowerCase();
      const school = String(lead.school || '').toLowerCase();
      const mobile = String(lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber || '').toLowerCase();
      const email = String(lead.email || '').toLowerCase();
      const leadId = String(lead.leadId || '').toLowerCase();
      return name.includes(q) || school.includes(q) || mobile.includes(q) || email.includes(q) || leadId.includes(q);
    });
  }, [leads, leadSearch]);

  const set = (k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v })); 
 
  const handleLeadChange = (leadId) => { 
    const lead = leads.find(l => l.leadId === leadId); 
    if (!lead) { set('leadId', leadId); return; } 
    setForm(f => ({ 
      ...f, 
      leadId: lead.leadId || '', 
      organization: lead.school || lead.name || '', 
      contactPerson: lead.name || '', 
      email: lead.email || '', 
      phone: lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber || '',
      whatsappNumber: lead.whatsappNumber || lead.whatsAppNumber || lead.whatsapp || lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber || '',
    })); 
  };

    if (generatingLink) return; 
    try { 
      setGeneratingLink(true); setFormError(''); 
      const data = await demoService.createMeeting(); 
      set('meetLink', data.meetingUri); 
      set('meetType', 'meet'); 
    } catch (error) { 
      if (error?.data?.authorizationUrl) { 
        const popup = window.open(error.data.authorizationUrl, 'googleMeetOAuth', 'width=600,height=700'); 
        if (!popup) setFormError('Please allow popups and click Generate Link again.'); 
        else setFormError('Complete Google authorization in the new window, then click Generate Link again.'); 
      } else { 
        setFormError(error.message || 'Unable to generate Google Meet link.');

    if (!form.topic.trim()) { setFormError('Please enter a demo topic.'); return; }

      <div className="dm-modal-box dm-modal-box-wide"> 
        <div className="dm-modal-header"> 
          <span className="dm-modal-title">{isEdit ? 'Edit Demo' : 'Schedule New Demo'}</span> 
          <button className="dm-modal-close" onClick={onClose}><FiX /></button> 
        </div> 
        <div className="dm-modal-body"> 
          <div className="dm-form"> 
 
            {/* Organization & Contact Info */} 
            <div className="dm-form-section"> 
              <div className="dm-form-section-title">Organization & Contact Information</div> 
              <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                <label>Select Lead *</label>
                <div className="dm-lead-picker">
                  <button type="button" className={`dm-lead-picker-trigger ${showLeadDropdown ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => !isEdit && setShowLeadDropdown(v => !v)} disabled={isEdit}>
                    <span className="dm-lead-selected-text">
                      {form.leadId ? (() => {
                        const selected = leads.find(l => l.leadId === form.leadId);
                        return selected ? `${selected.leadId} — ${selected.school || selected.name || 'Unnamed Lead'}` : form.leadId;
                      })() : 'Select a lead from Leads'}
                    </span>
                    <FiChevronRight size={15} className={showLeadDropdown ? 'rotate-90' : ''} />
                  </button>
                  {showLeadDropdown && !isEdit && (
                    <div className="dm-lead-dropdown">
                      <div className="dm-lead-search">
                        <FiSearch size={14} />
                        <input type="text" placeholder="Search lead, name, mobile, email..." value={leadSearch} onChange={e => setLeadSearch(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
                      </div>
                      <div className="dm-lead-options">
                        {filteredLeads.length === 0 ? <div className="dm-lead-empty">No matching leads found</div> : filteredLeads.map(lead => (
                          <button key={lead.leadId} type="button" className={`dm-lead-option ${form.leadId === lead.leadId ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => { handleLeadChange(lead.leadId); setLeadSearch(''); setShowLeadDropdown(false); }}>
                            <div className="dm-lead-option-main">
                              <strong>{lead.school || lead.name || 'Unnamed Lead'}</strong>
                              <span>{lead.name && lead.school ? lead.name : lead.leadId}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="dm-lead-option-meta">
                              <span>{lead.leadId}</span>
                              {(lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber) && <span>{lead.mobile || lead.phoneNumber}</span>}
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div> 
              </div> 
              <div className="dm-form-row"> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"><label>Organization Name</label><input value={form.organization} readOnly /></div> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"><label>Contact Person</label><input value={form.contactPerson} readOnly /></div> 
              </div> 
              <div className="dm-form-row"> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"><label>Lead ID</label><input value={form.leadId} readOnly /></div> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"><label>Email</label><input type="email" value={form.email} readOnly /></div> 
              </div> 
              <div className="dm-form-row">
                <div className="dm-form-group">
                  <label>Phone Number {isEdit && <span className="dm-edit-hint">(editable)</span>}</label>
                  <input type="tel" value={form.phone || ''} onChange={e => isEdit && set('phone', e.target.value)} readOnly={!isEdit} placeholder="Lead phone number" />
                </div>
                <div className="dm-form-group">
                  <label>WhatsApp Number {isEdit && <span className="dm-edit-hint">(editable)</span>}</label>
                  <input type="tel" value={form.whatsappNumber || ''} onChange={e => isEdit && set('whatsappNumber', e.target.value)} readOnly={!isEdit} placeholder="WhatsApp number for Meet link" />
                </div>
              </div> 
            </div> 
 
            {/* Demo Details */} 
            <div className="dm-form-section"> 
              <div className="dm-form-section-title">Demo Details</div> 
              <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                <label>Demo Topic</label> 
                <input value={form.topic} onChange={e => set('topic', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. School ERP – Admission & Fee Module" /> 
              </div> 
              <div className="dm-form-row"> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                  <label>Demo Date *</label> 
                  <input type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e => set('date', e.target.value)} /> 
                </div> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                  <label>Demo Time *</label> 
                  <input type="time" value={form.time} onChange={e => set('time', e.target.value)} /> 
                </div> 
              </div> 
              <div className="dm-form-row"> 
                <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                  <label>Duration</label> 
                  <select value={form.duration} onChange={e => set('duration', e.target.value)}> 
                    {['15 min','30 min','45 min','60 min','90 min','2 hrs'].map(d => <option key={d}>{d}</option>)} 
                  </select> 
                </div> 
              </div> 
              {isEdit && ( 
                <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                  <label>Status</label> 
                  <select value={form.status} onChange={e => set('status', e.target.value)}> 
                    {DEMO_STATUSES.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s === 'Completed' ? 'Meet Completed' : s}</option>)} 
                  </select> 
                </div> 
              )} 
            </div> 
 
            {/* Meeting Details */} 
            <div className="dm-form-section"> 
              <div className="dm-form-section-title">Meeting Details</div> 
              <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                <label>Meeting Type</label> 
                <div className="dm-meeting-types"> 
                  {MEETING_TYPES.map(mt => ( 
                    <button 
                      key={mt.id} 
                      className={`dm-meeting-type-btn ${form.meetType === mt.id ? 'active' : ''}`} 
                      onClick={() => set('meetType', mt.id)} 
                      type="button" 
                    > 
                      {mt.icon} {mt.label} 
                    </button> 
                  ))} 
                </div> 
              </div> 
 
              {form.meetType === 'meet' && ( 
                <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                  <label>Google Meet Link</label> 
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}> 
                    <div className="dm-meet-link-row"> 
                      <input 
                        className="dm-meet-link-input" 
                        value={form.meetLink} 
                        onChange={e => set('meetLink', e.target.value)} 
                        placeholder="https://meet.google.com/xxx-xxxx-xxx" 
                      /> 
                    </div> 
                    <div className="dm-meet-actions"> 
                      <button className="dm-generate-btn" onClick={handleGenerateLink} type="button" disabled={generatingLink}> 
                        <FiRefreshCw size={12}/> {generatingLink ? 'Creating...' : 'Generate Link'} 
                      </button> 
                      {form.meetLink && ( 
                        <> 
                          <button className="dm-copy-btn" onClick={handleCopyLink} type="button"> 
                            {linkCopied ? <FiCheck size={12}/> : <FiCopy size={12}/>} 
                            {linkCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Link'} 
                          </button> 
                          <a href={form.meetLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="dm-open-btn"> 
                            <FiExternalLink size={12}/> Open Meeting 
                          </a> 
                        </> 
                      )} 
                    </div> 
                  </div> 
                </div> 
              )} 
            </div> 
 
            {/* Notes */} 
            <div className="dm-form-section"> 
              <div className="dm-form-section-title">Notes</div> 
              <div className="dm-form-group"> 
                <label>Internal Notes</label> 
                <textarea 
                  rows={3} 
                  value={form.notes} 
                  onChange={e => set('notes', e.target.value)} 
                  placeholder="Add any notes, preparation details, or client requirements..." 
                /> 
              </div> 
            </div> 
 
            {formError && <div className="dm-toast dm-toast-error" style={{ position: 'static', marginBottom: 12 }}>{formError}</div>} 
 
            <div className="dm-form-actions"> 
              <button className="dm-btn-outline" onClick={onClose} type="button">Cancel</button> 
              <button className="dm-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave} type="button" disabled={saving}> 
                <FiCheck size={14}/> {saving ? 'Saving...' : (isEdit ? 'Save Changes' : 'Schedule Demo')} 
              </button> 
            </div> 
          </div> 
        </div> 
      </div> 
    </div> 
  ); 
}; 
 
// ─── View Demo Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
const DemoViewModal = ({ demo, onClose, onEdit }) => { 
  const [linkCopied, setLinkCopied] = useState(false); 
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); 
  const [generatingLink, setGeneratingLink] = useState(false); 
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState(''); 
 
  const copyLink = () => { 
    if (!demo.meetLink) return; 
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(demo.meetLink).catch(() => {}); 
    setLinkCopied(true); 
    setTimeout(() => setLinkCopied(false), 2000); 
  }; 
 
  const infoRows = [ 
    ['Lead ID',    demo.leadId  || '—'], 
    ['Organization', demo.organization || '—'], 
    ['Contact Person', demo.contactPerson || '—'], 
    ['Email',      demo.email   || '—'], 
    ['Phone',      demo.phone   || '—'],
    ['WhatsApp',   demo.whatsappNumber || demo.phone || '—'], 
    ['Topic',      demo.topic   || '—'], 
    ['Date',       fmtDate(demo.date)], 
    ['Time',       fmtTime(demo.time)], 
    ['Duration',   demo.duration || '—'], 
    ['Status',     <StatusPill key="s" status={demo.status} />], 
    ['Meeting',    demo.meetType === 'meet' ? 'Google Meet' : demo.meetType === 'office' ? 'Office Visit' : 'Phone Call'], 
    ['Created On', demo.createdOn || '—'], 
    ['Demo ID',    demo.id], 
  ]; 
 
  return ( 
    <div className="dm-modal-overlay" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}> 
      <div className="dm-modal-box dm-modal-box-wide"> 
        <div className="dm-modal-header"> 
          <span className="dm-modal-title">Demo Information</span> 
          <button className="dm-modal-close" onClick={onClose}><FiX /></button> 
        </div> 
 
        <div className="dm-view-body"> 
          {/* Hero */} 
          <div className="dm-view-hero"> 
            <div className="dm-view-avatar" style={{ background: avatarColor(demo.organization) }}> 
              {initials(demo.organization)} 
            </div> 
            <div className="dm-view-hero-info"> 
              <div className="dm-view-client-name">{demo.organization}</div> 
              {demo.contactPerson && <div className="dm-view-contact-person">Contact: {demo.contactPerson}</div>} 
              <div className="dm-view-demo-id">{demo.id} · {demo.topic}</div> 
            </div> 
            <StatusPill status={demo.status} /> 
          </div> 
 
          {/* Info Grid */} 
          <div className="dm-view-grid"> 
            {infoRows.map(([k, v]) => ( 
              <div className="dm-view-row" key={k}> 
                <div className="dm-view-key">{k}</div> 
                <div className="dm-view-val">{v}</div> 
              </div> 
            ))} 
          </div> 
 
          {/* Join Bar */} 
          {demo.meetType === 'meet' && demo.meetLink && ( 
            <div className="dm-view-join-bar"> 
              <a href={demo.meetLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="dm-btn-primary" style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}> 
                <FiVideo size={14}/> Join Meeting 
              </a> 
              <button className="dm-btn-outline" onClick={copyLink}> 
                {linkCopied ? <FiCheck size={13}/> : <FiCopy size={13}/>} 
                {linkCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Link'} 
              </button> 
            </div> 
          )} 
 
          {/* Notes */} 
          {demo.notes && ( 
            <div className="dm-view-notes"> 
              <div className="dm-view-notes-title">Notes</div> 
              <div className="dm-view-notes-text">{demo.notes}</div> 
            </div> 
          )} 
 
          {/* Timeline */} 
          {demo.timeline?.length > 0 && ( 
            <div className="dm-timeline"> 
              <div className="dm-timeline-title">Activity Timeline</div> 
              <div className="dm-timeline-list"> 
                {demo.timeline.map((t, i) => ( 
                  <div className="dm-timeline-item" key={i}> 
                    <div className="dm-timeline-left"> 
                      <div className="dm-timeline-dot" style={{ background: t.bg, color: t.color, fontSize: 14 }}> 
                        {t.icon} 
                      </div> 
                      <div className="dm-timeline-line" /> 
                    </div> 
                    <div className="dm-timeline-content"> 
                      <div className="dm-timeline-action">{t.action}</div> 
                      <div className="dm-timeline-time">{t.time}</div> 
                    </div> 
                  </div> 
                ))} 
              </div> 
            </div> 
          )} 
 
          {/* Actions */} 
          <div className="dm-form-actions" style={{ padding: '14px 24px 24px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)' }}> 
            <button className="dm-btn-outline" onClick={onClose}>Close</button> 
            <button className="dm-btn-primary" onClick={() => { onClose(); onEdit(demo); }}> 
              <FiEdit2 size={13}/> Edit Demo 
            </button> 
          </div> 
        </div> 
      </div> 
    </div> 
  ); 
}; 
 
// ─── Main Demo Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
const Demo = ({ onNavigate }) => { 
  const [demos, setDemos]         = useState([]); 
  const [leads, setLeads]         = useState([]); 
  const [loading, setLoading]     = useState(true); 
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('All'); 
  const [search, setSearch]       = useState(''); 
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('All'); 
  const [filterExec, setFilterExec]     = useState('All'); 
  const [filterDate, setFilterDate]     = useState(''); 
  const [page, setPage]           = useState(1); 
  const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10); 
 
  const [showSchedule, setShowSchedule] = useState(false); 
  const [editDemo, setEditDemo]         = useState(null); 
  const [viewDemo, setViewDemo]         = useState(null); 
  const [toast, setToast]               = useState(null);
  const [contactOverrides, setContactOverrides] = useState(() => readContactOverrides());
  const autoCompletingIds = useRef(new Set()); 
 
  const showToast = useCallback((msg, type = 'success') => { 
    setToast({ msg, type }); 
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000); 
  }, []); 
 
  useEffect(() => { 
    let mounted = true; 
    (async () => { 
      try { 
        setLoading(true); 
        const [leadPage, demoRows] = await Promise.all([ 
          leadService.getLeads(0, 1000), 
          demoService.getAll(), 
        ]); 
        if (!mounted) return; 
        setLeads(Array.isArray(leadPage?.content) ? leadPage.content : (Array.isArray(leadPage) ? leadPage : [])); 
        setDemos(Array.isArray(demoRows) ? demoRows : []); 
      } catch (error) { 
        if (mounted) showToast(error.message || 'Unable to load Demo data.', 'error'); 
      } finally { if (mounted) setLoading(false); } 
    })(); 
    return () => { mounted = false; }; 
  }, [showToast]); 
 
  const getContactOverride = useCallback((demo) => {
    const override = contactOverrides[demo?.id] || {};
    return {
      phone: override.phone || demo?.phone || '',
      whatsappNumber: override.whatsappNumber || demo?.whatsappNumber || demo?.whatsAppNumber || demo?.whatsapp || demo?.phone || '',
    };
  }, [contactOverrides]);

  const persistContactOverride = useCallback((demoId, values) => {
    if (!demoId) return;
    setContactOverrides(prev => {
      const next = {
        ...prev,
        [demoId]: {
          ...(prev[demoId] || {}),
          phone: values.phone ?? prev[demoId]?.phone ?? '',
          whatsappNumber: values.whatsappNumber ?? prev[demoId]?.whatsappNumber ?? '',
        },
      };
      saveContactOverrides(next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // Automatically mark a Google Meet demo as Completed after its scheduled end time.
  // Uses the existing demoService.update API; no backend changes are required.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!demos.length) return undefined;
    let cancelled = false;

    const completeEndedDemos = async () => {
      const ended = demos.filter(demo =>
        demo.status !== 'Completed' &&
        demo.status !== 'Cancelled' &&
        demo.meetType === 'meet' &&
        !!demo.meetLink &&
        hasDemoEnded(demo) &&
        !autoCompletingIds.current.has(demo.id)
      );

      for (const demo of ended) {
        autoCompletingIds.current.add(demo.id);
        try {
          const saved = await demoService.update(demo.id, {
            leadId: demo.leadId,
            topic: demo.topic,
            date: demo.date,
            time: demo.time,
            duration: demo.duration,
            meetType: demo.meetType,
            meetLink: demo.meetLink,
            status: 'Completed',
            notes: demo.notes,
          });
          if (!cancelled) {
            setDemos(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === saved.id ? saved : x));
          }
        } catch {
          // Keep the page usable if an automatic status update fails.
        } finally {
          autoCompletingIds.current.delete(demo.id);
        }
      }
    };

    completeEndedDemos();
    const timer = setInterval(completeEndedDemos, 30000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [demos]);

  // ── Computed Stats ── 
  const stats = useMemo(() => { 
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); 
    return { 
      total:    demos.length, 
      todayDemos: demos.filter(d => d.date === today).length, 
      upcoming: demos.filter(d => isUpcoming(d.date) && d.status === 'Scheduled').length, 
      completed:demos.filter(d => d.status === 'Completed').length, 
      cancelled:demos.filter(d => d.status === 'Cancelled').length, 
    }; 
  }, [demos]); 
 
  const TABS = [ 
    { id: 'All',       label: 'All',       count: demos.length }, 
    { id: 'Today',     label: "Today's",   count: demos.filter(d => isToday(d.date)).length }, 
    { id: 'Upcoming',  label: 'Upcoming',  count: demos.filter(d => isUpcoming(d.date) && d.status === 'Scheduled').length }, 
    { id: 'Completed', label: 'Meet Completed', count: demos.filter(d => d.status === 'Completed').length }, 
    { id: 'Cancelled', label: 'Cancelled', count: demos.filter(d => d.status === 'Cancelled').length }, 
  ]; 
 
  // ── Filtered & Paginated ── 
  const filtered = useMemo(() => { 
    let d = [...demos]; 
    if (activeTab === 'Today')     d = d.filter(x => isToday(x.date)); 
    if (activeTab === 'Upcoming')  d = d.filter(x => isUpcoming(x.date) && x.status === 'Scheduled'); 
    if (activeTab === 'Completed') d = d.filter(x => x.status === 'Completed'); 
    if (activeTab === 'Cancelled') d = d.filter(x => x.status === 'Cancelled'); 
    if (filterStatus !== 'All')   d = d.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus); 
    if (filterDate)               d = d.filter(x => x.date === filterDate); 
    if (search.trim()) { 
      const q = search.toLowerCase(); 
      d = d.filter(x => 
        x.organization.toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
        (x.contactPerson && x.contactPerson.toLowerCase().includes(q)) || 
        x.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
        x.leadId.toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
        x.topic.toLowerCase().includes(q) 
      ); 
    } 
    return d; 
  }, [demos, activeTab, filterStatus, filterExec, filterDate, search]); 
 
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / rowsPerPage)); 
  const paginated  = filtered.slice((page - 1) * rowsPerPage, page * rowsPerPage); 
 
  const pageNums = () => { 
    const nums = []; 
    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) { 
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - page) <= 1) nums.push(i); 
      else if (nums[nums.length - 1] !== '...') nums.push('...'); 
    } 
    return nums; 
  }; 
 
  // ── CRUD ── 
  const handleAddSave = async (d) => { 
    const saved = await demoService.create({ leadId:d.leadId, topic:d.topic, date:d.date, time:d.time, duration:d.duration, meetType:d.meetType, meetLink:d.meetLink, status:d.status, notes:d.notes }); 
    persistContactOverride(saved.id, { phone: d.phone, whatsappNumber: d.whatsappNumber });
    setDemos(prev => [saved, ...prev]); setShowSchedule(false); showToast(`Demo ${saved.id} scheduled successfully!`); 
  }; 
 
  const handleEditSave = async (d) => {
    const saved = await demoService.update(d.id, { leadId:d.leadId, topic:d.topic, date:d.date, time:d.time, duration:d.duration, meetType:d.meetType, meetLink:d.meetLink, status:d.status, notes:d.notes });
    persistContactOverride(d.id, { phone: d.phone, whatsappNumber: d.whatsappNumber });
    setDemos(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === saved.id ? { ...x, phone: d.phone } : x)); setEditDemo(null); showToast('Demo updated successfully!');
  }; 
 
  const handleDelete = async (id) => { 
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this demo permanently?')) return; 
    try { await demoService.remove(id); setDemos(prev => prev.filter(x => x.id !== id)); showToast('Demo deleted.', 'error'); } 
    catch(e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to delete demo.', 'error'); } 
  }; 
 
  const handleCancel = async (id) => { 
    try { const saved = await demoService.cancel(id); setDemos(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === saved.id ? saved : x)); showToast('Demo cancelled.', 'warn'); } 
    catch(e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to cancel demo.', 'error'); } 
  }; 
 
  const handleCopyLink = (demo) => { 
    if (!demo.meetLink) { showToast('No meet link for this demo.', 'error'); return; } 
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(demo.meetLink).catch(() => {}); 
    showToast('Meet link copied!', 'info'); 
  }; 
 
  // Call button -> open the Call Panel for THIS lead and dial THIS demo's number from the
  // paired phone (no more tel: link that opens the PC's dialer).
  const handleCall = (demo) => {
    const { phone } = getContactOverride(demo);
    const number = String(phone || '').replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');
    if (!number) { showToast('No phone number available for this lead.', 'error'); return; }
    if (!onNavigate) { window.open(`tel:${number}`, '_self'); return; }   // safety fallback
    const lead = leads.find(l => String(l.leadId) === String(demo.leadId))
      || { leadId: demo.leadId, name: demo.organization, contactPerson: demo.contactPerson, mobile: number };
    onNavigate('callpanel', {
      state: { lead, leadId: demo.leadId, phone: number, name: demo.organization, action: 'callNumber' },
    });
  }; 
 

  const handleExport = () => {
    if (!filtered.length) { showToast('No demos available to export.', 'warn'); return; }
    const headers = ['Demo ID','Lead ID','Organization','Contact Person','Email','Phone','WhatsApp Number','Topic','Date','Time','Duration','Meeting Type','Meet Link','Status','Notes'];
    const rows = filtered.map(demo => { const contact = getContactOverride(demo); return [demo.id||'',demo.leadId||'',demo.organization||'',demo.contactPerson||'',demo.email||'',contact.phone||'',contact.whatsappNumber||'',demo.topic||'',demo.date||'',demo.time||'',demo.duration||'',demo.meetType==='meet'?'Google Meet':demo.meetType==='office'?'Office Visit':'Phone Call',demo.meetLink||'',demo.status==='Completed'?'Meet Completed':(demo.status||''),demo.notes||'']; });
    const csv=[headers,...rows].map(row=>row.map(value=>`"${String(value ?? '').replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
    const blob=new Blob(['\ufeff'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const link=document.createElement('a'); link.href=url;
    link.download=`demo_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showToast('Demos exported successfully!','success');
  };

  const handleWhatsAppShare = (demo) => {
    if (!demo.meetLink) { showToast('No Google Meet link available.','error'); return; }
    const { whatsappNumber, phone: contactPhone } = getContactOverride(demo);
    const targetNumber = whatsappNumber || contactPhone;
    if (!targetNumber) { showToast('No WhatsApp number available for this lead.','error'); return; }
    let phone=String(targetNumber).replace(/\D/g,''); if(phone.length===10) phone=`91${phone}`;
    const message=[`Hello ${demo.contactPerson || demo.organization || 'there'},`,'','Your Google Meet demo has been scheduled.','',`📅 Date: ${fmtDate(demo.date)}`,`⏰ Time: ${fmtTime(demo.time)}`,`⏱ Duration: ${demo.duration || '60 min'}`,'',`🔗 Google Meet: ${demo.meetLink}`,'','Thank you.'].join('\n');
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');
  };

  const handleMeetCompleted = async (demo) => {
    if (demo.status === 'Completed' || demo.status === 'Cancelled') return;
    try {
      const saved=await demoService.update(demo.id,{leadId:demo.leadId,topic:demo.topic,date:demo.date,time:demo.time,duration:demo.duration,meetType:demo.meetType,meetLink:demo.meetLink,status:'Completed',notes:demo.notes});
      setDemos(prev=>prev.map(x=>x.id===saved.id?saved:x)); showToast('Meet marked as completed successfully!','success');
    } catch(error) { showToast(error.message || 'Unable to mark meet as completed.','error'); }
  };

  const handleTabChange = (t) => { setActiveTab(t); setPage(1); }; 
  const handleSearch = (e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }; 
 
  return ( 
    <div className="dm-page"> 
 
      {loading && <div style={{ padding: 20, textAlign: 'center' }}>Loading leads and demos...</div>} 
 
      {/* Toast */} 
      {toast && <Toast msg={toast.msg} type={toast.type} onClose={() => setToast(null)} />} 
 
      {/* Header */} 
      <div className="dm-page-header"> 
        <div> 
          <div className="dm-page-title">Demo Management</div> 
        </div> 
        <div className="dm-header-actions"> 
          <button className="dm-btn-outline" onClick={handleExport}> 
            <FiCalendar size={14}/> Export 
          </button> 
          <button className="dm-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowSchedule(true)}> 
            <FiPlus size={15}/> Schedule Demo 
          </button> 
        </div> 
      </div> 
 
      {/* Stats Row */} 
      <div className="dm-stats-row"> 
        <div className="dm-stat-card" style={{ borderTop: '3px solid #7b1113' }}>

                  <td> 
                    <div className="dm-date-cell">{fmtDate(demo.date)}</div> 
                    <div className="dm-time-cell" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>{demo.duration}</div> 
                  </td> 
                  <td> 
                    <div className="dm-date-cell">{fmtTime(demo.time)}</div> 
                  </td>

                    <MeetBtn demo={demo} onCall={handleCall} /> 
                  </td> 
                  <td> 
                    <StatusPill status={demo.status} /> 
                  </td> 
                  <td> 
                    <div className="dm-action-group"> 
                      <button className="dm-act-btn view" title="View" onClick={() => setViewDemo({ ...demo, ...getContactOverride(demo) })}> 
                        <FiEye /> 
                      </button> 
                      <button className="dm-act-btn edit" title="Edit" onClick={() => setEditDemo({ ...demo, ...getContactOverride(demo) })}> 
                        <FiEdit2 /> 
                      </button> 
                      {demo.meetLink && ( 
                        <button className="dm-act-btn copy" title="Copy Link" onClick={() => handleCopyLink(demo)}> 
                          <FiCopy /> 
                        </button> 
                      )}
                      {demo.meetLink && demo.meetType === 'meet' && demo.status !== 'Cancelled' && (
                        <button className="dm-act-btn whatsapp" title="Share Google Meet on WhatsApp" onClick={() => handleWhatsAppShare(demo)}>
                          <FaWhatsapp />
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button className="dm-act-btn call" title="Call Client" onClick={() => handleCall(demo)}> 
                        <FiPhone /> 
                      </button> 
                      {demo.meetLink && demo.meetType === 'meet' && demo.status !== 'Cancelled' && ( 
                        <button className="dm-act-btn join" title="Join Meet" 
                          onClick={() => window.open(demo.meetLink, '_blank')}> 
                          <FiVideo /> 
                        </button> 
                      )} 
                      {demo.status !== 'Cancelled' && demo.status !== 'Completed' && (
                        <button className="dm-act-btn complete" title="Mark Meet Completed" onClick={() => handleMeetCompleted(demo)}>
                          <FiCheck />
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {demo.status !== 'Cancelled' && demo.status !== 'Completed' && ( 
                        <button className="dm-act-btn cancel" title="Cancel Demo" 
                          onClick={() => handleCancel(demo.id)}> 
                          <FiX /> 
                        </button> 
                      )} 
                      <button className="dm-act-btn del" title="Delete" onClick={() => handleDelete(demo.id)}> 
                        <FiTrash2 /> 
                      </button> 
                    </div> 
                  </td> 
                </tr> 
              ))} 
            </tbody> 
          </table> 
        </div> 
 
        {/* Pagination */} 
        <div className="dm-pagination-bar"> 
          <div className="dm-rows-select"> 
            Rows per page: 
            <select value={rowsPerPage} onChange={e => { setRowsPerPage(Number(e.target.value)); setPage(1); }}> 
              {ROWS_OPTIONS.map(r => <option key={r}>{r}</option>)} 
            </select> 
          </div> 
          <div className="dm-page-nums"> 
            <button className="dm-pg-btn" disabled={page === 1} onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}> 
              <FiChevronLeft size={13}/> 
            </button> 
            {pageNums().map((p, i) => 
              p === '...' 
                ? <span key={i} style={{ padding: '0 4px', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>…</span> 
                : <button key={p} className={`dm-pg-btn ${page === p ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setPage(p)}>{p}</button> 
            )} 
            <button className="dm-pg-btn" disabled={page === totalPages} onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}> 
              <FiChevronRight size={13}/> 
            </button> 
          </div> 
        </div> 
      </div> 
 
      {/* Modals */} 
      {showSchedule && ( 
        <DemoFormModal 
          allDemos={demos} 
          leads={leads} 
          onSave={handleAddSave} 
          onClose={() => setShowSchedule(false)} 
        /> 
      )} 
 
      {editDemo && ( 
        <DemoFormModal 
          initial={editDemo} 
          allDemos={demos} 
          leads={leads} 
          onSave={handleEditSave} 
          onClose={() => setEditDemo(null)} 
        /> 
      )} 
 
      {viewDemo && ( 
        <DemoViewModal 
          demo={viewDemo} 
          onClose={() => setViewDemo(null)} 
          onEdit={(d) => setEditDemo(d)} 
        /> 
      )} 
    </div> 
  ); 
}; 
 
export default Demo;

// ─── Modal Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Modal = ({ show, title, onClose, children, wide }) => {
  if (!show) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fu-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className={`fu-modal-box${wide ? ' fu-modal-box-wide' : ''}`} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="fu-modal-header">
          <span className="fu-modal-title">{title}</span>
          <button className="fu-modal-close" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
        </div>
        <div className="fu-modal-body">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ─── Follow-Up Form ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const FollowUpForm = ({ initial, onSave, onClose, leads = [] }) => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(initial || {
    organization: '', contactPerson: '', mobile: '', email: '', campaign: 'School ERP',
    type: 'Call Back', date: '', time: '', note: '',
    priority: 'Medium', status: 'Pending',
  });
  const set = (k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  // ADD mode only: pick an existing lead (a follow-up is stored on a lead)
  const isAdd = !initial;
  const [leadSearch, setLeadSearch] = useState('');
  const keyOf = l => String(firstValue(l?.leadId, l?.businessLeadId, l?.id, l?._id, '') || '');
  const nameOf = l => String(firstValue(l?.organization, l?.schoolName, l?.school, l?.name, 'Unknown') || 'Unknown');
  const mobileOf = l => String(firstValue(l?.mobile, l?.phoneNumber, l?.phone, '') || '');
  const matches = useMemo(() => {
    const q = leadSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = q
      ? leads.filter(l => `${nameOf(l)} ${mobileOf(l)} ${firstValue(l?.contactPerson, '') || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      : leads;
    return list.slice(0, 50);
  }, [leads, leadSearch]);
  const pickLead = key => {
    const lead = leads.find(l => keyOf(l) === key);
    if (!lead) { setForm(f => ({ ...f, leadKey: '' })); return; }
    setForm(f => ({
      ...f,
      leadKey: key,
      organization: nameOf(lead),
      contactPerson: String(firstValue(lead.contactPerson, lead.contactName, '') || ''),
      mobile: mobileOf(lead),
      email: String(firstValue(lead.email, '') || ''),
    }));
  };
  const locked = isAdd && !!form.leadKey;

  return (
    <div className="fu-lead-form">
      {isAdd && (
        <div className="fu-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <label>Select Lead *</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={leadSearch}
            onChange={e => setLeadSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search by organization, contact or mobile…"
          />
          <select
            size={5}
            value={form.leadKey || ''}
            onChange={e => pickLead(e.target.value)}
            style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 6 }}
          >
            {matches.length === 0 && <option value="" disabled>No leads found</option>}
            {matches.map(l => (
              <option key={keyOf(l)} value={keyOf(l)}>
                {nameOf(l)} — {mobileOf(l) || 'no number'}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {!form.leadKey && <small style={{ color: '#b45309' }}>Select the lead this follow-up is for.</small>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="fu-form-row">
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Organization Name</label>
          <input type="text" value={form.organization} readOnly={locked} onChange={e => set('organization', e.target.value)} placeholder="Organization Name" />
        </div>
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Contact Person</label>
          <input type="text" value={form.contactPerson} readOnly={locked} onChange={e => set('contactPerson', e.target.value)} placeholder="Contact Person" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="fu-form-row">
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Mobile</label>
          <input type="tel" value={form.mobile} readOnly={locked} onChange={e => set('mobile', e.target.value)} placeholder="+91 XXXXX XXXXX" />
        </div>
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Email</label>
          <input type="email" value={form.email} readOnly={locked} onChange={e => set('email', e.target.value)} placeholder="email@example.com" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="fu-form-row">
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Campaign</label>
          <select value={form.campaign} onChange={e => set('campaign', e.target.value)}>
            {['School ERP', 'College ERP', 'University ERP', 'Other'].map(c => <option key={c}>{c}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Follow-Up Type</label>
          <select value={form.type} onChange={e => set('type', e.target.value)}>
            {TYPES.slice(1).map(t => <option key={t}>{t}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="fu-form-row">
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Priority</label>
          <select value={form.priority} onChange={e => set('priority', e.target.value)}>
            {['High', 'Medium', 'Low'].map(p => <option key={p}>{p}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Status</label>
          <select value={form.status} onChange={e => set('status', e.target.value)}>
            {['Pending', 'Completed', 'Missed', 'Cancelled'].map(s => <option key={s}>{s}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="fu-form-row">
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Date</label>
          <input type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e => set('date', e.target.value)} min={today} />
        </div>
        <div className="fu-form-group">
          <label>Time</label>
          <input type="time" value={form.time} onChange={e => set('time', e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      </div>
     
      <div className="fu-form-group">
        <label>Note</label>
        <textarea rows={3} value={form.note} onChange={e => set('note', e.target.value)} placeholder="Describe the follow-up…" />
      </div>
      <div className="fu-form-actions">
        <button className="fu-btn-outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
        <button className="fu-btn-primary" onClick={() => onSave(form)}>Save Follow-Up</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ─── View Follow-Up Detail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ViewFollowUp = ({ fu, onClose, onCall }) => (
  <div className="fu-view-lead">
    <div className="fu-view-header">
      <div className="fu-view-id">{fu.id}</div>
      <span className="fu-status-pill" style={STATUS_STYLE[fu.status] || STATUS_STYLE.Pending}>{fu.status}</span>

    {[
      ['Organization', fu.organization],

    ].map(([k, v]) => (

    )}
    {fu.callRemarks && fu.callRemarks !== '--' && (
      <div className="fu-view-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
        <span className="fu-view-key">Call Remarks</span>
        <span className="fu-view-val" style={{ fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{fu.callRemarks}</span>
