// SEND MODAL
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const SendModal = ({
  payment,
  mode,
  qr,
  onClose,
  onSent,
}) => {
  const isInvoice = mode === 'invoice';
  const showQr = !isInvoice;

  const [channel, setChannel] =
    useState('WhatsApp');

  const [message, setMessage] = useState(
    isInvoice
      ? `Dear ${payment.organizationName},

Please find attached your invoice.

Total Amount : ${fmtINR(payment.totalAmount)}
Amount Paid  : ${fmtINR(payment.amountPaid)}
Balance      : ${fmtINR(payment.balanceAmount)}

Thank you.`
      : `Dear ${payment.organizationName},

Here are your payment details.

Payment Type : ${payment.paymentType}
Total Amount : ${fmtINR(payment.totalAmount)}
Amount Paid  : ${fmtINR(payment.amountPaid)}
Balance Due  : ${fmtINR(payment.balanceAmount)}${
          qr
            ? '\n\n(Payment QR code attached separately — please scan to pay.)'
            : ''
        }

Thank you.`
  );

  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState(null);

  // Invoice mode: build the message from the invoice the Super Admin saved (edited totals + balance).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isInvoice) return undefined;
    let active = true;
    const num = (v) => Number(v) || 0;
    paymentService
      .getInvoice(payment.id)
      .then((inv) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setInvoice(inv);
        const taxable = Math.max(0, num(inv.totalAmount) - num(inv.discountAmount));
        const grand = taxable + (taxable * num(inv.taxRate)) / 100;
        setMessage(
          `Dear ${inv.organizationName || payment.organizationName},

Please find your invoice ${inv.invoiceNumber || ''}.

Invoice Total : ${fmtINR(grand)}
Amount Paid   : ${fmtINR(inv.amountPaid)}
Balance Due   : ${fmtINR(inv.balanceAmount)}

Thank you.`
        );
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isInvoice, payment.id]);

  const handleDownloadQr = () => {
    if (!qr?.dataUrl) return;

    const link = document.createElement('a');

    link.href = qr.dataUrl;
    link.download =
      qr.fileName || 'payment-qr.png';

    link.click();
  };

  const handleSend = async () => {
    setSending(true);

    try {
      // WhatsApp / mail links cannot attach files, so download the invoice PDF first;
      // the user attaches it in the chat / email that opens next.
      if (isInvoice) {
        try {
          const inv = invoice || (await paymentService.getInvoice(payment.id));
          const [sharedQr, assets] = await Promise.all([
            paymentService.getSharedQr().catch(() => null),
            invoiceAssetService.getAssets().catch(() => ({})),
          ]);
          await printInvoicePdf(inv, { qrDataUrl: sharedQr?.dataUrl, ...assets });
        } catch (e) {
          /* the message can still be sent */
        }
      }

      await onSent(channel);

      if (channel === 'WhatsApp') {
        const rawPhone = (
          payment.phone || ''
        ).replace(/\D/g, '');
        // wa.me needs the country code; assume India (+91) for 10-digit numbers
        const waPhone = rawPhone.length === 10 ? `91${rawPhone}` : rawPhone;

        window.open(
          `https://wa.me/${waPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
            message
          )}`,
          '_blank'
        );
      } else {
        window.open(
          `mailto:${payment.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(
            isInvoice
              ? 'Your Invoice'
              : 'Payment Details'
          )}&body=${encodeURIComponent(
            message
          )}`,
          '_blank'
        );
      }

      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      window.alert(e?.message || 'Unable to send. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="pay-modal-overlay"
      onClick={(e) =>
        e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()
      }
    >
      <div className="pay-modal-box pay-modal-box-sm">
        <div className="pay-modal-header">
          <span className="pay-modal-title">
            {channel === 'WhatsApp' ? (
              <FaWhatsapp
                size={16}
                style={{
                  marginRight: 6,
                  color: '#25D366',
                }}
              />
            ) : (
              <FiMail
                size={16}
                style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
              />
            )}

            Send{' '}
            {isInvoice
              ? 'Invoice'
              : 'Payment Details'}
          </span>

          <button
            className="pay-modal-close"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            <FiX />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-modal-body">
          <div className="pay-form-group">
            <label className="pay-form-label">
              Channel
            </label>

            <select
              className="pay-form-select"
              value={channel}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setChannel(e.target.value)
              }
            >
              <option value="WhatsApp">
                WhatsApp (
                {payment.phone || 'no number'})
              </option>

              <option value="Email">
                Email (
                {payment.email || 'no email'})
              </option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {showQr && (
            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Payment QR Code
              </label>

              {qr?.dataUrl ? (
                <div className="pay-qr-send-box">
                  <img
                    src={qr.dataUrl}
                    alt="Payment QR code"
                    className="pay-qr-send-img"
                  />

                  <div className="pay-qr-send-note">
                    <div>
                      {channel} can't auto-attach
                      images. Download the QR, then
                      attach it in the chat/email
                      before sending.
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="pay-btn-outline"
                      onClick={
                        handleDownloadQr
                      }
                    >
                      <FiDownload size={12} />
                      Download QR
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="pay-qr-send-empty">
                  No payment QR code has been
                  uploaded by the Super Admin yet.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {isInvoice && (
            <div className="pay-qr-send-note" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
              The invoice PDF downloads when you click Send. Attach it in the
              WhatsApp chat / email that opens, then send.
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="pay-wa-msg-area">
            <div className="pay-wa-msg-label">
              Message
            </div>

            <textarea
              className="pay-wa-msg-textarea"
              value={message}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setMessage(e.target.value)
              }
              rows={8}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          className="pay-form-actions"
          style={{
            padding: '14px 24px 24px',
            borderTop:
              '1px solid var(--border)',
          }}
        >
          <button
            className="pay-btn-outline"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <button
            className="pay-btn-primary"
            disabled={sending}
            onClick={handleSend}
          >
            <FiSend size={13} />

            {sending
              ? 'Sending…'
              : `Send via ${channel}`}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PAYMENT RECORD MODAL
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const PaymentRecordModal = ({
  payment,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}) => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    paymentAmount: '',
    paymentType: 'Partial',
    paymentDate: new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 10),
    paymentMethod: 'UPI',
    transactionReferenceNumber: '',
    notes: '',
    status: 'Paid',
  });

  const [saving, setSaving] =
    useState(false);

  const set = (k, v) =>
    setForm((x) => ({
      ...x,
      [k]: v,
    }));

  const history =
    payment.paymentHistory || [];

  const lastRecord = history.length
    ? history[history.length - 1]
    : null;

  const save = async () => {
    if (!(Number(form.paymentAmount) > 0)) {
      return alert(
        'Enter a valid payment amount'
      );
    }

    if (
      Number(form.paymentAmount) >
        Number(payment.balanceAmount || 0) &&
      form.status !== 'Pending'
    ) {
      return alert(
        'Amount cannot exceed remaining balance'
      );
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      await onSave({
        ...form,
        paymentAmount: Number(
          form.paymentAmount
        ),
      });

      onClose();
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="pay-modal-overlay"
      onClick={(e) =>
        e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()
      }
    >
      <div className="pay-modal-box pay-modal-lg">
        <div className="pay-modal-header">
          <span className="pay-modal-title">
            <FiPlus
              size={16}
              style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
            />

            Add Payment Record —{' '}
            {payment.organizationName}
          </span>

          <button
            className="pay-modal-close"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            <FiX />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-modal-body">
          <div className="pay-view-note-label">
            Previous Payment Information
          </div>

          <div
            className="pay-amount-summary"
            style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
          >
            <div className="pay-summary-item">
              <span className="pay-summary-label">
                Total Amount
              </span>

              <span className="pay-summary-value">
                {fmtINR(payment.totalAmount)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="pay-summary-item">
              <span className="pay-summary-label">
                Total Paid So Far
              </span>

              <span className="pay-summary-value pay-summary-paid">
                {fmtINR(payment.amountPaid)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="pay-summary-item">
              <span className="pay-summary-label">
                Remaining Balance
              </span>

              <span
                className={`pay-summary-value ${
                  payment.balanceAmount > 0
                    ? 'pay-summary-balance'
                    : ''
                }`}
              >
                {fmtINR(payment.balanceAmount)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {lastRecord && (
            <div
              className="pay-amount-summary"
              style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
            >
              <div className="pay-summary-item">
                <span className="pay-summary-label">
                  Previous Payment Amount
                </span>

                <span className="pay-summary-value">
                  {fmtINR(lastRecord.amount)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="pay-summary-item">
                <span className="pay-summary-label">
                  Previous Payment Date
                </span>

                <span className="pay-summary-value">
                  {lastRecord.paymentDate ||
                    '--'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="pay-summary-item">
                <span className="pay-summary-label">
                  Previous Payment Type
                </span>

                <span className="pay-summary-value">
                  {lastRecord.paymentType ||
                    '--'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {history.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 18 }}>
              <div className="pay-view-note-label">
                Payment History
              </div>

              <table className="pay-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Amount</th>
                    <th>Type</th>
                    <th>Date</th>
                    <th>Method</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody>
                  {history.map((r, i) => (
                    <tr key={r.id || i}>
                      <td>{fmtINR(r.amount)}</td>
                      <td>{r.paymentType}</td>
                      <td>
                        {r.paymentDate || '--'}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {r.paymentMethod || '--'}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {r.status || 'Paid'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="pay-view-note-label">
            New Payment
          </div>

          <div className="pay-add-grid">
            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Payment Amount *
              </label>

              <input
                className="pay-form-input"
                type="number"
                value={form.paymentAmount}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'paymentAmount',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Payment Type
              </label>

              <select
                className="pay-form-select"
                value={form.paymentType}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'paymentType',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
              >
                <option>Advance</option>
                <option>Partial</option>
                <option>Full</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Payment Date
              </label>

              <input
                className="pay-form-input"
                type="date"
                value={form.paymentDate}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'paymentDate',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Payment Method
              </label>

              <input
                className="pay-form-input"
                value={form.paymentMethod}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'paymentMethod',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
                placeholder="UPI / Cash / Bank Transfer"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Transaction / Reference No.
              </label>

              <input
                className="pay-form-input"
                value={
                  form.transactionReferenceNumber
                }
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'transactionReferenceNumber',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pay-form-group">
              <label className="pay-form-label">
                Status
              </label>

              <select
                className="pay-form-select"
                value={form.status}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  set(
                    'status',
                    e.target.value
                  )
                }
              >
                <option>Paid</option>
                <option>Pending</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pay-form-group">
            <label className="pay-form-label">
              Payment Notes
            </label>

            <textarea
              className="pay-form-textarea"
              value={form.notes}
              onChange={(e) =>
                set('notes', e.target.value)
              }
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          className="pay-form-actions"
          style={{
            padding: '14px 24px 24px',
            borderTop:
              '1px solid var(--border)',
          }}
        >
          <button
            className="pay-btn-outline"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <button
            className="pay-btn-primary"
            disabled={saving}
            onClick={save}
          >
            {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// VIEW PAYMENT MODAL
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const ViewPaymentModal = ({
  payment,
  previous = [],
  qr,
  onClose,
  onDownloadInvoice,
  onSendPayment,
  onSendInvoice,
  onAddRecord,
}) => {
  const pct =
    payment.totalAmount > 0
      ? Math.round(
          (payment.amountPaid /
            payment.totalAmount) *
            100
        )
      : 0;

  const progressColor =
    pct === 100
      ? '#15803d'
      : pct > 0
        ? '#d97706'
        : '#b91c1c';

  const canSendInvoice =
    payment.invoiceId &&
    (payment.status ===
      'Invoice Sent to Telecaller' ||
      payment.status === 'Completed');

  const infoRows = [
    [
      'Organization',
      payment.organizationName,
    ],
    ['Address', payment.address || '--'],
    ['Phone', payment.phone || '--'],
    ['Email', payment.email || '--'],
    ['Payment Type', payment.paymentType],
    [
      'Payment Date',
      payment.paymentDate || '--',
    ],
    [
      'Status',
      <StatusBadge
        key="s"
        status={payment.status}
      />,
    ],
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className="pay-modal-overlay"
      onClick={(e) =>
        e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()
      }
    >
      <div className="pay-modal-box pay-modal-lg">
        <div className="pay-modal-header">
          <span className="pay-modal-title">
            <FiCreditCard
              size={16}
              style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
            />
            Payment Details
          </span>

          <button
            className="pay-modal-close"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            <FiX />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-view-hero">
          <div
            className="pay-view-avatar"
            style={{
              background: avatarColor(
                payment.organizationName
              ),
            }}
          >
            {initials(
              payment.organizationName
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="pay-view-hero-info">
            <div className="pay-view-client-name">
              {payment.organizationName}
            </div>

            <div className="pay-view-company">
              {payment.address}
            </div>
          </div>

          <StatusBadge
            status={payment.status}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="pay-amount-summary">
          {[
            {
              label: 'Total Amount',
              val: fmtINR(
                payment.totalAmount
              ),
              cls: '',
            },
            {
              label: 'Amount Paid',
              val: fmtINR(
                payment.amountPaid
              ),
              cls: 'pay-summary-paid',
            },
            {
              label: 'Balance Due',
              val: fmtINR(
                payment.balanceAmount
              ),
              cls:
                payment.balanceAmount > 0
                  ? 'pay-summary-balance'
                  : '',
            },
          ].map((c) => (
            <div
              className="pay-summary-item"
              key={c.label}
            >
              <span className="pay-summary-label">
                {c.label}
              </span>

              <span
                className={`pay-summary-value ${c.cls}`}
              >
                {c.val}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="pay-progress-wrap">
          <div className="pay-progress-label">
            <span>Payment Progress</span>

            <span
              style={{
                color: progressColor,
              }}
            >
              {pct}% Paid
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="pay-progress-track">
            <div
              className="pay-progress-fill"
              style={{
                width: `${pct}%`,
                background: progressColor,
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {Number(payment.balanceAmount) > 0 &&
          payment.status !== 'Fully Paid' && (
            <button
              className="pay-btn-primary"
              style={{
                margin: '0 24px 14px',
              }}
              onClick={onAddRecord}
            >
              <FiPlus size={13} />
              Add Payment Record
            </button>
          )}

        {payment.paymentHistory?.length >
          0 && (
          <div
            style={{
              padding: '0 24px 14px',
            }}
          >
            <div className="pay-view-note-label">
              Payment History
            </div>

            <table className="pay-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Amount</th>
                  <th>Type</th>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Method</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {payment.paymentHistory.map(
                  (r, i) => (
                    <tr key={r.id || i}>
                      <td>
                        {fmtINR(r.amount)}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        {r.paymentType}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        {r.paymentDate ||
                          '--'}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        {r.paymentMethod ||
                          '--'}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        {r.status || 'Paid'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {previous.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ padding: '0 24px 14px' }}>
            <PreviousPayments
              payments={previous}
              title="Previous payments of this client"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="pay-view-grid">
          {infoRows.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div
              className="pay-view-row"
              key={k}
            >
              <div className="pay-view-key">
                {k}
              </div>

              <div className="pay-view-val">
                {v}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="pay-view-qr-section">
          <div className="pay-view-note-label">
            Payment QR Code / Scanner
          </div>

          {qr?.dataUrl ? (
            <div className="pay-view-qr-box">
              <img
                src={qr.dataUrl}
                alt="Payment QR code"
                className="pay-view-qr-img"
              />

              <span className="pay-view-qr-hint">
                Uploaded by Super Admin — shown
                to every Telecaller.
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="pay-view-qr-empty">
              The Super Admin hasn't uploaded a
              payment QR code yet.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {payment.notes && (
          <div className="pay-view-note">
            <div className="pay-view-note-label">
              <FiInfo size={12} />
              Notes
            </div>

            <div className="pay-view-note-text">
              {payment.notes}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {payment.timeline?.length > 0 && (
          <div className="pay-timeline">
            <div className="pay-timeline-title">
              <FiClock
                size={14}
                style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
              />
              Activity Timeline
            </div>

            <div className="pay-timeline-list">
              {payment.timeline.map(
                (t, i) => (
                  <div
                    className="pay-timeline-item"
                    key={i}
                  >
                    <div className="pay-timeline-left">
                      <div
                        className="pay-timeline-dot"
                        style={{
                          background: t.bg,
                          color: t.color,
                        }}
                      >
                        {getTimelineIcon(
                          t.icon
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="pay-timeline-line" />
                    </div>

                    <div className="pay-timeline-content">
                      <div className="pay-timeline-action">
                        {t.action}
                      </div>

                      <div className="pay-timeline-time">
                        {t.time}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div
          className="pay-form-actions"
          style={{
            padding: '14px 24px 24px',
            borderTop:
              '1px solid var(--border)',
          }}
        >
          <button
            className="pay-btn-outline"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            Close
          </button>

          <button
            className="pay-btn-outline"
            onClick={onSendPayment}
          >
            <FiSend size={13} />
            Send Payment Details
          </button>

          {payment.invoiceId && (
            <button
              className="pay-btn-outline"
              onClick={() =>
                onDownloadInvoice(payment)
              }
            >
              <FiDownload size={13} />
              Download Invoice
            </button>
          )}

          {canSendInvoice && (
            <button
              className="pay-btn-primary"
              onClick={onSendInvoice}
            >
              <FaWhatsapp size={13} />
              Send Invoice to Client
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// MAIN COMPONENT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const Payments = () => {
  const [payments, setPayments] =
    useState([]);

  const [leads, setLeads] =
    useState([]);

  const [leadsLoading, setLeadsLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [search, setSearch] =
    useState('');

  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] =
    useState('All Status');

  const [page, setPage] =
    useState(1);

  const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] =
    useState(10);

  const [viewPay, setViewPay] =
    useState(null);

  const [formPay, setFormPay] =
    useState(undefined);

  const [formPresetLead, setFormPresetLead] =
    useState(null);

  const [sendModal, setSendModal] =
    useState(null);

  const [recordPay, setRecordPay] =
    useState(null);

  const [toast, setToast] =
    useState(null);

  const [qr, setQr] =
    useState(null);

  const showToast = useCallback(
    (msg, type = 'success') => {
      setToast({
        msg,
        type,
      });

      setTimeout(
        () => setToast(null),
        3000
      );
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    paymentService
      .getSharedQr()
      .then((data) => setQr(data))
      .catch(() => setQr(null));
  }, []);

  const load = useCallback(
    async () => {
      setLoading(true);

      try {
        const data =
          await paymentService.getAll();

        setPayments(data || []);
      } catch (e) {
        showToast(
          e.message ||
            'Failed to load payments',
          'error'
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [showToast]
  );

  const loadLeads = useCallback(
    async () => {
      setLeadsLoading(true);

      try {
        const pageData =
          await paymentService.listAllClients();

        setLeads(
          pageData?.content || []
        );
      } catch (e) {
        showToast(
          e.message ||
            'Failed to load clients',
          'error'
        );
      } finally {
        setLeadsLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [showToast]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    loadLeads();
  }, [load, loadLeads]);

  const paymentByLead = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};

    for (const p of payments) {
      if (p.leadId) {
        map[p.leadId] = p;
      }
    }

    return map;
  }, [payments]);

  // every payment of a client (newest first); paymentByLead above only keeps one
  const paymentsByLead = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};

    for (const p of payments) {
      if (!p.leadId) continue;
      (map[p.leadId] = map[p.leadId] || []).push(p);
    }

    const stamp = (p) =>
      new Date(p.createdAt || p.recordedAt || p.paymentDate || 0).getTime() || 0;

    Object.values(map).forEach((list) => list.sort((a, b) => stamp(b) - stamp(a)));
    return map;
  }, [payments]);

  const rows = useMemo(
    () =>
      leads.map((lead) => ({
        lead,
        payment:
          paymentByLead[lead.leadId] ||
          null,
      })),
    [leads, paymentByLead]
  );

  const stats = useMemo(
    () => ({
      totalClients: leads.length,

      total: payments.length,

      completed:
        payments.filter(
          (p) =>
            p.status === 'Completed'
        ).length,

      pending:
        payments.filter(
          (p) =>
            p.status === 'Recorded' ||
            p.status === 'Verified'
        ).length,

      totalCollected:
        payments.reduce(
          (s, p) =>
            s +
            Number(
              p.amountPaid || 0
            ),
          0
        ),

      totalBalance:
        payments.reduce(
          (s, p) =>
            s +
            Number(
              p.balanceAmount || 0
            ),
          0
        ),
    }),
    [payments, leads]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let d = [...rows];

    if (filterStatus !== 'All Status') {
      d =
        filterStatus === 'No Payment'
          ? d.filter(
              (r) => !r.payment
            )
          : d.filter(
              (r) =>
                r.payment?.status ===
                filterStatus
            );
    }

    if (search.trim()) {
      const q =
        search.toLowerCase();

      d = d.filter(
        ({ lead, payment }) =>
          (
            payment?.organizationName ||
            lead.school ||
            lead.name ||
            ''
          )
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(q) ||
          (
            payment?.phone ||
            lead.phoneNumber ||
            lead.mobile ||
            ''
          )
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(q) ||
          (
            payment?.email ||
            lead.email ||
            ''
          )
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(q)
      );
    }

    return d;
  }, [
    rows,
    filterStatus,
    search,
  ]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.ceil(
      filtered.length /
        rowsPerPage
    )
  );

  const paginated = filtered.slice(
    (page - 1) * rowsPerPage,
    page * rowsPerPage
  );

  const pgRange = () => {
    const nums = [];

    for (
      let i = 1;
      i <= totalPages;
      i++
    ) {
      if (
        i === 1 ||
        i === totalPages ||
        Math.abs(i - page) <= 1
      ) {
        nums.push(i);
      } else if (
        nums[nums.length - 1] !==
        '...'
      ) {
        nums.push('...');
      }
    }

    return nums;
  };

  const handleSaveForm = async (
    payload,
    editId
  ) => {
    try {
      if (editId) {
        await paymentService.update(
          editId,
          payload
        );

        showToast(
          'Payment updated successfully.'
        );
      } else {
        await paymentService.create(
          payload
        );

        showToast(
          'Payment recorded successfully.'
        );
      }

      setFormPay(undefined);
      setFormPresetLead(null);

      load();
    } catch (e) {
      showToast(
        e.message ||
          'Failed to save payment',
        'error'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleAddRecord = async (
    payment,
    payload
  ) => {
    try {
      await paymentService.addPaymentRecord(
        payment.id,
        payload
      );

      await load();

      setViewPay(null);

      showToast(
        'Payment record saved and balance recalculated.'
      );
    } catch (e) {
      showToast(
        e.message ||
          'Failed to add payment record',
        'error'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleSendPaymentDetails =
    async (payment, channel) => {
      await paymentService.sendPaymentDetails(
        payment.id,
        channel
      );

      showToast(
        `Payment details shared via ${channel}.`
      );

      load();
    };

  const handleSendInvoice = async (
    payment,
    channel
  ) => {
    await paymentService.sendInvoiceToClient(
      payment.id,
      channel
    );

    showToast(
      `Invoice sent to client via ${channel}.`
    );

    load();
  };

  // Same invoice template + data as the Super Admin; PDF is generated in the browser.
  const handleDownloadInvoice = async (
    payment
  ) => {
    try {
      // Always print the invoice the Super Admin generated / edited (real number, items, bank details...)
      const [invoice, qr, assets] = await Promise.all([
        paymentService.getInvoice(payment.id),
        paymentService.getSharedQr().catch(() => null),
        invoiceAssetService.getAssets().catch(() => ({})),
      ]);
      await printInvoicePdf(invoice, { qrDataUrl: qr?.dataUrl, ...assets });
      showToast('Invoice PDF downloaded.');
    } catch (e) {
      showToast(
        e.message ||
          'Unable to download the invoice PDF.',
        'error'
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="pay-page">
      {toast && (
        <Toast
          msg={toast.msg}
          type={toast.type}
          onClose={() =>
            setToast(null)
          }
        />
      )}

      <div className="pay-page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="pay-page-title">
            Payments
          </h1>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-header-actions">
          <button
            className="pay-btn-primary"
            onClick={() => {
              setFormPresetLead(null);
              setFormPay(null);
            }}
          >
            <FiPlus size={13} />
            Record Payment
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pay-stats-row">
        {[
          {
            icon: <FiCreditCard />,
            label: 'Total Clients',
            val: stats.totalClients,
            color: '#4338ca',
            bg: '#e0e7ff',
          },
          {
            icon: <FiCheckCircle />,
            label: 'Completed',
            val: stats.completed,
            color: '#15803d',
            bg: '#dcfce7',
          },
          {
            icon: <FiClock />,
            label: 'In Progress',
            val: stats.pending,
            color: '#92400e',
            bg: '#fef9c3',
          },
          {
            icon: <FiDollarSign />,
            label: 'Collected',
            val: fmtINR(
              stats.totalCollected
            ),
            color: '#1d4ed8',
            bg: '#dbeafe',
          },
          {
            icon: <FaRupeeSign />,
            label: 'Balance Due',
            val: fmtINR(
              stats.totalBalance
            ),
            color: '#b91c1c',
            bg: '#fee2e2',
          },
        ].map((s) => (
          <div
            className="pay-stat-card"
            key={s.label}
          >
            <div
              className="pay-stat-icon"
              style={{
                background: s.bg,
                color: s.color,
              }}
            >
              {s.icon}
            </div>

            <div className="pay-stat-info">
              <div className="pay-stat-val">
                {s.val}
              </div>

              <div className="pay-stat-label">
                {s.label}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="pay-table-card">
        <div className="pay-filter-bar">
          <div className="pay-search-wrap">
            <FiSearch className="pay-search-ico" />

            <input
              className="pay-search-input"
              placeholder="Search by organization, phone, email…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSearch(
                  e.target.value
                );
                setPage(1);
              }}
            />
          </div>

          <select
            className="pay-filter-select"
            value={filterStatus}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFilterStatus(
                e.target.value
              );
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            {STATUSES.map((s) => (
              <option key={s}>
                {s}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          {(filterStatus !==
            'All Status' ||
            search) && (
            <button
              className="pay-btn-ghost"
              onClick={() => {
                setFilterStatus(
                  'All Status'
                );
                setSearch('');
                setPage(1);
              }}
            >
              <FiX size={13} />
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="pay-table-header-row">
          <div className="pay-table-label">
            Clients{' '}
            <span className="pay-record-count">
              ({filtered.length} of{' '}
              {leads.length})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-table-wrap">
          <table className="pay-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Organization</th>
                <th>Address</th>
                <th>Phone</th>
                <th>Email</th>
                <th>Type</th>
                <th>Total</th>
                <th>Paid</th>
                <th>Balance</th>
                <th>Status</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              {loading ||
              leadsLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={10}
                    className="pay-empty-row"
                  >
                    Loading clients…
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : paginated.length ===
                0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={10}
                    className="pay-empty-row"
                  >
                    No clients found.
                  </td>
                </tr>

                paginated.map(
                  ({
                    lead,
                    payment: pay,
                  }) => {

                      pay?.organizationName ||
                      leadOrganizationName(lead) ||
                      '--';

                    const address =
                      pay?.address ||
                      leadAddress(lead) ||
                      '--';

                    const phone =
                      pay?.phone ||
                      leadPhone(lead) ||
                      '--';

                      pay?.email ||
                      leadEmail(lead) ||
                      '--';

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={
                          lead.leadId
                        }
                      >
                        <td>
                          <div className="pay-client-cell">
                            <div
                              className="pay-client-avatar"
                              style={{
                                background:
                                  avatarColor(
                                    orgName
                                  ),
                              }}
                            >
                              {initials(
                                orgName
                              )}
                            </div>

                              <div className="pay-client-name">

                              </div>

                            '--'}
                        </td>

                            {pay
                              ? fmtINR(
                                  pay.totalAmount
                                )
                              : '--'}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={
                              pay?.amountPaid >
                              0
                                ? 'pay-amount-paid'
                                : 'pay-amount-zero'
                            }
                          >
                            {pay
                              ? fmtINR(
                                  pay.amountPaid
                                )
                              : '--'}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={
                              pay?.balanceAmount >
                              0

                                : 'pay-amount-zero'
                            }
                          >
                            {pay
                              ? fmtINR(
                                  pay.balanceAmount
                                )
                              : '--'}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <StatusBadge
                            status={
                              pay?.status ||
                              'No Payment'
                            }
                          />
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <div className="pay-action-group">
                            {pay ? (

                                  className="pay-act-btn view"
                                  title="View Details"
                                  aria-label="View Details"

                                      pay

                                    setFormPay(

                                      aria-label="Send Invoice to Client"
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        setSendModal(
                                          {
                                            payment:
                                              pay,
                                            mode: 'invoice',
                                          }
                                        )
                                      }
                                    >
                                      <FaWhatsapp />
                                    </button>
                                  )}

                                {pay.invoiceId && (
                                  <button
                                    className="pay-act-btn download"
                                    title="Download Invoice"
                                    aria-label="Download Invoice"
                                    onClick={() =>
                                      handleDownloadInvoice(
                                        pay
                                      )
                                    }
                                  >
                                    <FiDownload />
                                  </button>
                                )}
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              // ─────────────────────────────
                              // ONLY UI CHANGE:
                              // "Start Payment" text removed.
                              // Existing functionality is unchanged.
                              // ─────────────────────────────
                              <button
                                className="pay-act-btn view"
                                title="Start Payment Request"
                                aria-label="Start Payment Request"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setFormPresetLead(
                                    lead
                                  );
                                  setFormPay(
                                    null
                                  );
                                }}
                              >
                                <FiPlus />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  }
                )
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="pay-pagination-bar">
          <div className="pay-rows-select">
            Rows per page:

            <select
              value={rowsPerPage}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRowsPerPage(
                  Number(e.target.value)
                );
                setPage(1);
              }}
            >
              {ROWS_OPTIONS.map((r) => (
                <option key={r}>
                  {r}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="pay-page-nums">
            <button
              className="pay-pg-btn"
              disabled={page === 1}
              onClick={() =>
                setPage(
                  (p) => p - 1
                )
              }
            >
              <FiChevronLeft
                size={13}
              />
            </button>

            {pgRange().map(
              (p, i) =>
                p === '...' ? (
                  <span
                    key={`d${i}`}
                    style={{
                      padding: '0 4px',
                      color:
                        'var(--text-light)',
                    }}
                  >
                    …
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    key={p}
                    className={`pay-pg-btn${
                      page === p
                        ? ' active'
                        : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPage(p)
                    }
                  >
                    {p}
                  </button>
                )
            )}

            <button
              className="pay-pg-btn"
              disabled={
                page === totalPages
              }
              onClick={() =>
                setPage(
                  (p) => p + 1
                )
              }
            >
              <FiChevronRight
                size={13}
              />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {viewPay && (
        <ViewPaymentModal
          payment={viewPay}
          previous={(paymentsByLead[viewPay.leadId] || []).filter(
            (p) => p.id !== viewPay.id
          )}
          qr={qr}
          onClose={() =>
            setViewPay(null)
          }
          onDownloadInvoice={
            handleDownloadInvoice
          }
          onSendPayment={() => {
            setSendModal({
              payment: viewPay,
              mode: 'payment',
            });

            setViewPay(null);
          }}
          onSendInvoice={() => {
            setSendModal({
              payment: viewPay,
              mode: 'invoice',
            });

            setViewPay(null);
          }}
          onAddRecord={() =>
            setRecordPay(viewPay)
          }
        />
      )}

      {formPay !== undefined && (
        <PaymentFormModal
          initial={formPay}
          paymentsByLead={paymentsByLead}
          presetLead={
            formPay
              ? null
              : formPresetLead
          }
          onClose={() => {
            setFormPay(undefined);
            setFormPresetLead(null);
          }}
          onSave={handleSaveForm}
        />
      )}

      {recordPay && (
        <PaymentRecordModal
          payment={recordPay}
          onClose={() =>
            setRecordPay(null)
          }
          onSave={(payload) =>
            handleAddRecord(
              recordPay,
              payload
            )
          }
        />
      )}

      {sendModal && (
        <SendModal
          payment={
            sendModal.payment
          }
          mode={sendModal.mode}
          qr={qr}
          onClose={() =>
            setSendModal(null)
          }
          onSent={(channel) =>
            sendModal.mode ===
            'invoice'
              ? handleSendInvoice(
                  sendModal.payment,
                  channel
                )
              : handleSendPaymentDetails(
                  sendModal.payment,
                  channel
                )
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Payments;

// Reads the saved document (fieldValues.doc) of an existing quotation, or null.
export const parseDoc = (fieldValues, kind) => {
  try {
    const raw = fieldValues && fieldValues.doc;
    if (!raw) return null;
    const d = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    return d && typeof d === 'object' ? { ...defaultDoc(kind), ...d, __kind: kind } : null;
  } catch { return null; }
};

const num = (v) => { const n = parseFloat(String(v ?? '').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, '')); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; };
const inr = (n) => {
  const abs = Math.abs(n).toLocaleString('en-IN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  return `${n < 0 ? '-' : ''}₹${abs}`;
};

const QuotationDocumentEditor = ({ kind, doc, setDoc, form, set, quotationNo }) => {
  const up = (patch) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, ...patch }));
  const upRow = (key, i, patch) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, [key]: d[key].map((r, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)) }));
  const addRow = (key, row) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, [key]: [...(d[key] || []), row] }));
  const delRow = (key, i) => setDoc((d) => ({ ...d, [key]: d[key].filter((_, idx) => idx !== i) }));

  const gstRate = num(doc.gstPercent) / 100;

  // ── ERP numbers ──
  const strength = Math.round(num(doc.strength));

  // ── DM numbers ──
  const pkg = num(doc.package);
  const dmGst = pkg * gstRate;
  const discount = num(doc.discount);
  const extrasTotal = (doc.extras || []).reduce((s, r) => s + num(r.amount), 0);
  const finalAmount = pkg + dmGst - discount + extrasTotal;

  const notesBlock = (
    <div className="qde-notes">
      {(doc.notes || []).map((n, i) => (
        <div className="qde-note" key={i}>
          {kind === 'erp' && <T className="qde-b qde-note-label" value={n.label} onChange={(v) => upRow('notes', i, { label: v })} placeholder="Label:" />}
          {kind === 'erp'
            ? <TA value={n.text} onChange={(v) => upRow('notes', i, { text: v })} />
            : <T className="qde-b" value={n.text} onChange={(v) => upRow('notes', i, { text: v })} placeholder="Note (e.g. GST Applicable.)" />}
          <Del onClick={() => delRow('notes', i)} title="Remove line" />
        </div>
      ))}
      <Add onClick={() => addRow('notes', kind === 'erp' ? { label: '', text: '' } : { text: '' })}>Add note line</Add>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="qde-wrap">
      <div className="qde-hint">Edit the quotation exactly as it will appear in the PDF. Click any text to change it; use + / 🗑 to add or remove rows.</div>
      <div className="qde-page">
        {/* letterhead */}
        <div className="qde-ribbon-tr" />
        <div className="qde-head">
          <div className="qde-logo">INDO</div>
          <div className="qde-brand">
        
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="qde-body">
          <T className="qde-title qde-b" value={doc.title} onChange={(v) => up({ title: v })} />

          {/* quotation no. + date */}
          <div className={`qde-meta ${kind === 'dm' ? 'qde-meta-right' : ''}`}>
            <div><b>Quotation No.:</b> <span className="qde-auto">{quotationNo || 'auto-generated on save'}</span></div>
            <div className="qde-inline"><b>Date:</b> <T value={doc.date} onChange={(v) => up({ date: v })} style={{ width: 120 }} /></div>
          </div>

          {/* To / org / attn / subject */}
          <div className="qde-inline"><b>To:</b> <T value={doc.attn} onChange={(v) => up({ attn: v })} placeholder="The Principal" /></div>
          {kind === 'erp'
            ? <T className="qde-b qde-org" value={form.organization} onChange={(v) => set('organization', v)} placeholder="SCHOOL / ORGANIZATION NAME" />
            : <>
                <div className="qde-inline"><b>Organization:</b> <T value={form.organization} onChange={(v) => set('organization', v)} /></div>
                <div className="qde-inline"><b>Location:</b> <T value={form.address} onChange={(v) => set('address', v)} placeholder="Address" /></div>
              </>}
          <div className="qde-inline"><b>Subject:</b> <T value={form.subject} onChange={(v) => set('subject', v)}
            placeholder={kind === 'erp' ? 'ERP, Student Strength ( 150 )' : 'Digital Marketing Services'} /></div>

          {kind === 'erp' ? (
            <>
              <div className="qde-inline qde-strength"><b>Student Strength:</b> <T value={doc.strength} onChange={(v) => up({ strength: v })} style={{ width: 90 }} placeholder="150" />
                <b style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>GST %:</b> <T value={doc.gstPercent} onChange={(v) => up({ gstPercent: v })} style={{ width: 50 }} /></div>

              <div className="qde-table qde-erp">
                <div className="qde-tr qde-th"><div>Service</div><div>Per Student</div><div>Amount</div><div>GST</div><div>Total</div></div>
                {doc.plans.map((p, i) => {
                  const amount = num(p.rate) * strength; const gst = amount * gstRate;
                  return (
                    <div className="qde-tr" key={i}>
                      <div><T className="qde-b" value={p.name} onChange={(v) => upRow('plans', i, { name: v })} /></div>
                      <div className="qde-c"><T className="qde-b qde-c" value={p.rate} onChange={(v) => upRow('plans', i, { rate: v })} /></div>
                      <div className="qde-c">{inr(amount)}</div>
                      <div className="qde-c">{inr(gst)}</div>
                      <div className="qde-c">{inr(amount + gst)}</div>
                      <Del onClick={() => delRow('plans', i)} />
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                {doc.freeRows.map((r, i) => (
                  <div className="qde-tr qde-free" key={`f${i}`}>
                    <div><T className="qde-b" value={r.label} onChange={(v) => upRow('freeRows', i, { label: v })} /></div>
                    <div className="qde-span"><T className="qde-b" value={r.text} onChange={(v) => upRow('freeRows', i, { text: v })} /></div>
                    <Del onClick={() => delRow('freeRows', i)} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="qde-addrow">
                <Add onClick={() => addRow('plans', { name: 'New Plan – Per Student/Year', rate: '' })}>Add plan row</Add>
                <Add onClick={() => addRow('freeRows', { label: '', text: '' })}>Add free / info row</Add>
              </div>
              {notesBlock}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="qde-table qde-dm">
                <div className="qde-tr qde-th"><div>Service</div><div>Qty</div></div>
                {doc.services.map((s, i) => (
                  <div className="qde-tr" key={i}>
                    <div><T value={s.name} onChange={(v) => upRow('services', i, { name: v })} /></div>
                    <div className="qde-c"><T className="qde-c" value={s.qty} onChange={(v) => upRow('services', i, { qty: v })} /></div>
                    <Del onClick={() => delRow('services', i)} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="qde-addrow"><Add onClick={() => addRow('services', { name: '', qty: '' })}>Add service row</Add></div>

              <div className="qde-b qde-sub">Quotation Amount</div>
              <div className="qde-table qde-dm">
                <div className="qde-tr qde-th"><div>Particulars</div><div>Amount</div></div>
                <div className="qde-tr"><div>Package Amount</div><div className="qde-c"><T className="qde-c" value={doc.package} onChange={(v) => up({ package: v })} placeholder="e.g. 16000" /></div></div>
                <div className="qde-tr"><div>GST @ <T value={doc.gstPercent} onChange={(v) => up({ gstPercent: v })} style={{ width: 38, textAlign: 'center' }} />%</div><div className="qde-c">{inr(dmGst)}</div></div>
                <div className="qde-tr"><div>Package Discount <span className="qde-auto">(optional)</span></div><div className="qde-c"><T className="qde-c" value={doc.discount} onChange={(v) => up({ discount: v })} placeholder="0" /></div></div>
                {(doc.extras || []).map((r, i) => (
                  <div className="qde-tr" key={i}>
                    <div><T value={r.label} onChange={(v) => upRow('extras', i, { label: v })} placeholder="Extra charge / adjustment" /></div>
                    <div className="qde-c"><T className="qde-c" value={r.amount} onChange={(v) => upRow('extras', i, { amount: v })} placeholder="+/- amount" /></div>
                    <Del onClick={() => delRow('extras', i)} />
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div className="qde-tr qde-final"><div className="qde-b">Final Amount</div><div className="qde-c qde-b">{inr(finalAmount)}</div></div>
              </div>
              <div className="qde-addrow"><Add onClick={() => addRow('extras', { label: '', amount: '' })}>Add amount row</Add></div>

              <div className="qde-inline"><b>Payment:</b> <T value={doc.payment} onChange={(v) => up({ payment: v })} /></div>
              {notesBlock}
            </>
          )}

          {/* signature */}
          <div className="qde-sign">
            <T className="qde-b qde-sign-co" value={doc.signCompany} onChange={(v) => up({ signCompany: v })} />
            <T value={doc.signName} onChange={(v) => up({ signName: v })} />
            <T value={doc.signTitle} onChange={(v) => up({ signTitle: v })} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* footer */}
        <div className="qde-ribbon-bl" />
        <div className="qde-foot">
          <div><span className="qde-ico"><FiPhone size={12} /></span> 8925811993 / 8925811994</div>
          <div><span className="qde-ico qde-ico-dark"><FiGlobe size={12} /></span> <span className="qde-link">www.indocampas.com</span></div>
          <div><span className="qde-ico"><FiMapPin size={12} /></span> TIDEL NEO - Thiruchitrambalam<br />Koot Road, Tamil Nadu 605111</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QuotationDocumentEditor;

// src/pages/Quotations/Quotations.jsx
import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import './Quotations.css';
import leadService from '../../services/leadService';
import quotationService from '../../services/quotationService';
import templateService from '../../services/templateService';
import {
  FiFileText, FiPlus, FiSearch, FiDownload,
  FiEdit2, FiTrash2, FiEye, FiX, FiCheck,
  FiChevronLeft, FiChevronRight, FiSend, FiRefreshCw,
  FiDollarSign, FiClock, FiCheckCircle, FiAlertCircle,
  FiUser, FiTag, FiMessageCircle, FiMail,
} from 'react-icons/fi';
import { FaWhatsapp } from 'react-icons/fa';
import QuotationDocumentEditor, { kindOfTemplate, defaultDoc, parseDoc } from './QuotationDocumentEditor';

// ─── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// These are the ONLY statuses the backend (QuotationService) understands.
// Draft / Rejected / Revision Required -> editable + submittable by the telecaller.
// Pending Confirmation -> awaiting Super Admin action, locked for editing.
// Approved -> the telecaller (and only the telecaller) can send it to the client.
// Sent to Client -> terminal, read-only reflection for everyone.
const QT_STATUSES = ['Draft', 'Pending Confirmation', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'Revision Required', 'Sent to Client'];
const EDITABLE_STATUSES = new Set(['Draft', 'Rejected', 'Revision Required']);
const ROWS_OPTIONS = [10, 20, 50];

const AVATAR_COLORS = ['#7b1113', '#2563eb', '#16a34a', '#7c3aed', '#c2410c', '#0369a1', '#4338ca', '#be185d'];

const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  'Draft':                { cls: 'qt-status-draft',    label: 'Draft' },
  'Pending Confirmation':  { cls: 'qt-status-sent',      label: 'Pending Approval' },
  'Approved':              { cls: 'qt-status-approved',  label: 'Approved' },
  'Rejected':              { cls: 'qt-status-rejected',  label: 'Rejected' },
  'Revision Required':     { cls: 'qt-status-revised',   label: 'Revision Required' },
  'Sent to Client':        { cls: 'qt-status-viewed',    label: 'Sent to Client' },
};

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const avatarColor = (name) => AVATAR_COLORS[(name?.charCodeAt(0) || 0) % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
const initials = (name) => name?.split(' ').slice(0, 2).map(w => w[0]?.toUpperCase()).join('') || '?';
const fmtDateTime = (iso) => {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  return d.toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};
const currentUserName = () => {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}').name || 'You'; } catch { return 'You'; }
};

// ─── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Toast = ({ msg, type, onClose }) => (
  <div className={`qt-toast qt-toast-${type}`} onClick={onClose}>
    {type === 'success' ? <FiCheck /> : type === 'error' ? <FiX /> : <FiRefreshCw />}
    {msg}
  </div>
);

// ─── Status Pill ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const StatusPill = ({ status }) => {
  const cfg = STATUS_CONFIG[status] || { cls: '', label: status || '—' };
  return <span className={`qt-status-pill ${cfg.cls}`}>{cfg.label}</span>;
};

// ─── Create / Edit Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const QuotationFormModal = ({ initial, leads, templates, onClose, onSave }) => {
  const isEdit = !!initial?.id;
  const [leadSearch, setLeadSearch] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    leadId: initial?.leadId || '', templateId: initial?.templateId || (templates.find(t => !t.serviceType || String(t.serviceType).toLowerCase() === String(initial?.serviceType || 'ERP').toLowerCase())?.id || ''),
    serviceType: initial?.serviceType || 'ERP', clientName: initial?.clientName || '',
    organization: initial?.organization || '', email: initial?.email || '', phone: initial?.phone || '', address: initial?.address || '',
    subject: initial?.subject || '', validTill: initial?.validTill || '', notes: initial?.notes || '', fieldValues: initial?.fieldValues || {},
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const set = (k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const filteredLeads = useMemo(() => { const q = leadSearch.trim().toLowerCase(); return !q ? leads : leads.filter(l => Object.values(l || {}).some(v => String(v ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q))); }, [leads, leadSearch]);
  const selectedLead = leads.find(l => l.leadId === form.leadId);
  const leadLabel = l => `${l.name || 'Unnamed'} — ${l.mobile || l.phoneNumber || l.phone || 'No mobile'}${l.email ? ` — ${l.email}` : ''}`;
  const availableTemplates = useMemo(() => templates.filter(t => !t.serviceType || String(t.serviceType).toLowerCase() === String(form.serviceType).toLowerCase()), [templates, form.serviceType]);
  const selectedTemplate = availableTemplates.find(t => t.id === form.templateId);
  const AUTO_KEYS = new Set(['clientName','organization','email','phone','subject','validTill','notes','leadId','date']);
  const customFields = (selectedTemplate?.fields || []).filter(f => f.mapsTo && !AUTO_KEYS.has(f.mapsTo));
  // Built-in IndoCampas templates use the WYSIWYG document editor instead of simple fields.
  const builtinKind = kindOfTemplate(selectedTemplate);
  const [doc, setDoc] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!builtinKind) { setDoc(null); return; }
    setDoc(prev => (prev && prev.__kind === builtinKind) ? prev : (parseDoc(form.fieldValues, builtinKind) || defaultDoc(builtinKind)));
  }, [builtinKind]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!builtinKind || !doc) return;
    if (builtinKind === 'erp') {
      const n = Math.round(parseFloat(doc.strength));
      if (n > 0 && (!form.subject.trim() || /^ERP(, Student Strength \( \d+ \))?$/.test(form.subject.trim()))) set('subject', `ERP, Student Strength ( ${n} )`);
    } else if (!form.subject.trim()) set('subject', 'Digital Marketing Services');
  }, [builtinKind, doc?.strength, !!doc]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!form.templateId || !availableTemplates.some(t => t.id === form.templateId)) {
      set('templateId', availableTemplates[0]?.id || '');
    }
  }, [form.serviceType, availableTemplates]);
  const selectLead = leadId => { const l = leads.find(x => x.leadId === leadId); if (!l) return set('leadId', leadId); setLeadSearch(leadLabel(l)); setForm(f => ({ ...f, leadId, clientName:l.name||'', organization:l.school||l.organization||l.company||l.name||'', email:l.email||'', phone:l.mobile||l.phoneNumber||l.phone||'', address:l.schoolAddress||l.address||l.area||'' })); };
  const handleLeadSearchChange = value => { setLeadSearch(value); const match = leads.find(l => leadLabel(l) === value || l.leadId === value); if (match) selectLead(match.leadId); };
  const handleSave = async () => { setError(''); if (!form.leadId) return setError('Please select a client / lead.'); if (!form.templateId) return setError('Please select a quotation template.'); if (!form.subject.trim()) return setError('Subject is required.'); if (!form.clientName.trim()) return setError('Client name is required.'); setSaving(true); try { const payload = { leadId:form.leadId, templateId:form.templateId, serviceType:form.serviceType, clientName:form.clientName, organization:form.organization, email:form.email, phone:form.phone, address:form.address, subject:form.subject, validTill:form.validTill, notes:form.notes, fieldValues:(builtinKind&&doc)?{...form.fieldValues,doc:JSON.stringify(doc)}:form.fieldValues }; const saved=isEdit?await quotationService.update(initial.id,payload):await quotationService.create(payload); onSave(saved,isEdit); } catch(e){ setError(e.message||'Unable to save quotation.'); } finally { setSaving(false); } };
  return <div className="qt-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}><div className="qt-modal-box qt-modal-box-wide" onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}><div className="qt-modal-header"><div className="qt-modal-title">{isEdit?`Edit ${initial.id}`:'New Quotation'}</div><button className="qt-modal-close" onClick={onClose}><FiX /></button></div><div className="qt-modal-body"><div className="qt-form">
    {error&&<div className="qt-client-autofill" style={{borderColor:'#fecaca',background:'#fef2f2'}}><div className="qt-client-autofill-label" style={{color:'#b91c1c'}}><FiAlertCircle size={12}/> {error}</div></div>}
    <div className="qt-form-section"><div className="qt-form-section-title">Client / Lead</div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Lead Selection *</label><input list="quotation-leads" placeholder="Click and search by name, mobile or email" value={leadSearch} onChange={e=>handleLeadSearchChange(e.target.value)} disabled={isEdit}/><datalist id="quotation-leads">{filteredLeads.map(l=><option key={l.leadId} value={leadLabel(l)} />)}</datalist></div>{selectedLead&&<div className="qt-client-autofill"><div className="qt-client-autofill-label">Lead selected — details can be edited below before submission</div></div>}<div className="qt-form-row"><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Client Name *</label><input value={form.clientName} onChange={e=>set('clientName',e.target.value)}/></div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Mobile Number</label><input value={form.phone} onChange={e=>set('phone',e.target.value)}/></div></div><div className="qt-form-row"><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Email Address</label><input type="email" value={form.email} onChange={e=>set('email',e.target.value)}/></div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Company / Organization</label><input value={form.organization} onChange={e=>set('organization',e.target.value)}/></div></div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Address</label><textarea value={form.address} onChange={e=>set('address',e.target.value)}/></div></div>
    <div className="qt-form-section"><div className="qt-form-section-title">Quotation Details</div><div className="qt-form-row"><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Service Type *</label><select value={form.serviceType} onChange={e=>set('serviceType',e.target.value)}><option value="ERP">ERP</option><option value="Digital Marketing">Digital Marketing</option><option value="Online Admission">Online Admission</option></select></div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Template *</label><select value={availableTemplates.some(t=>t.id===form.templateId) ? form.templateId : ''} onChange={e=>set('templateId',e.target.value)}><option value="">— Select a template —</option>{availableTemplates.map(t=><option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>)}</select></div></div><div className="qt-form-row"><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Subject *</label><input placeholder={`Quotation for ${form.serviceType}`} value={form.subject} onChange={e=>set('subject',e.target.value)}/></div><div className="qt-form-group"><label>Valid Till</label><input type="date" value={form.validTill} onChange={e=>set('validTill',e.target.value)}/></div></div>{!builtinKind&&<div className="qt-form-group"><label>Notes / Service Details</label><textarea placeholder="Scope, inclusions, service details and terms…" value={form.notes} onChange={e=>set('notes',e.target.value)}/></div>}</div>
    {builtinKind&&doc&&<QuotationDocumentEditor kind={builtinKind} doc={doc} setDoc={setDoc} form={form} set={set} quotationNo={initial?.quotationNo}/>}
    {customFields.length>0&&!builtinKind&&<div className="qt-form-section"><div className="qt-form-section-title">Template Fields</div>{customFields.map(f=><div className="qt-form-group" key={f.id}><label>{f.label||f.id}</label><input value={form.fieldValues[f.id]||''} onChange={e=>set('fieldValues',{...form.fieldValues,[f.id]:e.target.value})}/></div>)}</div>}
    <div className="qt-form-actions"><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button><button className="qt-btn-primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}><FiCheck size={13}/> {saving?'Saving…':isEdit?'Save Changes':'Create Quotation (Draft)'}</button></div>
  </div></div></div></div>;
};

      </div>
      <div className="qt-view-grid">
