        <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Valid Till</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.validTill || '—'}</span></div>
        <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Email</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.email || '—'}</span></div>
        <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Phone</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.phone || '—'}</span></div>
        {quotation.status === 'Rejected' && <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Rejection Reason</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.rejectionReason}</span></div>}
        {quotation.status === 'Revision Required' && <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Revision Notes</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.revisionReason}</span></div>}
        {quotation.approvalRemark && <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Approval Remark</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.approvalRemark}</span></div>}
        {quotation.sent && <div className="qt-view-row"><span className="qt-view-key">Sent</span><span className="qt-view-val">{quotation.sentChannel} · {fmtDateTime(quotation.sentAt)}</span></div>}
      </div>
      {quotation.notes && (
        <div className="qt-view-note">
          <div className="qt-view-note-label">Notes</div>
          <div className="qt-view-note-text">{quotation.notes}</div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="qt-timeline">
        <div className="qt-timeline-title">History</div>
        <div className="qt-timeline-list">
          {(quotation.timeline || []).map((t, i) => (
            <div className="qt-timeline-item" key={i}>
              <div className="qt-timeline-left">
                <div className="qt-timeline-dot" style={{ background: t.bg, color: t.color }}>•</div>
                {i < quotation.timeline.length - 1 && <div className="qt-timeline-line" />}
              </div>
              <div className="qt-timeline-content">
                <div className="qt-timeline-action">{t.action}</div>
                <div className="qt-timeline-time">{t.time}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="qt-form-actions" style={{ padding: '0 24px 24px' }}>
        {quotation.generatedPdfPath && (
          <button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={() => onDownload(quotation)}><FiDownload size={13} /> Download PDF</button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
);

// ─── Main Quotations Page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Quotations = () => {
  const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState([]);
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState([]);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('All');
  const [filterServiceType, setFilterServiceType] = useState('All');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editQt, setEditQt] = useState(null);
  const [viewQt, setViewQt] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  const showToast = useCallback((msg, type = 'success') => {
    setToast({ msg, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
  }, []);

  const loadAll = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Fetch every page instead of assuming that all eligible leads fit in one
      // fixed page. This keeps the quotation lead selector in sync with Leads.
      const fetchAllLeads = async () => {
        const first = await leadService.getLeads(0, 1000);
        if (Array.isArray(first)) return first;

        const all = [...(Array.isArray(first?.content) ? first.content : [])];
        const totalPages = Number(first?.totalPages || 1);
        if (totalPages <= 1) return all;

        const pages = await Promise.all(
          Array.from({ length: totalPages - 1 }, (_, index) =>
            leadService.getLeads(index + 1, 1000)
          )
        );
        pages.forEach(result => {
          if (Array.isArray(result?.content)) all.push(...result.content);
        });

        // Avoid duplicate lead entries when the backend returns overlapping data.
        const seen = new Set();
        return all.filter(lead => {
          const key = lead?.leadId || lead?.id;
          if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;
          seen.add(key);
          return true;
        });
      };

      const [allLeads, quoteList, templateList] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAllLeads(),
        quotationService.getAll(),
        templateService.list(),
      ]);
      setLeads(allLeads);
      setQuotations(Array.isArray(quoteList) ? quoteList : []);
      setTemplates(Array.isArray(templateList) ? templateList : []);
    } catch (e) {
      showToast(e.message || 'Failed to load quotations.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [showToast]);

  useEffect(() => { loadAll(); }, [loadAll]);

  const upsert = (q) => setQuotations(prev => {
    const exists = prev.some(x => x.id === q.id);
    return exists ? prev.map(x => x.id === q.id ? q : x) : [q, ...prev];
  });

  // ── Stats ──
  const stats = useMemo(() => ({
    total: quotations.length,
    pendingApproval: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Pending Approval' || q.status === 'Pending Confirmation').length,
    approved: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Approved').length,
    sent: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Sent' || q.status === 'Sent to Client').length,
    value: quotations
      .filter(q => q.status === 'Sent' || q.status === 'Sent to Client')
      .reduce((s, q) => s + (q.amount || 0), 0),
  }), [quotations]);

  const TABS = [
    { id: 'All', label: 'All', count: quotations.length },
    { id: 'Draft', label: 'Draft', count: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Draft').length },
    { id: 'Pending Approval', label: 'Pending Approval', count: stats.pendingApproval },
    { id: 'Approved', label: 'Approved', count: stats.approved },
    { id: 'Rejected', label: 'Rejected', count: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Rejected').length },
    { id: 'Revision Required', label: 'Revision Required', count: quotations.filter(q => q.status === 'Revision Required').length },
    { id: 'Sent', label: 'Sent to Client', count: stats.sent },
  ];

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let d = [...quotations];
    if (filterStatus !== 'All') {
      d = d.filter(q => {
        if (filterStatus === 'Sent') return q.status === 'Sent' || q.status === 'Sent to Client';
        if (filterStatus === 'Pending Approval') return q.status === 'Pending Approval' || q.status === 'Pending Confirmation';
        return q.status === filterStatus;
      });
    }
    if (filterServiceType !== 'All') {
      d = d.filter(x => (x.serviceType || 'ERP') === filterServiceType);
    }
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      d = d.filter(x =>
        (x.id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (x.clientName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (x.subject || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (x.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }
    return d;
  }, [quotations, filterStatus, filterServiceType, search]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / rowsPerPage));
  const paginated = filtered.slice((page - 1) * rowsPerPage, page * rowsPerPage);
  const pageNums = () => {
    const nums = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - page) <= 1) nums.push(i);
      else if (nums[nums.length - 1] !== '...') nums.push('...');
    }
    return nums;
  };

  // ── Actions ──
  const handleSaved = (q, isEdit) => {
    upsert(q);
    setShowForm(false);
    setEditQt(null);
    showToast(isEdit ? 'Quotation updated.' : `${q.id} created as Draft.`);
  };

  const handleSubmitForApproval = async (id) => {
    try {
      const saved = await quotationService.submit(id);
      upsert(saved);
      showToast('Sent to Super Admin for confirmation.');
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to submit.', 'error'); }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this quotation permanently?')) return;
    try {
      await quotationService.remove(id);
      setQuotations(prev => prev.filter(x => x.id !== id));
      showToast('Quotation deleted.', 'error');
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to delete.', 'error'); }
  };

  const handleSend = async (id, channel) => {
    try {
      const saved = await quotationService.markSent(id, channel);
      upsert(saved);
      showToast(`Sent to ${saved.clientName} via ${channel}.`);
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to send.', 'error'); throw e; }
  };

  // WhatsApp / Email are sent straight from the browser — no backend WhatsApp/SMTP
  // integration involved. We download the PDF for the telecaller to attach, open
  // WhatsApp Web / the mail client with the message pre-filled, then mark the
  // quotation as Sent so Super Admin + telecaller both see it move to "Sent".
  const handleWhatsAppSend = async (q) => {
    try {
      await handleDownload(q);
      const digits = (q.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      const phone = digits.length === 10 ? `91${digits}` : digits;
      const msg = `Hi ${q.clientName || ''}, please find your ${q.serviceType || 'ERP'} quotation "${q.subject || ''}" attached. (Ref: ${q.id})`; 
      if (phone) window.open(`https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank');
      else showToast('No phone number on this quotation — opening WhatsApp Web without a recipient.', 'error');
      await handleSend(q.id, 'WhatsApp');
    } catch (e) { /* handleSend already toasts */ }
  };

  const handleEmailSend = async (q) => {
    try {
      await handleDownload(q);
      const subject = `Quotation ${q.id} — ${q.subject || ''}`;
      const body = `Hi ${q.clientName || ''},\n\nPlease find your quotation attached (downloaded to your device — attach it to this email).\n\nService Type: ${q.serviceType || 'ERP'}\nSubject: ${q.subject || ''}\nRef: ${q.id}\n\nRegards.`;
      if (q.email) window.open(`mailto:${q.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`, '_blank');
      else showToast('No email address on this quotation — opening mail client without a recipient.', 'error');
      await handleSend(q.id, 'Email');
    } catch (e) { /* handleSend already toasts */ }
  };

  const handleDownload = async (q) => {
    try {
      const blob = await quotationService.downloadPdfBlob(q.id);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url; a.download = q.generatedPdfFileName || `Quotation_${q.id}.pdf`;
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to download PDF.', 'error'); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="qt-page">
      {toast && <Toast msg={toast.msg} type={toast.type} onClose={() => setToast(null)} />}

      <div className="qt-page-header">
        <div>
          <div className="qt-page-title">Quotations</div>
          <div className="qt-breadcrumb">Prepare a quotation, send it for Super Admin confirmation, then deliver it to the client once approved.</div>
        </div>
        <div className="qt-header-actions">
          <button className="qt-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}>
            <FiPlus size={15} /> New Quotation
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="qt-stats-row">
        <div className="qt-stat-card" style={{ borderTop: '3px solid #7b1113' }}>
          <div className="qt-stat-icon" style={{ background: '#fce8e8', color: '#7b1113' }}><FiFileText /></div>
          <div className="qt-stat-info"><div className="qt-stat-val">{stats.total}</div><div className="qt-stat-label">Total Quotes</div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="qt-stat-card" style={{ borderTop: '3px solid #1d4ed8' }}>
          <div className="qt-stat-icon" style={{ background: '#dbeafe', color: '#1d4ed8' }}><FiClock /></div>
          <div className="qt-stat-info"><div className="qt-stat-val">{stats.pendingApproval}</div><div className="qt-stat-label">Awaiting Super Admin</div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="qt-stat-card" style={{ borderTop: '3px solid #15803d' }}>
          <div className="qt-stat-icon" style={{ background: '#dcfce7', color: '#15803d' }}><FiCheckCircle /></div>
          <div className="qt-stat-info"><div className="qt-stat-val">{stats.approved}</div><div className="qt-stat-label">Ready to Send</div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="qt-stat-card" style={{ borderTop: '3px solid #4338ca' }}>
          <div className="qt-stat-icon" style={{ background: '#e0e7ff', color: '#4338ca' }}><FiDollarSign /></div>
          <div className="qt-stat-info"><div className="qt-stat-val">₹{stats.value.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div><div className="qt-stat-label">Sent to Clients</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="qt-table-card">
        <div className="qt-tabs-row">
          {TABS.map(t => (
            <div key={t.id} className={`qt-tab ${filterStatus === t.id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setFilterStatus(t.id); setPage(1); }}>
              {t.label} <span className="qt-tab-badge">{t.count}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="qt-filter-bar">
          <select value={filterServiceType} onChange={e => { setFilterServiceType(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} aria-label="Filter by service type">
            <option value="All">All Services</option><option value="ERP">ERP</option><option value="Digital Marketing">Digital Marketing</option><option value="Online Admission">Online Admission</option>
          </select>
          <div className="qt-search-wrap">
            <FiSearch className="qt-search-ico" />
            <input className="qt-search-input" placeholder="Search by client, subject or ID…" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="qt-table-wrap">
          {loading ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Loading leads, templates and quotations…</div>
          ) : (
            <table className="qt-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Quote #</th><th>Client</th><th>Subject</th><th>Service Type</th><th>Status</th><th>Updated</th><th>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {paginated.length === 0 && (
                  <tr className="qt-empty-row"><td colSpan={7}>No quotations found.</td></tr>
                )}
                {paginated.map(q => (
                  <tr key={q.id}>
                    <td className="qt-quote-no">{q.id}</td>
                    <td>
                      <div className="qt-client-cell">
                        <div className="qt-client-avatar" style={{ background: avatarColor(q.clientName) }}>{initials(q.clientName)}</div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="qt-client-name">{q.clientName}</div>
                          <div className="qt-client-email">{q.email}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td>{q.subject}</td>
                    <td>{q.serviceType || 'ERP'}</td>
                    <td><StatusPill status={q.status} /></td>
                    <td>{fmtDateTime(q.updatedAt)}</td>
                    <td>
                      <div className="qt-action-group">
                        <button className="qt-act-btn view" title="View" onClick={() => setViewQt(q)}><FiEye size={14} /></button>
                        {EDITABLE_STATUSES.has(q.status) && (
                          <button className="qt-act-btn edit" title="Edit" onClick={() => setEditQt(q)}><FiEdit2 size={14} /></button>
                        )}
                        {EDITABLE_STATUSES.has(q.status) && (
                          <button className="qt-act-btn email" title="Send for Super Admin confirmation" onClick={() => handleSubmitForApproval(q.id)}><FiSend size={14} /></button>
                        )}
                        {(q.status === 'Approved' || q.status === 'Sent' || q.status === 'Sent to Client') && (
                          <>
                            <button className="qt-act-btn whatsapp" title="Send / Resend via WhatsApp" onClick={() => handleWhatsAppSend(q)}><FaWhatsapp size={14} /></button>
                            <button className="qt-act-btn mail" title="Send / Resend via Email" onClick={() => handleEmailSend(q)}><FiMail size={14} /></button>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {q.generatedPdfPath && (
                          <button className="qt-act-btn download" title="Download PDF" onClick={() => handleDownload(q)}><FiDownload size={14} /></button>
                        )}
                        {EDITABLE_STATUSES.has(q.status) && (
                          <button className="qt-act-btn del" title="Delete" onClick={() => handleDelete(q.id)}><FiTrash2 size={14} /></button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="qt-pagination-bar">
          <div className="qt-rows-select">
            Rows per page:
            <select value={rowsPerPage} onChange={e => { setRowsPerPage(Number(e.target.value)); setPage(1); }}>
              {ROWS_OPTIONS.map(n => <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="qt-page-nums">
            <button className="qt-pg-btn" disabled={page === 1} onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}><FiChevronLeft /></button>
            {pageNums().map((n, i) => n === '...'
              ? <span key={`e${i}`}>…</span>
              : <button key={n} className={`qt-pg-btn ${page === n ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setPage(n)}>{n}</button>)}
            <button className="qt-pg-btn" disabled={page === totalPages} onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}><FiChevronRight /></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <QuotationFormModal
          initial={null}
          leads={leads}
          templates={templates}
          onClose={() => setShowForm(false)}
          onSave={handleSaved}
        />
      )}
      {editQt && (
        <QuotationFormModal
          initial={editQt}
          leads={leads}
          templates={templates}
          onClose={() => setEditQt(null)}
          onSave={handleSaved}
        />
      )}
      {viewQt && (
        <ViewModal quotation={viewQt} onClose={() => setViewQt(null)} onDownload={handleDownload} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Quotations;

const normalize = (template) => {
  const d = template.design || {};
  let pages = Array.isArray(d.pages) && d.pages.length ? d.pages : [];
  if (!pages.length) pages = [makePage(0, Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : [])];
  pages = pages.map((p, i) => ({
    ...makePage(i), ...p,
    id: p.id || `page_${i + 1}`,
    name: p.name || `Page ${i + 1}`,
    backgroundColor: p.backgroundColor || d.backgroundColor || '#FFFFFF',
    headerEnabled: p.headerEnabled !== false,
    headerHeight: Number(p.headerHeight ?? d.headerHeight ?? 0.16),
    headerLayout: p.headerLayout || d.headerLayout || 'logo-left',
    footerEnabled: p.footerEnabled !== false,
    footerHeight: Number(p.footerHeight ?? d.footerHeight ?? 0.12),
    footerLayout: p.footerLayout || d.footerLayout || 'contact-left',
    blocks: Array.isArray(p.blocks) ? p.blocks : [],
  }));
  return {
    mode: d.mode || (template.storedOriginalPath ? 'BACKGROUND' : 'BUILDER'),
    pageSize: d.pageSize || 'A4', orientation: d.orientation || 'PORTRAIT',
    backgroundColor: d.backgroundColor || '#FFFFFF', primaryColor: d.primaryColor || '#7B1113',
    secondaryColor: d.secondaryColor || '#172554', accentColor: d.accentColor || '#DC2626',
    textColor: d.textColor || '#111827', headingColor: d.headingColor || '#111827',
    fontFamily: d.fontFamily || 'Helvetica', fontDataUrl: d.fontDataUrl || '', logoDataUrl: d.logoDataUrl || '',
    companyName: d.companyName || 'Your Company Name', companySubtitle: d.companySubtitle || '',
    companyAddress: d.companyAddress || '', companyPhone: d.companyPhone || '', companyEmail: d.companyEmail || '',
    companyWebsite: d.companyWebsite || '', companyGstNumber: d.companyGstNumber || '',
    headerEnabled: d.headerEnabled !== false, headerHeight: Number(d.headerHeight ?? 0.16),
    headerLayout: d.headerLayout || 'logo-left', footerEnabled: d.footerEnabled !== false,
    footerHeight: Number(d.footerHeight ?? 0.12), footerLayout: d.footerLayout || 'contact-left',
    marginLeft: Number(d.marginLeft ?? 0.08), marginRight: Number(d.marginRight ?? 0.08),
    marginTop: Number(d.marginTop ?? 0.05), marginBottom: Number(d.marginBottom ?? 0.05),
    blocks: Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : [], pages,

};

const QuotationTemplateDesigner = ({ template, onClose, onSaved, showToast }) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState(template.name || 'Quotation Template');
  const [design, setDesign] = useState(() => normalize(template));
  const [fields, setFields] = useState(template.fields || []);

  const fieldDragRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let url;
    if (template.storedPreviewPath) templateService.previewUrl(template.id).then(u => { url = u; setPreviewUrl(u); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
  }, [template.id, template.storedPreviewPath]);

  const updateDesign = patch => setDesign(prev => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));
  const LOCKED_LETTERHEAD_KEYS = new Set([
    'headerEnabled', 'headerHeight', 'headerLayout',
    'footerEnabled', 'footerHeight', 'footerLayout',
  ]);
  const updatePage = patch => {
    const editablePatch = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(patch).filter(([key]) => !LOCKED_LETTERHEAD_KEYS.has(key))
    );
    setDesign(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      pages: prev.pages.map((p, i) => i === pageIndex ? { ...p, ...editablePatch } : p)
    }));
  };
  const updateBlock = (id, patch) => updatePage({ blocks: blocks.map(b => b.id === id ? { ...b, ...patch } : b) });
  const deleteBlock = id => { updatePage({ blocks: blocks.filter(b => b.id !== id) }); if (selectedId === id) setSelectedId(null); };

  const addPage = () => {
    const p = makePage(pages.length, []); setDesign(prev => ({ ...prev, pages: [...prev.pages, p] })); setPageIndex(pages.length); setSelectedId(null);
  };
  const duplicatePage = () => {
    if (!currentPage) return;
    const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPage)); clone.id = `page_${Date.now()}`; clone.name = `${currentPage.name} Copy`;
    clone.blocks = clone.blocks.map((b, i) => ({ ...b, id: `b_${Date.now()}_${i}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,5)}` }));
    const next = [...pages]; next.splice(pageIndex + 1, 0, clone); setDesign(prev => ({ ...prev, pages: next })); setPageIndex(pageIndex + 1); setSelectedId(null);
  };
  const deletePage = () => {
    if (pages.length <= 1) { showToast('At least one page is required.', 'error'); return; }
    const next = pages.filter((_, i) => i !== pageIndex); setDesign(prev => ({ ...prev, pages: next })); setPageIndex(Math.min(pageIndex, next.length - 1)); setSelectedId(null);
  };
  const renamePage = nameValue => updatePage({ name: nameValue || `Page ${pageIndex + 1}` });

  const addBlock = type => {
    const b = makeBlock(type, blocks.length, type === 'heading' ? 0.28 : 0.32);
    if (type === 'heading') b.color = design.headingColor;
    if (type === 'table') { b.height = 0.18; b.text = ''; }
    if (type === 'image') { b.height = 0.12; b.width = 0.24; b.text = ''; }
    updatePage({ blocks: [...blocks, b] }); setSelectedId(b.id); setTab('blocks');
  };
  const duplicateBlock = () => {
    if (!selectedBlock) return;
    const copy = { ...selectedBlock, id: `b_${Date.now()}`, x: clamp(selectedBlock.x + 0.02), y: clamp(selectedBlock.y + 0.02) };
    updatePage({ blocks: [...blocks, copy] }); setSelectedId(copy.id);
  };
  const startDrag = (e, block) => {
    if (!isBuilder || e.button !== 0) return; e.stopPropagation();
    const rect = e.currentTarget.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragRef.current = { id: block.id, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, x: block.x, y: block.y, rect };
    setSelectedId(block.id);
    const move = ev => { const r = dragRef.current; if (!r) return; updateBlock(r.id, { x: clamp(r.x + (ev.clientX-r.startX)/r.rect.width), y: clamp(r.y + (ev.clientY-r.startY)/r.rect.height) }); };
    const up = () => { dragRef.current = null; window.removeEventListener('mousemove', move); window.removeEventListener('mouseup', up); };
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', move); window.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
  };

  // ── Fields (amount overlays like svc_erpPro, svc_admissionDashboard) ──
  // These are separate from "blocks": blocks are used in BUILDER mode content;
  // fields are precise x/y/width/height overlay spots — used on top of an
  // uploaded PDF/DOCX background (BACKGROUND mode) — and they double up as
  // the extra input boxes shown in the telecaller's "New Quotation" form
  // (see Quotations.jsx -> customFields) so whatever gets typed there is
  // what should land on that exact spot when the final PDF is generated.
  const makeField = (index) => ({
    id: `fld_${Date.now()}_${index}`,
    label: 'New Field',
    mapsTo: `fld_${Date.now()}_${index}`,
    x: 0.35, y: 0.30 + index * 0.03, width: 0.35, height: 0.024,
    fontSize: 11, align: 'left', verticalAlign: 'middle',
    fontFamily: 'Helvetica', fontWeight: 'normal', color: '#111827',
    bold: false, italic: false, defaultValue: '',
  });
  const addField = () => {
    const f = makeField(fields.length);
    setFields(prev => [...prev, f]);
    setSelectedFieldId(f.id);
    setTab('fields');
  };
  const updateField = (id, patch) => setFields(prev => prev.map(f => f.id === id ? { ...f, ...patch } : f));
  const deleteField = (id) => { setFields(prev => prev.filter(f => f.id !== id)); if (selectedFieldId === id) setSelectedFieldId(null); };

  const startDragField = (e, field) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return; e.stopPropagation();
    const rect = e.currentTarget.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    fieldDragRef.current = { id: field.id, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, x: field.x, y: field.y, rect };
    setSelectedFieldId(field.id); setTab('fields');
    const move = ev => {
      const r = fieldDragRef.current; if (!r) return;
      updateField(r.id, { x: clamp(r.x + (ev.clientX - r.startX) / r.rect.width), y: clamp(r.y + (ev.clientY - r.startY) / r.rect.height) });
    };
    const up = () => { fieldDragRef.current = null; window.removeEventListener('mousemove', move); window.removeEventListener('mouseup', up); };
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', move); window.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
  };

  const importFields = () => {
    setImportError('');
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(importText);
      const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : Array.isArray(parsed.fields) ? parsed.fields : null;
      if (!list) throw new Error('JSON must be an array of fields, or an object with a "fields" array.');
      const cleaned = list.map((f, i) => ({
        id: f.id || f.mapsTo || `fld_${Date.now()}_${i}`,
        label: f.label || f.id || `Field ${i + 1}`,
        mapsTo: f.mapsTo || f.id || `fld_${Date.now()}_${i}`,
        x: clamp(f.x ?? 0.3), y: clamp(f.y ?? 0.3), width: clamp(f.width ?? 0.3, 0.02, 1), height: clamp(f.height ?? 0.024, 0.01, 1),
        fontSize: f.fontSize ?? 11, align: f.align || 'left', verticalAlign: f.verticalAlign || 'middle',
        fontFamily: f.fontFamily || 'Helvetica', fontWeight: f.fontWeight || 'normal', color: f.color || '#111827',
        bold: !!f.bold, italic: !!f.italic, defaultValue: f.defaultValue ?? '',
      }));
      setFields(cleaned);
      setImportText('');
      showToast(`${cleaned.length} field(s) imported. Drag them onto the exact blank spots, then Save.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setImportError(err.message || 'Invalid JSON.');
    }
  };

  const save = async () => {
    try {
      setSaving(true);
      const normalizedDesign = { ...design, blocks: pages[0]?.blocks || [], pages };
      const saved = await templateService.saveDesign(template.id, { name, design: normalizedDesign, fields });
      showToast('Quotation template saved successfully.'); onSaved(saved);
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'Unable to save template.', 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };
  const handleLogo = async e => { const file=e.target.files?.[0]; if(!file)return; try{updateDesign({logoDataUrl:await readImage(file)});}catch{showToast('Unable to read logo.','error');} e.target.value=''; };
  const handleFont = async e => { const file=e.target.files?.[0]; if(!file)return; try{updateDesign({fontDataUrl:await readImage(file),fontFamily:file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'')});}catch{showToast('Unable to read font file.','error');} e.target.value=''; };
  const handleBlockImage = async e => { const file=e.target.files?.[0]; if(!file||!selectedBlock)return; try{updateBlock(selectedBlock.id,{imageDataUrl:await readImage(file)});}catch{showToast('Unable to read image.','error');} e.target.value=''; };

  const pageStyle = { width:'100%', aspectRatio:`${pageRatio}`, position:'relative', overflow:'hidden', background:currentPage?.backgroundColor || design.backgroundColor, boxShadow:'0 10px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.15)', border:'1px solid #d1d5db', userSelect:'none' };
  const backgroundStyle = !isBuilder && previewUrl ? {backgroundImage:`url(${previewUrl})`,backgroundSize:'100% 100%',backgroundPosition:'center',backgroundRepeat:'no-repeat'} : {};

  return (
    <div className="qt-modal-overlay" style={{zIndex:2000}} onClick={e=>e.target===e.currentTarget&&onClose()}>
      <div className="qt-modal-box" style={{width:'min(1500px,98vw)',maxWidth:'1500px',height:'95vh',display:'flex',flexDirection:'column'}}>
        <div className="qt-modal-header"><span className="qt-modal-title"><FiLayout size={16} style={{marginRight:6}}/> Quotation Template Designer — Multi Page</span><button className="qt-modal-close" onClick={onClose}><FiX/></button></div>
        <div style={{padding:'9px 14px',borderBottom:'1px solid #e5e7eb',display:'flex',gap:8,alignItems:'center',flexWrap:'wrap'}}>
          <input value={name} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Template name" style={{width:230,border:'1px solid #d1d5db',borderRadius:7,padding:'8px 10px',fontWeight:700}}/>
          {['design','pages','blocks','fields'].map(t=><button key={t} className={`qt-btn-outline ${tab===t?'active':''}`} onClick={()=>setTab(t)}>{t==='design'?'Branding & Layout':t==='pages'?'Pages':t==='blocks'?'Content Blocks':`Fields (${fields.length})`}</button>)}
          <span style={{flex:1}}/><button className="qt-btn-primary" onClick={save} disabled={saving}><FiSave size={13}/> {saving?'Saving…':'Save Template'}</button>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:'flex',flex:1,minHeight:0}}>
          <div style={{flex:'1 1 auto',overflow:'auto',padding:18,background:'#f1f5f9'}}>
            <div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',justifyContent:'center',gap:8,marginBottom:10}}>
              <button className="qt-btn-outline" disabled={pageIndex===0} onClick={()=>{setPageIndex(pageIndex-1);setSelectedId(null)}}><FiChevronLeft/></button>
              <select value={pageIndex} onChange={e=>{setPageIndex(Number(e.target.value));setSelectedId(null)}} style={{padding:'7px 12px',border:'1px solid #cbd5e1',borderRadius:7,fontWeight:700}}>{pages.map((p,i)=><option key={p.id} value={i}>{i+1}. {p.name}</option>)}</select>
              <button className="qt-btn-outline" disabled={pageIndex===pages.length-1} onClick={()=>{setPageIndex(pageIndex+1);setSelectedId(null)}}><FiChevronRight/></button>
            </div>
            <div style={{maxWidth:760,margin:'0 auto'}}>
              {/* FIX: backgroundStyle (the uploaded template's rendered preview
                  image) was calculated above but never applied here — the
                  canvas only used pageStyle, so an uploaded DOC/DOCX/PDF
                  template's actual look never showed up. Spreading it in
                  makes the uploaded template's format visible again. */}
              <div style={{ ...pageStyle, ...backgroundStyle }}>
                {isBuilder && currentPage?.headerEnabled && <div style={{position:'absolute',inset:'0 0 auto 0',height:`${currentPage.headerHeight*100}%`,background:design.secondaryColor,display:'flex',alignItems:'center',padding:'0 4%',boxSizing:'border-box',color:'#fff',gap:18}}>
                  {design.logoDataUrl && <img src={design.logoDataUrl} alt="logo" style={{width:'10%',maxWidth:72,maxHeight:70,objectFit:'contain'}}/>}
                  <div><div style={{fontSize:22,fontWeight:800}}>{design.companyName||'Your Company Name'}</div>{design.companySubtitle&&<div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:.9}}>{design.companySubtitle}</div>}</div>
                </div>}
                {isBuilder && currentPage?.footerEnabled && <div style={{position:'absolute',inset:'auto 0 0 0',height:`${currentPage.footerHeight*100}%`,background:design.primaryColor,color:'#fff',padding:'1.8% 5%',boxSizing:'border-box',fontSize:9}}><div style={{fontWeight:700}}>{[design.companyPhone,design.companyEmail,design.companyWebsite].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}</div><div>{design.companyAddress}</div><div style={{opacity:.85}}>{design.companyGstNumber&&`GST: ${design.companyGstNumber}`}</div></div>}
                {blocks.map(block=>{
                  const selected=selectedId===block.id;
                  return <div key={block.id} onMouseDown={e=>startDrag(e,block)} onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();setSelectedId(block.id)}} style={{position:'absolute',left:`${block.x*100}%`,top:`${block.y*100}%`,width:`${block.width*100}%`,height:`${block.height*100}%`,boxSizing:'border-box',padding:block.padding,border:selected?`2px solid ${design.accentColor}`:`${block.borderWidth||0}px solid ${block.borderColor||'#d1d5db'}`,borderRadius:block.borderRadius||0,background:block.backgroundColor==='transparent'?'transparent':block.backgroundColor,color:block.color,fontFamily:block.fontFamily||design.fontFamily,fontSize:block.fontSize,fontWeight:block.bold?700:400,fontStyle:block.italic?'italic':'normal',textDecoration:block.underline?'underline':'none',textAlign:block.align,display:'flex',alignItems:block.verticalAlign==='middle'?'center':block.verticalAlign==='bottom'?'flex-end':'flex-start',overflow:'hidden',cursor:isBuilder?'move':'default'}}>
                    {block.type==='image'&&block.imageDataUrl?<img src={block.imageDataUrl} alt="block" style={{width:'100%',height:'100%',objectFit:'contain'}}/>:block.type==='divider'?<div style={{width:'100%',borderTop:`${Math.max(1,block.borderWidth||1)}px solid ${block.color}`}}/>:block.type==='table'?<table style={{width:'100%',height:'100%',borderCollapse:'collapse',fontSize:'inherit'}}><tbody>{(block.tableRows||[]).map((row,r)=><tr key={r}>{row.map((cell,c)=><td key={c} style={{border:`1px solid ${block.borderColor}`,padding:4,background:r===0?design.primaryColor:'#fff',color:r===0?'#fff':block.color}}>{cell}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table>:<div style={{width:'100%',whiteSpace:'pre-wrap'}}>{block.text||'Text block'}</div>}
                    {selected&&<span style={{position:'absolute',right:3,top:2,background:design.accentColor,color:'#fff',fontSize:8,padding:'1px 4px',borderRadius:3}}>{block.type}</span>}
                  </div>;
                })}
                {fields.map(field=>{
                  const fSelected=selectedFieldId===field.id;
                  return <div key={field.id} onMouseDown={e=>startDragField(e,field)} onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();setSelectedFieldId(field.id);setTab('fields')}} title={field.label}
                    style={{position:'absolute',left:`${field.x*100}%`,top:`${field.y*100}%`,width:`${field.width*100}%`,height:`${field.height*100}%`,boxSizing:'border-box',display:'flex',alignItems:field.verticalAlign==='middle'?'center':field.verticalAlign==='bottom'?'flex-end':'flex-start',justifyContent:field.align==='center'?'center':field.align==='right'?'flex-end':'flex-start',padding:'0 3px',background:'rgba(37,99,235,0.10)',border:fSelected?'2px solid #2563eb':'1.5px dashed #2563eb',color:field.color||'#111827',fontFamily:field.fontFamily,fontSize:field.fontSize,fontWeight:field.bold?700:400,fontStyle:field.italic?'italic':'normal',overflow:'hidden',cursor:'move'}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,color:'#1d4ed8',whiteSpace:'nowrap'}}>{field.label}</span>
                    {fSelected&&<span style={{position:'absolute',right:2,top:-18,background:'#2563eb',color:'#fff',fontSize:8,padding:'1px 4px',borderRadius:3,whiteSpace:'nowrap'}}>field · {field.mapsTo}</span>}
                  </div>;
                })}
              </div>
              <div style={{marginTop:8,textAlign:'center',fontSize:11,color:'#64748b'}}>Page {pageIndex+1} of {pages.length} · Drag blocks/fields to position them. Blue dashed boxes = amount fields. Use the right panel for exact layout.</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{width:390,overflow:'auto',borderLeft:'1px solid #e5e7eb',background:'#fff'}}>
            {tab==='design'&&<div style={{padding:16}}>
              <h4 style={{margin:'0 0 12px'}}>Branding</h4>
              {['companyName','companySubtitle','companyAddress','companyPhone','companyEmail','companyWebsite','companyGstNumber'].map(k=><DesignerInput key={k} label={k.replace(/^company/,'').replace(/([A-Z])/g,' $1')} value={design[k]} onChange={v=>updateDesign({[k]:v})}/>)}
              <div style={{marginBottom:12}}><span style={{display:'block',fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:5}}>Logo</span><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>logoRef.current?.click()}><FiUpload size={12}/> Upload Logo</button><input ref={logoRef} hidden type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handleLogo}/>{design.logoDataUrl&&<button className="qt-btn-outline" style={{marginLeft:6}} onClick={()=>updateDesign({logoDataUrl:''})}>Remove</button>}</div>
              <div style={{display:'grid',gridTemplateColumns:'1fr 1fr',gap:8}}>{['primaryColor','secondaryColor','accentColor','textColor','headingColor','backgroundColor'].map(key=><label key={key} style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:'#4b5563'}}>{key.replace('Color','')}<input type="color" value={design[key]||'#000000'} onChange={e=>updateDesign({[key]:e.target.value})} style={{display:'block',width:'100%',height:34,marginTop:4}}/></label>)}</div>
              <div style={{marginTop:12}}><DesignerSelect label="Default Font" value={design.fontFamily} onChange={v=>updateDesign({fontFamily:v})}><option>Helvetica</option><option>Times</option><option>Courier</option>{design.fontDataUrl&&<option value={design.fontFamily}>{design.fontFamily} (uploaded)</option>}</DesignerSelect><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>fontRef.current?.click()}><FiUpload size={12}/> Upload TTF/OTF</button><input ref={fontRef} hidden type="file" accept=".ttf,.otf,font/ttf,font/otf" onChange={handleFont}/></div>
              <div style={{borderTop:'1px solid #e5e7eb',margin:'14px 0',paddingTop:14}}><h4 style={{margin:'0 0 10px'}}>Document</h4><DesignerSelect label="Template Mode" value={design.mode} onChange={v=>updateDesign({mode:v})}><option value="BUILDER">Builder — fully editable</option><option value="BACKGROUND">Uploaded background + fields</option></DesignerSelect><DesignerSelect label="Orientation" value={design.orientation} onChange={v=>updateDesign({orientation:v})}><option>PORTRAIT</option><option>LANDSCAPE</option></DesignerSelect></div>
            </div>}

            {tab==='pages'&&<div style={{padding:16}}>
              <h4 style={{margin:'0 0 10px'}}>Pages</h4>
              <div style={{display:'flex',gap:6,marginBottom:12}}><button className="qt-btn-primary" onClick={addPage}><FiPlus/> Add Page</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={duplicatePage}><FiDuplicate/> Duplicate</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" style={{color:'#dc2626'}} onClick={deletePage}><FiTrash2/></button></div>
              <DesignerInput label="Page Name" value={currentPage?.name} onChange={renamePage}/>
              <label style={{display:'block',fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>Page Background<input type="color" value={currentPage?.backgroundColor||'#ffffff'} onChange={e=>updatePage({backgroundColor:e.target.value})} style={{display:'block',width:'100%',height:34,marginTop:4}}/></label>
              <label style={{display:'flex',gap:8,alignItems:'center',fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}><input type="checkbox" checked={currentPage?.headerEnabled!==false} onChange={e=>updatePage({headerEnabled:e.target.checked})}/> Header on this page</label>
              <DesignerInput label="Header Height (0–1)" type="number" min="0.05" max="0.35" step="0.01" value={currentPage?.headerHeight} onChange={v=>updatePage({headerHeight:clamp(v,.05,.35)})}/>
              <DesignerSelect label="Header Layout" value={currentPage?.headerLayout} onChange={v=>updatePage({headerLayout:v})}><option value="logo-left">Logo Left</option><option value="logo-center">Logo Center</option><option value="logo-right">Logo Right</option></DesignerSelect>
              <label style={{display:'flex',gap:8,alignItems:'center',fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}><input type="checkbox" checked={currentPage?.footerEnabled!==false} onChange={e=>updatePage({footerEnabled:e.target.checked})}/> Footer on this page</label>
              <DesignerInput label="Footer Height (0–1)" type="number" min="0.05" max="0.25" step="0.01" value={currentPage?.footerHeight} onChange={v=>updatePage({footerHeight:clamp(v,.05,.25)})}/>
              <DesignerSelect label="Footer Layout" value={currentPage?.footerLayout} onChange={v=>updatePage({footerLayout:v})}><option value="contact-left">Contact Left</option><option value="contact-center">Contact Center</option><option value="contact-right">Contact Right</option></DesignerSelect>
              <div style={{marginTop:12,padding:10,background:'#f8fafc',borderRadius:8,fontSize:11,color:'#64748b'}}>Each page has its own blocks, background, header/footer visibility, height and layout. Page 1 and Page 2 can therefore have completely different content.</div>
            </div>}

            {tab==='blocks'&&<div style={{padding:16}}>
              <h4 style={{margin:'0 0 10px'}}>Page {pageIndex+1} Content</h4>
              <div style={{display:'grid',gridTemplateColumns:'1fr 1fr',gap:7}}><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('text')}><FiType/> Text</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('heading')}><FiFileText/> Heading</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('image')}><FiImage/> Image</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('divider')}><FiMinus/> Divider</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('table')}><FiTable/> Table</button><button className="qt-btn-outline" onClick={()=>addBlock('signature')}><FiFileText/> Signature</button></div>
              <div style={{borderTop:'1px solid #e5e7eb',margin:'15px 0',paddingTop:14}}/><h4 style={{margin:'0 0 8px'}}>Blocks</h4>
              {blocks.length===0&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:'#6b7280'}}>No blocks on this page.</div>}
              {blocks.map(b=><div key={b.id} onClick={()=>setSelectedId(b.id)} style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:7,padding:'8px 7px',marginBottom:5,border:selectedId===b.id?`1px solid ${design.accentColor}`:'1px solid #e5e7eb',borderRadius:7,cursor:'pointer'}}><span style={{flex:1,fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>{b.type} — {(b.text||'').slice(0,28)}</span><button className="qt-btn-ghost" onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();deleteBlock(b.id)}}><FiTrash2 size={12}/></button></div>)}
            </div>}

            {tab==='fields'&&<div style={{padding:16}}>
              <h4 style={{margin:'0 0 6px'}}>Amount / Merge Fields</h4>
              <div style={{fontSize:11,color:'#64748b',marginBottom:10}}>
                These are the exact spots (blue dashed boxes on the canvas) where a telecaller's typed value
                gets placed on the final PDF — e.g. ERP Pro Plan amount. Drag a box onto the blank space in
                the uploaded template, or type X/Y/Width/Height directly below.
              </div>
              <button className="qt-btn-primary" style={{width:'100%',marginBottom:12}} onClick={addField}><FiPlus size={13}/> Add Field</button>

              <div style={{border:'1px solid #e5e7eb',borderRadius:8,padding:10,marginBottom:14}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,marginBottom:6}}>Import fields from JSON</div>
                <textarea value={importText} onChange={e=>{setImportText(e.target.value);setImportError('')}} placeholder='Paste your fields JSON here'
                  style={{width:'100%',minHeight:70,boxSizing:'border-box',border:'1px solid #d1d5db',borderRadius:6,padding:'7px 8px',fontSize:11,fontFamily:'monospace'}}/>
                {importError && <div style={{color:'#b91c1c',fontSize:11,marginTop:4}}>{importError}</div>}
                <button className="qt-btn-outline" style={{width:'100%',marginTop:6}} onClick={importFields} disabled={!importText.trim()}><FiUpload size={12}/> Import (replaces current fields)</button>
              </div>

              <h4 style={{margin:'0 0 8px'}}>Fields on this template ({fields.length})</h4>
              {fields.length===0&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:'#6b7280'}}>No fields yet — add one or import JSON above.</div>}
              {fields.map(f=><div key={f.id} style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:7,padding:'8px 7px',marginBottom:5,border:selectedFieldId===f.id?'1px solid #2563eb':'1px solid #e5e7eb',borderRadius:7}}>
                <span onClick={()=>setSelectedFieldId(f.id)} style={{flex:'1 1 auto',fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,cursor:'pointer'}}>{f.label} <span style={{color:'#9ca3af',fontWeight:400}}>({f.mapsTo})</span></span>

  BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line,
  XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";

  FaUsers, FaPhone, FaRedo, FaTrophy, FaSearch,
  FaFileExcel, FaPrint, FaCheckCircle, FaPhoneSlash, FaSyncAlt

const PERIODS = [
  { value: "TODAY", label: "Today" },
  { value: "WEEK", label: "This Week" },
  { value: "MONTH", label: "This Month" },

const exportCsv = (rows, filename) => {
  const keys = Object.keys(rows[0] || {});
  const csv = [
    keys.join(","),
    ...rows.map(row => keys.map(key => {
      const value = String(row[key] ?? "").replaceAll('"', '""');
      return `"${value}"`;
    }).join(","))
  ].join("\n");

  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
};

const ReportView = ({ admin = false }) => {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState("MONTH");
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);
  const [telecallers, setTelecallers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedUsername, setSelectedUsername] = useState("");
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadingDetail, setLoadingDetail] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      if (admin) {
        const [overall, rows] = await Promise.all([
          reportService.getOverallReport(period),
          reportService.getTelecallerReports(period),
        ]);
        setReport(overall);
        setTelecallers(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []);
        setSelectedUsername("");
        setSelectedReport(null);
      } else {
        setReport(await reportService.getMyReport(period));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || "Unable to load report data.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [period]);

  const openTelecaller = async username => {
    if (!username) {
      setSelectedUsername("");
      setSelectedReport(null);
      return;
    }

    setLoadingDetail(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      setSelectedUsername(username);
      setSelectedReport(await reportService.getTelecallerReport(username, period));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || "Unable to load telecaller report.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDetail(false);
    }
  };

  const activeReport = selectedReport || report;
  const summary = activeReport?.summary || {};
  const today = activeReport?.today || {};
  const leadStatus = activeReport?.leadStatus || [];
  const outcomes = activeReport?.callOutcomes || [];
  const trend = activeReport?.performanceTrend || [];

  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Leads", value: summary.totalLeads ?? 0, icon: <FaUsers />, color: "#7b1113" },
    { label: "Calls Made", value: summary.callsMade ?? 0, icon: <FaPhone />, color: "#2563eb" },
    { label: "Follow-ups", value: summary.followUps ?? 0, icon: <FaRedo />, color: "#d97706" },
    { label: "Connected Calls", value: summary.connectedCalls ?? 0, icon: <FaCheckCircle />, color: "#16a34a" },
    { label: "Missed Calls", value: summary.missedCalls ?? 0, icon: <FaPhoneSlash />, color: "#dc2626" },
    { label: "Interested Leads", value: summary.interestedLeads ?? 0, icon: <FaUsers />, color: "#7c3aed" },
    { label: "Clients Converted", value: summary.clientsConverted ?? 0, icon: <FaTrophy />, color: "#0891b2" },
    { label: "Conversion Rate", value: `${summary.conversionRate ?? 0}%`, icon: <FaTrophy />, color: "#db2777" },
  ];

  const filteredTelecallers = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!needle) return telecallers;
    return telecallers.filter(row =>
      [row.fullName, row.username, row.employeeId]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .some(value => String(value).toLowerCase().includes(needle))
    );
  }, [search, telecallers]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="rp-root"><div className="rp-panel">Loading report data...</div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="rp-root">
      <div className="rp-page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="rp-page-title">
            {admin ? "Reports & Telecaller Performance" : "My Reports"}
          </h1>
          <div className="rp-breadcrumb">
            {admin
              ? "Centralized performance reporting for all telecallers"
              : "Your own performance data from the backend"}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rp-header-actions">
          <select
            className="rp-select"
            value={period}
            onChange={e => setPeriod(e.target.value)}
          >
            {PERIODS.map(item => (
              <option key={item.value} value={item.value}>{item.label}</option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <button className="rp-btn rp-btn-outline" onClick={load}>
            <FaSyncAlt /> Refresh
          </button>

          <button
            className="rp-btn rp-btn-outline"
            onClick={() => exportCsv(
              cards.map(card => ({ Metric: card.label, Value: card.value })),
              "reports-summary.csv"
            )}
          >
            <FaFileExcel /> Export
          </button>

          <button className="rp-btn rp-btn-primary" onClick={() => window.print()}>
            <FaPrint /> Print
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="rp-error">{error}</div>}

      {admin && (
        <div className="rp-panel">
          <div className="rp-panel-header">
            <div>
              <h3>Telecaller Comparison</h3>
              <p>Select a telecaller to view their individual report.</p>

                placeholder="Search telecaller"
                value={search}
                onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

                  return (

                      onClick={() => openTelecaller(row.username)}
                    >

        setLoading(false);

    setSaving(true);

      console.error('Error saving settings:', error);

      setSaving(false);

  const toggleSwitch = (setting, value, setter) => {

    setActiveTab(tabId);
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate(`settings-${tabId}`);
    }
  };

  const handleBackToSettings = () => {
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate('settings');
    }
  };

  // Get current tab label
  const currentTabLabel = tabItems.find(tab => tab.id === activeTab)?.label || 'Settings';

  const renderTabContent = () => {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'profile':
        return renderCompanyProfile();
      case 'security':
        return renderSecurity();
      case 'notifications':
        return renderNotifications();
      case 'calls':
        return renderCallSettings();
      case 'about':
        return renderAbout();
      default:
        return renderCompanyProfile();
    }
  };

  // --- Company Profile Render ---
  const renderCompanyProfile = () => (
    <div className="settings-section">
      <div className="section-header">
        <h3>Company Profile</h3>
        <p className="section-desc">Manage your company information and branding</p>
      </div>

        <div className="form-grid">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>Company Name</label>

            />

              type="email"

===== D:\CRM Main\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app\src\services\agreementService.js =====
// src/services/agreementService.js
const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE || 'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 30000;

const auth = (json = true) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  return {
    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    ...(json ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
    Accept: 'application/json',
    'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
  };
};

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT);
  const isForm = options.body instanceof FormData;

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      ...options,
      signal: controller.signal,
      headers: { ...auth(!isForm), ...(options.headers || {}) },
    });

    if (response.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      window.location.href = '/login';
      throw new Error('Session expired. Please login again.');
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const text = await response.text().catch(() => '');
      let error = {};
      try { error = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; } catch { error = { message: text }; }
      throw new Error(error.message || `API error: ${response.status}`);
    }

    if (response.status === 204) return null;
    const text = await response.text();
    if (!text) return null;
    try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return { message: text }; }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.name === 'AbortError') throw new Error('Request timed out. Please try again.');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

const query = (params = {}) => {
  const value = new URLSearchParams(
    Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(params).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '')),
  ).toString();
  return value ? `?${value}` : '';
};

/**
 * Convert Spring Page response to content array.
 * Also supports APIs that directly return an array.
 * (This was missing from the telecaller file — it's what caused
 * "pageContent is not defined".)
 */
const pageContent = (value) =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? value : value?.content || [];

export const agreementService = {
  list: (params = {}) => request(`/agreements${query(params)}`),
  get: (id) => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
  create: (data) => request('/agreements', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(data) }),
  update: (id, data) => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(data) }),
  previewAgreement: (data) => request('/agreements/preview', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(data) }),
  submit: (id) => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/submit`, { method: 'POST' }),
  approve: (id, remark = '') => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/approve`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ remark }) }),
  reject: (id, reason = '') => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/reject`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason }) }),
  send: (id, channel = 'WhatsApp') => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/send`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ channel }) }),
  remove: (id) => request(`/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  // ============================================================
  // AGREEMENT TEMPLATES
  // ============================================================
  templates: () => request('/agreement-templates'),

  // Added — this is what caused "agreementService.templatesByType is not a function"
  templatesByType: (type) => request(`/agreement-templates${query({ type })}`),

  createTemplate: (data) => request('/agreement-templates', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(data) }),
  updateTemplateHtml: (id, contentHtml) => request(`/agreement-templates/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/html`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ contentHtml }) }),
  renameTemplate: (id, name) => request(`/agreement-templates/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/name`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ name }) }),
  archiveTemplate: (id) => request(`/agreement-templates/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  // ============================================================
  // AGREEMENT PLANS
  // ============================================================
  // Added — the New Agreement form calls this right alongside
  // templatesByType(), so it would have thrown next.
  plans: (type) => request(`/agreement-plans${query({ type })}`),

  // ============================================================
  // TELECALLER LEADS
  // ============================================================
  leads: () =>
    request('/telecaller/leads?size=1000&sort=createdAt,desc')
      .then(pageContent),

  pdfBlobUrl: async (id) => {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/agreements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/pdf`, { headers: auth(false) });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to load PDF: ${response.status}`);
    return URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());
  },
};

export default agreementService;

===== D:\CRM Main\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app\src\services\api.js =====
// src/services/api.js

const API_BASE =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ||
  'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';

/**
 * Generic API request function with authentication
 */
const request = async (endpoint, options = {}) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');

  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
    ...options.headers,
  };

  if (token) {
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers,
      body:
        options.body && typeof options.body === 'object'
          ? JSON.stringify(options.body)
          : options.body,
    });

    if (response.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');

      window.location.href = '/login';

      throw new Error('Session expired. Please login again.');
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

      throw new Error(
        errorData.message ||
          errorData.error ||
          `API error: ${response.status}`
      );
    }

    // Handle empty response
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');

    if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
      return null;
    }

    return response.json();
  } catch (error) {

  }

// CRM-APP (TELECALLERS)/src/services/apiClient.js
// Shared fetch wrapper used by demoService.js (and available to any other
// service that wants a single place for base URL, auth header, and error
// handling). Mirrors the same request() pattern already used in
// callService.js / telecallerService.js so behavior stays consistent
// across the app.
const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE || 'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';
const getToken = () => localStorage.getItem('token');
export const request = async (endpoint, options = {}) => {
  const token = getToken();
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
    ...options.headers,
  };
  if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
  });
  if (response.status === 401) {
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    window.location.href = '/login';
    throw new Error('Session expired. Please login again.');
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const err = new Error(error.message || error.error || `API error: ${response.status}`);
    err.data = error;
    throw err;
  }
  if (response.status === 204) return null;
  return response.json();
};
export default request;

// CRM-APP (TELECALLERS)/src/services/authService.js
const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE || 'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';
const getToken = () => localStorage.getItem('token');

const apiCall = async (endpoint, options = {}) => {
  const token = getToken();
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
    ...options.headers,
  };
  // never send an old/stale token with the login request itself
  const isLogin = endpoint.startsWith('/auth/login');
  if (token && !isLogin) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
    // removed credentials: 'include' - backend uses
    // app.cors.allowed-origins=* (wildcard), and browsers reject
    // wildcard-origin + credentials:'include' combos outright.
    // Auth is via the Authorization header (JWT) above, not cookies.
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(error.message || error.error || `API error: ${response.status}`);
  }
  return response.json();
};

export const authService = {
  login: (username, password) => apiCall('/auth/login', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ username: (username || '').trim(), password }),
  }),
  register: (userData) => apiCall('/auth/register', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(userData),
  }),
  logout: async () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    return { success: true };
  },
  validateToken: () => {
    const token = getToken();
    if (!token) return Promise.reject('No token');
    return apiCall('/auth/validate', {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
  },
};

export default authService;

// src/services/cache.js
// Tiny stale-while-revalidate helper.
//   - If we already have data for `key` (memory or sessionStorage) -> onData(cached) is called
//     IMMEDIATELY so the page paints in ~0 ms.
//   - Then fresh data is fetched (only if the cached copy is older than `ttl`) and onData(fresh)
//     is called again.
//   - Concurrent calls for the same key share ONE network request.
//   - Cache is scoped to the logged-in token, so one user never sees another user's data.

const mem = new Map();        // scopedKey -> { data, at }
const inflight = new Map();   // scopedKey -> Promise
const PREFIX = 'crmswr:';

const scope = () => (localStorage.getItem('token') || 'anon').slice(-16);
const skey = (key) => `${scope()}:${key}`;

const read = (key) => {
  const k = skey(key);
  const m = mem.get(k);
  if (m) return m;
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(PREFIX + k);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.at === 'number') {
        mem.set(k, parsed);
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return null;
};

const write = (key, data) => {
  const k = skey(key);
  const entry = { data, at: Date.now() };
  mem.set(k, entry);
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(PREFIX + k, JSON.stringify(entry)); } catch { /* quota: memory copy is enough */ }
};

export async function swr(key, fetcher, { ttl = 15000, onData, force = false } = {}) {
  const cached = read(key);
  const age = cached ? Date.now() - cached.at : Infinity;

  if (cached && onData) onData(cached.data, { cached: true });
  if (cached && age < ttl && !force) return cached.data;

  const k = skey(key);
  let p = inflight.get(k);
  if (!p) {
    p = fetcher()
      .then((data) => { write(key, data); return data; })
      .finally(() => inflight.delete(k));
    inflight.set(k, p);
  }

  try {
    const fresh = await p;
    if (onData) onData(fresh, { cached: false });
    return fresh;
  } catch (err) {
    // We already showed cached data -> do not blow the page up because a refresh failed.
    if (cached) return cached.data;
    throw err;
  }
}

// Call after you change data so the next read is fresh. invalidate('district:') clears every district list.
export function invalidate(prefix = '') {
  const p = skey(prefix);
  for (const k of Array.from(mem.keys())) if (k.startsWith(p)) mem.delete(k);
  try {
    Object.keys(sessionStorage)
      .filter((k) => k.startsWith(PREFIX + p))
      .forEach((k) => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

export function clearCache() {
  mem.clear();
  try {
    Object.keys(sessionStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith(PREFIX)).forEach((k) => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

    ...(options.headers || {}),
  };

  if (token) {
    headers.Authorization =
      `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  const response =
    await fetch(
      `${BASE}${endpoint}`,
      {
        ...options,
        headers,
      }
    );

  if (response.status === 401) {

    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');

    window.location.href =
      '/login';

    throw new Error(
      'Session expired. Please login again.'
    );
  }

  if (response.status === 403) {

    throw new Error(
      'You do not have permission to use Communications.'
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {

    const error =
      await response
        .json()
        .catch(() => ({}));

    throw new Error(
      error.message ||
      error.error ||
      `API error: ${response.status}`
    );
  }

  return response.json();
};

    request(
      `/monitor/messages?firstUsername=${encodeURIComponent(firstUsername)}&secondUsername=${encodeURIComponent(secondUsername)}`
    ),

    attachmentId
  ) =>
    `${BASE}/attachments/${encodeURIComponent(
      attachmentId
    )}`,

  // Fetch protected attachment/audio with JWT and return a Blob URL.
  getAttachmentBlobUrl: async (attachmentId, expectedSizeBytes = 0) => {
    if (!attachmentId) {
      throw new Error('Attachment ID is missing');
    }

    const token = getToken();
    let lastError = null;

    // A voice/file download must be complete before it is handed to the
    // audio element. Retry once if the browser receives a short response.
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${BASE}/attachments/${encodeURIComponent(attachmentId)}`,
          {
            method: 'GET',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
              ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
              'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
              Accept: '*/*',
            },
          }
        );

        if (response.status === 401) {
          localStorage.removeItem('token');
          localStorage.removeItem('user');
          window.location.href = '/login';
          throw new Error('Session expired. Please login again.');
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          const text = await response.text();
          throw new Error(
            text || `Attachment request failed: ${response.status}`
          );
        }

        const rawBlob = await response.blob();
        const serverType = response.headers.get('Content-Type')?.split(';')[0]?.trim();
        const blob = serverType && rawBlob.type !== serverType
          ? new Blob([rawBlob], { type: serverType })
          : rawBlob;
        const actualSize = blob.size;
        const expected = Number(expectedSizeBytes) || 0;

        if (expected > 0 && actualSize !== expected) {
          throw new Error(
            `Incomplete attachment download (${actualSize} of ${expected} bytes).`
          );
        }

        if (!actualSize) {
          throw new Error('Attachment download returned an empty file.');
        }

        return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      } catch (err) {
        lastError = err;
        if (attempt === 0) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
        }
      }
    }

    throw lastError || new Error('Unable to load attachment.');
  },

  openAttachment: async (attachmentId) => {
    const url = await communicationService.getAttachmentBlobUrl(attachmentId);
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
  },
};

export default communicationService;

  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    headers: {
      Accept: "application/json",
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),

    },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(body.message || body.error || `API error: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return body;
}

// src/services/leadService.js

const API_BASE =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ||
  'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';

const getToken = () => localStorage.getItem('token');

const apiCall = async (endpoint, options = {}) => {
  const token = getToken();

  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
    ...options.headers,
  };

  if (token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
    // removed credentials: 'include' - your backend uses
    // app.cors.allowed-origins=* (wildcard), and browsers reject
    // wildcard-origin + credentials:'include' combos outright.
    // We authenticate via the Authorization header (JWT) above,
    // not cookies, so credentials:'include' isn't needed anyway.
  });

  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');

    window.location.href = '/login';

    throw new Error('Session expired. Please login again.');
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

    throw new Error(
      error.message ||
      error.error ||
      `API error: ${response.status}`
    );
  }

  return response.json();
};

const API_BASE = (
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ||
  'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api'
).replace(/\/+$/, '');

function getAuthToken() {
  return (
    localStorage.getItem('token') ||
    localStorage.getItem('accessToken') ||
    localStorage.getItem('jwt') ||
    ''
  );
}

/**
 * Normalize and validate an Indian mobile number.
 * Accepts:
 *   8925897422
 *   +91 89258 97422
 *   91-8925897422
 */
function normalizePhoneNumber(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    throw new Error('A lead mobile number is required.');
  }

  let digits = String(value).trim().replace(/\D/g, '');

  if (digits.startsWith('0091') && digits.length === 14) {
    digits = digits.slice(4);
  } else if (digits.startsWith('91') && digits.length === 12) {
    digits = digits.slice(2);
  }

  if (!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(digits)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number. Received: "${String(value).trim()}".`
    );
  }

  return digits;
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const token = getAuthToken();

  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
      ...(options.body
        ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
        : {}),
      ...(token
        ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
        : {}),
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    },
  });

  const raw = await response.text();
  let data = {};

  if (raw) {
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      data = { message: raw };
    }
  }

  const looksLikeHtml = /^\s*<(!doctype|html)/i.test(raw);
  if (looksLikeHtml) {
    throw new Error(
      'The CRM server returned a web page instead of data. Check the API URL / ngrok tunnel.'
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      data?.message ||
        data?.error ||
        `Local SIM API request failed (${response.status})`
    );
  }

  return data;
}

function post(path, body) {
  return request(path, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

/**
 * Initiate an outgoing call through the local SIM bridge.
 */
async function call({
  leadId,
  leadName,
  leadMobile,
  phoneNumber,
  mobile,
  agentUsername,
} = {}) {
  const normalizedNumber = normalizePhoneNumber(
    leadMobile ?? phoneNumber ?? mobile
  );

  return post('/local-sim/calls', {
    action: 'DIAL',
    leadId: leadId ?? null,
    leadName: leadName ?? '',
    leadMobile: normalizedNumber,
    phoneNumber: normalizedNumber,
    mobile: normalizedNumber,
    ...(agentUsername ? { agentUsername } : {}),
  });
}

async function sendAction(requestId, action) {
  if (!requestId) {
    throw new Error('requestId is required.');
  }

  // The backend creates a NEW command for the action and links it to the original call.
  return post('/local-sim/calls', {
    action,
    parentRequestId: requestId,
    requestId,
  });
}

async function answer(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'ANSWER');
}

async function reject(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'REJECT');
}

async function hangup(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'HANGUP');
}

// In-call controls. Each one creates a command that the Windows companion sends to the phone.
// Response = the parent call snapshot + followUpRequestId (the id of the control command).
async function hold(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'HOLD');
}

async function resume(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'RESUME');
}

async function mute(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'MUTE');
}

async function unmute(requestId) {
  return sendAction(requestId, 'UNMUTE');
}

/**
 * Wait until the phone has confirmed (or rejected) a control command.
 * Resolves { ok: true } on COMPLETED, { ok: false, message } on FAILED / CANCELLED / timeout.
 */
async function waitForAction(controlRequestId, timeoutMs = 25000) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
    let cmd;
    try {
      cmd = await getCall(controlRequestId);
    } catch (error) {
      return { ok: false, message: error.message || 'Lost contact with the CRM server.' };
    }
    const st = String(cmd?.status || '').toUpperCase();
    if (st === 'COMPLETED') return { ok: true, message: cmd.message || '' };
    if (['FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'BUSY', 'NO_ANSWER'].includes(st)) {
      return { ok: false, message: cmd.message || 'The phone did not accept the command.' };
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, message: 'The phone did not confirm in time. Check the Windows companion and the phone.' };
}

async function getCall(requestId) {
  if (!requestId) {
    throw new Error('requestId is required.');
  }

  return request(
    `/local-sim/calls/${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}`
  );
}

async function updateStatus(requestId, status, message = '') {
  if (!requestId) {
    throw new Error('requestId is required.');
  }

  return post(
    `/local-sim/calls/${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}/status`,
    {
      status,
      message,
    }
  );
}

  return request('/local-sim/calls/companion-status');
}

const API_BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ||
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:8080/api';

const getToken = () =>
  localStorage.getItem('token') ||
  localStorage.getItem('jwtToken') ||
  localStorage.getItem('accessToken');

const request = async (url, options = {}) => {
  const token = getToken();
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${url}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
      ...(options.headers || {})
    }
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const text = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(text || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.status === 204 ? null : response.json();
};

};

===== D:\CRM Main\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app(telecallers)\crm-app\src\services\reportService.js =====
const API_BASE =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ||
  'https://crmbackend-5d2o.onrender.com/api';

const request = async (path) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    },
  });

  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(body.message || body.error || 'You do not have permission to access reports.');
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(body.message || body.error || `Report request failed (${response.status})`);
  }

  return response.json();
};
